I married one of my daughters to Abu Al-`As bin Al- Rabi` (the husband of Zainab, the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) before Islam and he proved truthful in whatever he said to me. No doubt, Fatima is a part of me, I hate to see her being troubled. By Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the daughter of Allah's Enemy cannot be the wives of one man." So `Ali gave up that engagement. 'Al-Miswar further said: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking and he mentioned a son-in-law of his belonging to the tribe of Bani `Abd-Shams. He highly praised him concerning that relationship and said (whenever) he spoke to me, he spoke the truth, and whenever he promised me, he fulfilled his promise
62.hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi ka prastaav rakha. Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne yeh suna aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas gaee aur kaha, "Aapki qaum sochti hai ke aap apni betiyon ke liye naraaj nahi hote, kyunke Ali ab Abu Jahl ki beti se shaadi karna chahte hain." Isspar Allah ke Rasool khade hue aur apna Tashah-hud padhne ke baad, maine unhe kehte suna, "Iske baad! Maine apni ek beti ki shaadi Abu Al-As bin Ar-Rabi (yaani Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا), Nabi ki beti ke shohar) se ki thi Islam se pahle, aur woh mujhse jo bhi kahte the usme sachche nikle. Koi shak nahi, Fatima mera ek hissa hai, mujhe napasand hai use pareshaan hote dekhna. Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ki beti aur Allah ke dushman ki beti ek shaks ki biwiyaan nahi ban sakti." Isliye Ali ne woh mangni chhod di. Al-Miswar ne aage kaha: Maine Nabi ko baat karte suna aur unhone apne ek daamad ka zikar kiya jo Bani Abd-Shams qabile se the. Unhone unke baare mein bahut taarif ki us rishte mein, kehte huye, "(Jab bhi) unhone mujhse baat ki, unhone sach kaha, aur jab bhi unhone mujhse waada kiya, unhone apna waada poora kiya."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا، وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، فَطَعَنَ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ تَطْعُنُوا فِي إِمَارَتِهِ فَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْعُنُونَ فِي إِمَارَةِ أَبِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ، إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لِلإِمَارَةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent an army under the command of Usama bin Zaid. When some people criticized his leadership, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If you are criticizing Usama's leadership, you used to criticize his father's leadership before. By Allah! He was worthy of leadership and was one of the dearest persons to me, and (now) this (i.e. Usama) is one of the dearest to me after him (i.e. Zaid)
62.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne ek fauj Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke netritva mein bheji. Jab kuch logon ne unki agwaee par ilzaam lagaya, Nabi ne kaha, "Agar tum Usama ki agwaee par ilzaam lagate ho, tumne unke waalid ki agwaee par bhi pahle ilzaam lagaya tha. Allah ki qasam! Woh agwaee ke laayak the aur mere sabse pyare logon mein se ek the, aur (ab) yeh (yaani Usama) unke baad mere sabse pyare logon mein se ek hai."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ قَائِفٌ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَاهِدٌ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ مُضْطَجِعَانِ، فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الأَقْدَامَ بَعْضُهَا مِنْ بَعْضٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسُرَّ بِذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَعْجَبَهُ، فَأَخْبَرَ بِهِ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Urwa:Aisha said, "A Qaif (i.e. one skilled in recognizing the lineage of a person through Physiognomy and through examining the body parts of an infant) came to me while the Prophet (ﷺ) was present, and Usama bin Zaid and Zaid bin Haritha were Lying asleep. The Qa'if said. These feet (of Usama and his father) are of persons belonging to the same lineage.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) was pleased with that saying which won his admiration, and he told `Aisha of it
62.hi: Urwa bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Ek Qaif (yaani ek maahir jo shaariirik lakshanon se rishta pahchante hain) mere paas aaya jabke Nabi wahaan maujood the, aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Zaid bin Haritha sote hue the. Qaif ne kaha, 'Yeh (Usama aur unke waalid ke) paanv ek hi vansh ke logon ke hain.'" Nabi is baat se khush hue jisne unka dil jeeta, aur unhone Ayesha ko bhi iske baare mein bataya.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا، أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ، فَقَالُوا مَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
62.en: Narrated 'Aisha: The people of the Quraish tribe were worried about the Makhzumiya woman. They said. "Nobody dare speak to him (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) except Usama bin Zaid as he is the most beloved to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
62.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Quraish qabile ke log Makhzumiya aurat ke maamle se pareshaan the. Unhone kaha, "Koi bhi unse (yaani Nabi se) baat karne ki himmat nahi karega siwaye Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke, kyunke woh Allah ke Rasool ko sabse pyare hain."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ أَسْأَلُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنْ حَدِيثِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ، فَصَاحَ بِي، قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ فَلَمْ تَحْتَمِلْهُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ قَالَ وَجَدْتُهُ فِي كِتَابٍ كَانَ كَتَبَهُ أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ سَرَقَتْ، فَقَالُ��ا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَجْتَرِئْ أَحَدٌ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ، فَكَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَ إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ، وَإِذَا سَرَقَ الضَّعِيفُ قَطَعُوهُ، لَوْ كَانَتْ فَاطِمَةُ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Aisha said, "A woman from Bani Makhzumiya committed a theft and the people said, 'Who can intercede with the Prophet (ﷺ) for her?' So nobody dared speak to him (i.e. the Prophet) but Usama bin Zaid spoke to him. The Prophet said, 'If a reputable man amongst the children of Bani Israel committed a theft, they used to forgive him, but if a poor man committed a theft, they would cut his hand. But I would cut even the hand of Fatima (i.e. the daughter of the Prophet) if she committed a theft
62.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bani Makhzumiya qabile ki ek aurat ne chori ki, aur logon ne kaha, "Kaun Nabi ke saamne uske liye sifarish kar sakta hai?" Isliye kisi ne unse (yaani Nabi se) baat karne ki himmat nahi ki siwaye Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke. Nabi ne kaha, "Agar Bani Israel mein koi izzatdaar shaks chori karta, woh use maaf kar dete, magar agar koi gareeb shaks chori karta, woh uska haath kaat dete. Magar main Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) (yaani Nabi ki beti) ka bhi haath kaatunga agar woh chori kare."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبَّادٍ، يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَاجِشُونُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ نَظَرَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَوْمًا وَهْوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ إِلَى رَجُلٍ يَسْحَبُ ثِيَابَهُ فِي نَاحِيَةٍ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ انْظُرْ مَنْ هَذَا لَيْتَ هَذَا عِنْدِي‏.‏ قَالَ لَهُ إِنْسَانٌ أَمَا تَعْرِفُ هَذَا يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هَذَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ فَطَأْطَأَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ رَأْسَهُ، وَنَقَرَ بِيَدَيْهِ فِي الأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْ رَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَحَبَّهُ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:One day Ibn `Umar, while in the Mosque, looked at a man who was dragging his clothes while walking in one of the corners of the Mosque He said, "See who is that. I wish he was near to me." Somebody then said (to Ibn `Umar), "Don't you know him, O Abu `Abdur-Rahman? He is Muhammad bin Usama." On that Ibn `Umar bowed his head and dug the earth with his hands and then, said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he would have loved him
62.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Dinar bataate hain: Ek din Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne masjid mein ek shaks ko dekha jo masjid ke ek kone mein apne kapde ghaseette hue chal raha tha. Unhone kaha, "Dekho yeh kaun hai. Kaash woh mere qareeb hote." Kisi ne (Ibn Umar se) kaha, "Kya aap unhe nahi jaante, Aye Abu Abdur-Rahman? Woh Muhammad bin Usama hain." Isspar Ibn Umar ne apna sar jhukaya aur apne haathon se zameen khoda aur kaha, "Agar Allah ke Rasool unhe dekhte, woh unse pyar karte."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ حَدَّثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْخُذُهُ وَالْحَسَنَ فَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَحِبَّهُمَا فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Usama bin Zaid: That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take him (i.e. Usama) and Al-Hasan (in his lap) and say: "O Allah! Love them, as I love them
62.hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi unhe (yaani Usama ko) aur Al-Hasan ko (apni god mein) uthate the aur kahte, "Aye Allah! Inse pyar kar, jaisa main unse pyar karta hoon."

62.ar: وَقَالَ نُعَيْمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَوْلًى، لأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ‏.‏ أَنَّ الْحَجَّاجَ بْنَ أَيْمَنَ ابْنِ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ،، وَكَانَ، أَيْمَنُ ابْنُ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ أَخَا أُسَامَةَ لأُمِّهِ، وَهْوَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، فَرَآهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَمْ يُتِمَّ رُكُوعَهُ وَلاَ سُجُودَهُ فَقَالَ أَعِدْ‏.‏
62.en: The freed slave of Usama bin Zaid said, "Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman bin Um Aiman and Aiman Ibn Um Aiman was Usama's brother from the maternal side, and he was one of the Ansar. He was seen by Ibn 'Umar not performing his bowing and prostrations in a perfect manner. So Ibn 'Umar told him to repeat his prayer
62.hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam bataate hain: Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman bin Um Aiman, aur Aiman ibn Um Aiman Usama ke mama-jaee bhai the, aur woh Ansaar mein se the. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe dekha ke woh apna ruku aur sajda sahi tarike se nahi kar rahe the. Isliye Ibn Umar ne unhe namaz doharane ko kaha.

62.ar: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَحَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ نَمِرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ، مَوْلَى أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ إِذْ دَخَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ فَلَمْ يُتِمَّ رُكُوعَهُ وَلاَ سُجُودَهُ، فَقَالَ أَعِدْ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ هَذَا قُلْتُ الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ ابْنِ أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَوْ رَأَى هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَحَبَّهُ، فَذَكَرَ حُبَّهُ وَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّ أَيْمَنَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَكَانَتْ حَاضِنَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
62.en: Harmala, the freed slave of Usama bin Zaid said that while he was in the company of 'Abdullah bin 'Umar, Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman came in and (while praying) he did not perform his bowing and prostrations properly. So Ibn 'Umar told him to repeat his prayer. When he went away, Ibn 'Umar asked me, "Who is he?" I said, "Al-Hajjaj bin Um Aiman." Ibn 'Umar said, "If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him, he would have loved him." Then Ibn 'Umar mentioned the love of the Prophet (ﷺ) for the children of Um Aiman. Sulaiman said that Um Aiman was one of the nurses of the Prophet
62.hi: Harmala, Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam, bataate hain: Jabke woh Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ki sohbat mein the, Al-Hajjaj bin Aiman aaye aur (namaz padhte waqt) unhone apna ruku aur sajda sahi tarike se nahi kiya. Isliye Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne unhe namaz doharane ko kaha. Jab woh chale gaye, Ibn Umar ne mujhse pucha, "Woh kaun hain?" Maine kaha, "Al-Hajjaj bin Um Aiman." Ibn Umar ne kaha, "Agar Allah ke Rasool unhe dekhte, woh unse pyar karte." Phir Ibn Umar ne Nabi ki Um Aiman ke bachchon ke prati mohabbat ka zikar kiya. Sulaiman ne kaha ke Um Aiman Nabi ki daiyon mein se ek thi.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِي حَيَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَأَى رُؤْيَا قَصَّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَتَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَرَى رُؤْيَا أَقُصُّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكُنْتُ غُلاَمًا أَعْزَبَ، وَكُنْتُ أَنَامُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّ مَلَكَيْنِ أَخَذَانِي فَذَهَبَا بِي إِلَى النَّارِ، فَإِذَا هِيَ مَطْوِيَّةٌ كَطَىِّ الْبِئْرِ، فَإِذَا لَهَا قَرْنَانِ كَقَرْنَىِ الْبِئْرِ، وَإِذَا فِيهَا نَاسٌ قَدْ عَرَفْتُهُمْ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيَهُمَا مَلَكٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لِي لَنْ تُرَاعَ‏. فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَى حَفْصَةَ‏.‏ فَقَصَّتْهَا حَفْصَةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ يَنَامُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar:If a man saw a dream during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) he would narrate it to the Prophet. Once I wished to see a dream and narrate it to the Prophet (ﷺ) I was young, unmarried, and used to sleep in the Mosque during the lifetime of the Prophet. I dreamt that two angels took me and went away with me towards the (Hell) Fire which looked like a well with the inside walls built up, and had two side-walls like those of a well. There I saw some people in it whom I knew. I started saying, "I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire, I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire." Then another angel met the other two and said to me, "Do not be afraid." I narrated my dream to Hafsa who, in her turn, narrated it to the Prophet. He said, "What an excellent man `Abdullah is if he only observes the night prayer." (Salim, a sub-narrator said, "Abdullah used not to sleep at night but very little hence forward)
62.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Agar koi shaks Nabi ki zindagi mein koi khwab dekhta, woh use Nabi ko sunata. Ek baar main bhi chahta tha ke main koi khwab dekhun aur Nabi ko sunaun. Main jawan tha, ashaadi-shuda, aur Nabi ki zindagi mein masjid mein sota tha. Maine khwab mein dekha ke do farishte mujhe pakadkar (Dozakh ki) aag ki taraf le gaye jo ek kue jaisa dikhta tha, andar se deewaron se bana hua, aur uske do kinare the jaise ek kue ke. Wahaan maine kuch logon ko dekha jinhe main jaanta tha. Main kehne laga, "Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon (Dozakh ki) aag se, main Allah ki panah maangta hoon (Dozakh ki) aag se." Phir ek doosra farishta un donon se mila aur mujhe kaha, "Daro mat." Maine apna khwab Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bataya, jinhone ise Nabi ko bataya. Unhone kaha, "Kaisa behtareen shaks hai Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ), agar woh raat ki namaz (nafil) padha kare." (Salim, doosre raawi ne kaha, "Abdullah tab se raat ko bahut kam sote the.")

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أُخْتِهِ، حَفْصَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ صَالِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar from Hafsa his sister:That the Prophet (ﷺ) had said to her, "`Abdullah is a pious man
62.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) apni behn Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) se bataate hain: Nabi ne unse kaha tha, "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ek pakbaz shaks hai."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ،، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ الشَّأْمَ فَصَلَّيْتُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا، فَأَتَيْتُ قَوْمًا فَجَلَسْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَإِذَا شَيْخٌ قَدْ جَاءَ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَى جَنْبِي، قُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا قَالُوا أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُيَسِّرَ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا فَيَسَّرَكَ لِي، قَالَ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ قُلْتُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوَلَيْسَ عِنْدَكُمُ ابْنُ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ صَاحِبُ النَّعْلَيْنِ وَالْوِسَادِ وَالْمِطْهَرَةِ وَفِيكُمُ الَّذِي أَجَارَهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ صَاحِبُ سِرِّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي لاَ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ كَيْفَ يَقْرَأُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى‏}‏، فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى * وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ فِيهِ إِلَى فِيَّ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated 'Alqama:I went to Sham and offered a two-rak`at prayer and then said, "O Allah! Bless me with a good pious companion." So I went to some people and sat with them. An old man came and sat by my side. I asked, "Who is he?" They replied, "(He is) Abu-Ad-Darda.' I said (to him), "I prayed to Allah to bless me with a pious companion and He sent you to me." He asked me, "From where are you?" I replied, "From the people of Al-Kufa." He said, "Isn't there amongst you Ibn Um `Abd, the one who used to carry the shoes, the cushion(or pillow) and the water for ablution? Is there amongst you the one whom Allah gave Refuge from Satan through the request of His Prophet. Is there amongst you the one who keeps the secrets of the Prophet (ﷺ) which nobody knows except him?" Abu Darda further asked, "How does `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) recite the Sura starting with, 'By the Night as it conceals (the light)." (92.1) Then I recited before him: 'By the Night as it envelops: And by the Day as it appears in brightness; And by male and female.' (91.1-3) On this Abu Ad-Darda' said, "By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) made me recite the Sura in this way while I was listening to him (reciting it)
62.hi: Alqama bataate hain: Main Sham gaya aur do rakat namaz padhi aur phir kaha, "Aye Allah! Mujhe ek achhe, pakbaz sathi se nawaza." Isliye main kuch logon ke paas gaya aur unke saath baith gaya. Ek budha shaks aaya aur mere paas baith gaya. Maine pucha, "Yeh kaun hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "(Yeh) Abu-Ad-Darda hain." Maine (unse) kaha, "Maine Allah se dua ki thi ke mujhe ek pakbaz sathi de, aur usne aapko mere paas bheja." Unhone mujhse pucha, "Tum kahaan se ho?" Maine jawab diya, "Al-Kufa ke logon mein se." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum mein Ibn Um Abd nahi hain, woh jo joote, taakia (yaani gaddi), aur wudu ka paani uthate the? Kya tum mein woh hain jinhe Allah ne Shaitan se panah di apne Nabi ki guzarish par? Kya tum mein woh hain jo Nabi ke raaz rakhte hain jo unke ilawa kisi ko nahi pata?" Abu Darda ne aage pucha, "Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) us Surah ko kaise padhte hain jo shuru hoti hai, 'Raat ki qasam jab woh (roshni) chhupati hai.' (92:1)" Phir maine unke saamne padha: "Raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaati hai; Aur din ki qasam jab woh roshan hoti hai; Aur (uski qasam) jisne nar aur maada banaaye." (91:1-3) Isspar Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, Nabi ne mujhe isi tarah yeh Surah padhwaee jabke main unse (Quran) sun raha tha."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ ذَهَبَ عَلْقَمَةُ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ إِلَى أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ ـ أَوْ مِنْكُمْ ـ صَاحِبُ السِّرِّ الَّذِي لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ غَيْرُهُ يَعْنِي حُذَيْفَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمُ ـ أَوْ مِنْكُمُ ـ الَّذِي أَجَارَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، يَعْنِي عَمَّارًا‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ فِيكُمْ ـ أَوْ مِنْكُمْ ـ صَاحِبُ السِّوَاكِ أَوِ السِّرَارِ قَالَ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى‏}‏ قُلْتُ ‏{‏وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَا زَالَ بِي هَؤُلاَءِ حَتَّى كَادُوا يَسْتَنْزِلُونِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibrahim:'Alqama went to Sham and when he entered the mosque, he said, "O Allah ! Bless me with a pious companion." So he sat with Abu Ad-Darda. Abu Ad-Darda' asked him, "Where are you from?" 'Alqama replied, "From the people of Kufa." Abu Ad-Darda said, "Isn't there amongst you the Keeper of the secret which nobody else knows i.e. Hudhaifa?" Al-qama said, "Yes." Then Abu Ad-Darda further said, "Isn't there amongst you the person whom Allah gave Refuge from Satan through the invocation of His Prophet namely `Ammar?" Alqama replied in the affirmative Abu Ad-Darda said, "Isn't there amongst you the person who carries the Siwak (or the Secret) (i.e. of the Prophet (ﷺ) namely `Abdullah bin Mas'ud)?" Alqama said, "Yes." Then Abu Ad-Darda asked, "How (Abdullah bin Masud) used to recite the Sura starting with: "By the night as it envelopes; By the day as it appears in brightness?" (92.1-2). Alqama said "And by male and female." Abu Ad-Darda then said, "These people (of Sham) tried hard to make me accept something other than what I had heard from the Prophet
62.hi: Ibrahim bataate hain: Alqama Sham gaye aur jab woh masjid mein daakhil hue, unhone kaha, "Aye Allah! Mujhe ek pakbaz sathi de." Isliye woh Abu Ad-Darda ke saath baith gaye. Abu Ad-Darda ne unse pucha, "Tum kahaan se ho?" Alqama ne jawab diya, "Kufa ke logon mein se." Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, "Kya tum mein woh raaz rakhne wala nahi hai jise koi aur nahi jaanta, yaani Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ)?" Alqama ne kaha, "Haan." Phir Abu Ad-Darda ne aage kaha, "Kya tum mein woh shaks nahi hai jise Allah ne Shaitan se panah di apne Nabi ki dua se, yaani Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ)?" Alqama ne haan mein jawab diya. Abu Ad-Darda ne kaha, "Kya tum mein woh shaks nahi hai jo Siwaak (ya raaz) uthata hai (yaani Nabi ka), yaani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ)?" Alqama ne kaha, "Haan." Phir Abu Ad-Darda ne pucha, "(Abdullah bin Masud) kaise padhte the yeh Surah jo shuru hoti hai: 'Raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaati hai; Din ki qasam jab woh roshan hoti hai?'" (92:1-2) Alqama ne kaha, "'Aur (uski qasam) jisne nar aur maada banaaye.'" Abu Ad-Darda ne phir kaha, "Yeh log (Sham ke) mujhe kisi aur cheez ko qubool karane ki koshish karte rahe jo maine Nabi se suna tha uske ilawa."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَمِينًا، وَإِنَّ أَمِينَنَا أَيَّتُهَا الأُمَّةُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, " Every nation has an extremely trustworthy man, and the trustworthy man of this (i.e. Muslim) nation is Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah
62.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Har ummat ka ek bahut bharosemand shaks hota hai, aur is (Musalman) ummat ka bharosemand shaks Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah hain."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ صِلَةَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَهْلِ نَجْرَانَ ‏ "‏ لأَبْعَثَنَّ ـ يَعْنِي عَلَيْكُمْ ـ يَعْنِي أَمِينًا ـ حَقَّ أَمِينٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشْرَفَ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَبَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ رضى الله عنه‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Hudhaifa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the people of Najran, "I will send you the most trustworthy man." (Every one of) the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) was looking forward (to be that person). He then sent Abu 'Ubaida
62.hi: Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Najran ke logon se kaha, "Main tumhare paas sabse zyada bharosemand shaks bhejunga." (Har ek) Nabi ke sahaba ummeed lagaye hue the (ke woh chune jaaenge). Phir unhone Abu Ubaida ko bheja.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، سَمِعَ أَبَا بَكْرَةَ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَالْحَسَنُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، يَنْظُرُ إِلَى النَّاسِ مَرَّةً وَإِلَيْهِ مَرَّةً، وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ ابْنِي هَذَا سَيِّدٌ، وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُصْلِحَ بِهِ بَيْنَ فِئَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Abu Bakra:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) talking at the pulpit while Al-Hasan was sitting beside him, and he (i.e. the Prophet ) was once looking at the people and at another time Al-Hasan, and saying, "This son of mine is a Saiyid (i.e. chief) and perhaps Allah will bring about an agreement between two sects of the Muslims through him
62.hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko mimbar par baat karte suna jabke Al-Hasan unke bagal mein baithe the, aur woh (yaani Nabi) kabhi logon ki taraf dekhte aur kabhi Al-Hasan ki taraf, aur kehte, "Yeh mera beta ek Saiyid (yaani sardaar) hai, aur shaayad Allah unke zariye do Musalman girohon ke beech sulha karvaaae."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْخُذُهُ وَالْحَسَنَ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُمَا فَأَحِبَّهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:That the Prophet (ﷺ) used to take him and Al-Hasan, and used to say, "O Allah! I love them, so please love them," or said something similar
62.hi: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi unhe aur Al-Hasan ko uthate the aur kahte, "Aye Allah! Main inse mohabbat karta hoon, isliye kripya inse mohabbat kar," ya isi se milta-julta kuch kahte.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أُتِيَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ بِرَأْسِ الْحُسَيْنِ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ فَجُعِلَ فِي طَسْتٍ، فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ، وَقَالَ فِي حُسْنِهِ شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ كَانَ أَشْبَهَهُمْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكَانَ مَخْضُوبًا بِالْوَسْمَةِ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Muhammad:Anas bin Malik said, "The head of Al-Husain was brought to 'Ubaidullah bin Ziyad and was put in a tray, and then Ibn Ziyad started playing with a stick at the nose and mouth of Al-Husain's head and saying something about his handsome features." Anas then said (to him), "Al-Husain resembled the Prophet more than the others did." Anas added, "His (i.e. Al-Husain's) hair was dyed with Wasma (i.e. a kind of plant used as a dye)
62.hi: Muhammad bataate hain: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Al-Husain ka sar Ubaidullah bin Ziyad ke paas laaya gaya aur ek tray mein rakha gaya, aur phir Ibn Ziyad Al-Husain ke sar ki naak aur munh ke paas ek lakdi se khelna laga aur unke khoobsurat lakshanon ke baare mein kuch kah raha tha." Anas ne phir (unse) kaha, "Al-Husain Nabi se doosron ki tulna mein zyada milte-julte the." Anas ne joda, "Unke (yaani Al-Husain ke) baal Wasma (yaani ek qisam ke paudhe se bana rang) se range hue the."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيٌّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْحَسَنُ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهُ فَأَحِبَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Al-Bara:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) carrying Al-Hasan on his shoulder an saying, "O Allah! I love him, so please love him
62.hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko Al-Hasan ko apne kandhe par uthate aur kahte dekha, "Aye Allah! Main inse mohabbat karta hoon, isliye kripya inse mohabbat kar."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَحَمَلَ الْحَسَنَ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ بِأَبِي شَبِيهٌ بِالنَّبِيِّ، لَيْسَ شَبِيهٌ بِعَلِيٍّ‏.‏ وَعَلِيٌّ يَضْحَكُ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:I saw Abu Bakr carrying Al-Hasan and saying, "Let my father be sacrificed for you; you resemble the Prophet and not `Ali," while `Ali was laughing at this
62.hi: Uqba bin Al-Harith bataate hain: Maine Abu Bakr ko Al-Hasan ko uthate aur kahte dekha, "Mere waalid tumhare liye qurbaan hon; tum Nabi se milte-julte ho, Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) se nahi," jabke Ali ispar haanste the.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، وَصَدَقَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ارْقُبُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Abu Bakr used to say, "Look after Muhammad (ﷺ) in (looking after) his family
62.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abu Bakr kaha karte the, "Muhammad ka unke pariwara ke maamle mein khyaal rakho."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسٌ، قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ أَشْبَهَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Anas:None resembled the Prophet (ﷺ) more than Al-Hasan bin `Ali did
62.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Koi bhi Nabi se Al-Hasan bin Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) se zyada milta-julta nahi tha.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، وَسَأَلَهُ، عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ،، قَالَ شُعْبَةُ أَحْسِبُهُ يَقْتُلُ الذُّبَابَ فَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ يَسْأَلُونَ عَنِ الذُّبَابِ وَقَدْ قَتَلُوا ابْنَ ابْنَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هُمَا رَيْحَانَتَاىَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn Abi Nu'm:A person asked `Abdullah bin `Umar whether a Muslim could kill flies. I heard him saying (in reply). "The people of Iraq are asking about the killing of flies while they themselves murdered the son of the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The Prophet (ﷺ) said, They (i.e. Hasan and Husain) are my two sweet basils in this world
62.hi: Ibn Abi Nu'm bataate hain: Ek shaks ne Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha kya ek Musalman makkhiyaan maar sakta hai. Maine unhe jawab dete suna, "Iraq ke log makkhiyon ko maarne ke baare mein puchte hain jabke unhonne khud Allah ke Rasool ki beti ke bete ko qatl kiya. Nabi ne kaha, 'Woh (yaani Hasan aur Husain) is duniya mein mere do khushboodaar phool hain (yaani chhote basil paudhe).'"

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ يَقُولُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ سَيِّدُنَا، وَأَعْتَقَ سَيِّدَنَا‏.‏ يَعْنِي بِلاَلاً‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:`Umar used to say, "Abu Bakr is our chief, and he manumitted our chief," meaning Bilal
62.hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, "Abu Bakr humare sardaar hain, aur unhonne humare sardaar ko azaad kiya," Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka zikar karte huye.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّ بِلاَلاً، قَالَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَيْتَنِي لِنَفْسِكَ فَأَمْسِكْنِي، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ إِنَّمَا اشْتَرَيْتَنِي لِلَّهِ فَدَعْنِي وَعَمَلَ اللَّهِ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Qais:Bilal said to Abu Bakr, "If you have bought me for yourself then keep me (for yourself), but if you have bought me for Allah's Sake, then leave me for Allah's Work
62.hi: Qais bataate hain: Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Abu Bakr se kaha, "Agar aapne mujhe apne liye khareeda hai, mujhe (apne liye) rakhiye, magar agar aapne mujhe Allah ke liye khareeda hai, mujhe Allah ke kaam ke liye chhod dijiye."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،، قَالَ ضَمَّنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى صَدْرِهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْهُ الْحِكْمَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) embraced me (pressed me to his chest) and said, "O Allah, teach him wisdom (i.e. the understanding of the knowledge of Qur'an)
62.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar Nabi ne mujhe gale lagaya (apne seene se lagaya) aur kaha, "Aye Allah, ise hikmat sikha (yaani Quran ke gyan ki samajh)."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، وَقَالَ، ‏ "‏ عَلِّمْهُ الْكِتَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَالْحِكْمَةُ الْإِصَابَةُ فِي غَيْرِ النُّبُوَّةِ
62.en: Narrated 'Abdul Warith: The same but said, "O Allah, teach him (Ibn Abbas) the Book (i.e. the understanding of the knowledge of Qur'an)." Narrated Khalid: As above
62.hi: Abdul Warith bataate hain: (Wahi riwaayat) magar kaha, "Aye Allah, ise (yaani Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko) Kitaab sikha (yaani Quran ke gyan ki samajh)." Khalid bataate hain: (Upar jaisa hi)

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَعَى زَيْدًا وَجَعْفَرًا وَابْنَ رَوَاحَةَ لِلنَّاسِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ خَبَرُهُمْ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَخَذَ الرَّايَةَ زَيْدٌ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ جَعْفَرٌ فَأُصِيبَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ ابْنُ رَوَاحَةَ فَأُصِيبَ ـ وَعَيْنَاهُ تَذْرِفَانِ ـ حَتَّى أَخَذَ سَيْفٌ مِنْ سُيُوفِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) had informed the people about the death of Zaid, Ja`far and Ibn Rawaha before the news of their death reached them. He said with his eyes flowing with tears, "Zaid took the flag and was martyred; then Ja`far took the flag and was martyred, and then Ibn Rawaha took the flag and was martyred. Finally the flag was taken by one of Allah's Swords (i.e. Khalid bin Al-Walid) and Allah gave them (i.e. the Muslims) victory
62.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne logon ko Zaid, Ja'far, aur Ibn Rawaha ki maut ki khabar unki maut ki khabar untak pahunchne se pahle di thi. Unhonne apni aankhon se aansu bahate huye kaha, "Zaid ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue; phir Ja'far ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue, aur phir Ibn Rawaha ne jhanda liya aur shaheed hue. Aakhirkar jhanda Allah ki ek Talwaron mein se ek (yaani Khalid bin Al-Walid) ne uthaya aur Allah ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) fatah di."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ ذُكِرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، فَقَالَ ذَاكَ رَجُلٌ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اسْتَقْرِئُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فَبَدَأَ بِهِ، وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي بَدَأَ بِأُبَىٍّ أَوْ بِمُعَاذٍ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Masruq:`Abdullah (bin Mas`ud) was mentioned before `Abdullah bin `Amr. The latter said, "That is a man I continue to love because I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, ' Learn the recitation of the Qur'an from (any of these) four persons: `Abdullah bin Masud, Salim the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai bin Ka`b, and Mu`adh bin Jabal." I do not remember whether he mentioned Ubai first or Mu`adh
62.hi: Masruq bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Mas'ud) ka zikar Abdullah bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke saamne hua. Unhone kaha, "Yeh woh shaks hai jinse main hamesha mohabbat karta hoon kyunke maine Allah ke Rasool ko kehte suna, 'In chaar logon mein se (kisi bhi ek se) Quran padhna seekho: Abdullah bin Masud, Salim (Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam), Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ).'" Mujhe yaad nahi kya unhonne pahle Ubai ka naam liya ya Mu'adh ka.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَسْرُوقًا، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ فَاحِشًا وَلاَ مُتَفَحِّشًا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَىَّ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَقْرِئُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) neither talked in an insulting manner nor did he ever speak evil intentionally. He used to say, "The most beloved to me amongst you is the one who has the best character and manners." He added, " Learn the Qur'an from (any of these) four persons. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud, Salim the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai bin Ka`b, and Mu`adh bin Jabal
62.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Amr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool na to apmaanjanak tarike se baat karte the na hi jaanboojhkar buri baat kahte the. Woh kaha karte the, "Tum mein mujhe sabse zyada pyara woh hai jinke adab aur charitra sabse behtar hain." Unhone joda, "Quran chaar logon mein se (kisi ek se) sikho: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ), Salim (Abu Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke azaad kiye gulaam), Ubai bin Ka'b (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ)."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، دَخَلْتُ الشَّأْمَ فَصَلَّيْتُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَقُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي جَلِيسًا‏.‏ فَرَأَيْتُ شَيْخًا مُقْبِلاً، فَلَمَّا دَنَا قُلْتُ أَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ اسْتَجَابَ‏.‏ قَالَ مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ قُلْتُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَفَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيكُمْ صَاحِبُ النَّعْلَيْنِ وَالْوِسَادِ وَالْمِطْهَرَةِ أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيكُمُ الَّذِي أُجِيرَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيكُمْ صَاحِبُ السِّرِّ الَّذِي لاَ يَعْلَمُهُ غَيْرُهُ كَيْفَ قَرَأَ ابْنُ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ‏}‏ فَقَرَأْتُ ‏{‏وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى * وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى * وَالذَّكَرِ وَالأُنْثَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَقْرَأَنِيهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاهُ إِلَى فِيَّ، فَمَا زَالَ هَؤُلاَءِ حَتَّى كَادُوا يَرُدُّونِي‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Alqama:I went to Sham and was offering a two-rak`at prayer; I said, "O Allah! Bless me with a (pious) companion." Then I saw an old man coming towards me, and when he came near I said, (to myself), "I hope Allah has given me my request." The man asked (me), "Where are you from?" I replied, "I am from the people of Kufa." He said, "Weren't there amongst you the Carrier of the (Prophet's) shoes, Siwak and the ablution water container? Weren't there amongst you the man who was given Allah's Refuge from the Satan? And weren't there amongst you the man who used to keep the (Prophet's) secrets which nobody else knew? How did Ibn Um `Abd (i.e. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud) use to recite Surat-al-lail (the Night:92)?" I recited:-- "By the Night as it envelops By the Day as it appears in brightness. And by male and female." (92.1- 3) On that, Abu Darda said, "By Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) made me read the Verse in this way after listening to him, but these people (of Sham) tried their best to let me say something different
62.hi: Alqama bataate hain: Main Sham gaya aur do rakat namaz padh raha tha; maine kaha, "Aye Allah! Mujhe ek (pakbaz) sathi se nawaza." Phir maine ek budha shaks mere paas aate dekha, aur jab woh qareeb aaye maine (khud se) kaha, "Mujhe ummeed hai Allah ne meri guzarish qubool kar li." Us shaks ne (mujhse) pucha, "Tum kahaan se ho?" Maine jawab diya, "Main Kufa ke logon mein se hoon." Unhone kaha, "Kya tum mein woh (Nabi ke) joote, Siwaak, aur wudu ke paani ka bartan uthane wale nahi the? Kya tum mein woh shaks nahi tha jise Allah ki panah di gaee thi Shaitan se? Aur kya tum mein woh shaks nahi tha jo (Nabi ke) raaz rakhta tha jo koi aur nahi jaanta tha? Ibn Um Abd (yaani Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ)) Surat-al-Lail (yaani Raat, 92) kaise padhte the?" Maine padha: "Raat ki qasam jab woh chhaa jaati hai, Din ki qasam jab woh roshan hoti hai, Aur (uski qasam) jisne nar aur maada banaaye." (92:1-3) Isspar, Abu Darda ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, Nabi ne mujhe isi tarah yeh Ayat padhwaee, unhe sunne ke baad, magar yeh log (Sham ke) meri poori koshish ki mujhe kuch aur kahne ke liye majboor karne ki."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ،، قَالَ سَأَلْنَا حُذَيْفَةَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، قَرِيبِ السَّمْتِ وَالْهَدْىِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى نَأْخُذَ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ مَا أَعْرِفُ أَحَدًا أَقْرَبَ سَمْتًا وَهَدْيًا وَدَلاًّ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:We asked Hudhaifa to tell us of a person resembling (to some extent) the Prophet (ﷺ) in good appearance and straight forward behavior so that we may learn from him (good manners and acceptable conduct). Hudhaifa replied, "I do not know anybody resembling the Prophet (to some extent) in appearance and conduct more than Ibn Um `Abd
62.hi: Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid bataate hain: Humne Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha ke woh humein aise kisi shaks ke baare mein bataen jo (kuch had tak) Nabi jaise achhe soorat aur seedhi soch mein milte-julte hon, taake hum unse (achhe adab aur qubool karne laayak vyavhaar) seekh saken. Hudhaifa ne jawab diya, "Mujhe koi bhi shaks Nabi jaise soorat aur vyavhaar mein Ibn Um Abd se zyada milta-julta nahi lagta."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَدِمْتُ أَنَا وَأَخِي مِنَ الْيَمَنِ، فَمَكُثْنَا حِينًا مَا نُرَى إِلاَّ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، لِمَا نَرَى مِنْ دُخُولِهِ وَدُخُولِ أُمِّهِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:My brother and I came from Yemen, and for some time we continued to consider `Abdullah bin Mas`ud as one of the members of the family of the Prophet (ﷺ) because we used to see him and his mother going in the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) very often
62.hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Mera bhai aur main Yemen se aaye, aur kuch waqt tak hum Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mas'ud (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Nabi ke pariwara ka ek sadasya samajhte rahe kyunke hum unhe aur unki maa ko Nabi ke ghar bahut baar jate dekhte the.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَافَى، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ أَوْتَرَ مُعَاوِيَةُ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَعِنْدَهُ مَوْلًى لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فَأَتَى ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ دَعْهُ، فَإِنَّهُ صَحِبَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn Abu Mulaika:Muawiya offered one rak`a witr prayer after the `Isha prayer, and at that time a freed slave of Ibn `Abbas was present. He (i.e. the slave) went to Ibn `Abbas (and told him that Muawiya offered one rak`a witr prayer). Ibn `Abbas said, "Leave him, for he was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
62.hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Isha ki namaz ke baad ek rakat Witr padhi, aur us waqt Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek azaad kiya gulaam wahaan maujood tha. Woh (yaani gulaam) Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya (aur unhe bataya ke Muawiya ne ek rakat Witr padhi). Ibn Abbas ne kaha, "Unhe chhod do, kyunke woh Allah ke Rasool ki sohbat mein rahe hain."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قِيلَ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ هَلْ لَكَ فِي أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ مَا أَوْتَرَ إِلاَّ بِوَاحِدَةٍ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهُ فَقِيهٌ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:Somebody said to Ibn `Abbas, "Can you speak to the chief of the believers Mu`awiyah, as he does not pray except one rak`a as witr?" Ibn `Abbas replied, "He is a Faqih (i.e. a learned man who can give religious verdicts)
62.hi: Ibn Abu Mulaika bataate hain: Kisi ne Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Kya aap mominon ke Ameer Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) se baat kar sakte hain, kyunke woh sirf ek rakat Witr padhte hain?" Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya, "Woh ek Faqih hain (yaani ek ilm waala shaks jo deeni faisle de sakte hain)."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُمْرَانَ بْنَ أَبَانَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ لَتُصَلُّونَ صَلاَةً لَقَدْ صَحِبْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا رَأَيْنَاهُ يُصَلِّيهَا، وَلَقَدْ نَهَى عَنْهُمَا، يَعْنِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Humran bin Aban:Muawiya said (to the people), "You offer a prayer which we, who were the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering, and he forbade its offering," i.e. the two rak`at after the compulsory `Asr prayer
62.hi: Humran bin Aban bataate hain: Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne (logon se) kaha, "Tum ek namaz padhte ho jo hum, jo Nabi ke sahaba the, kabhi Nabi ko padhte nahi dekha, aur unhone ise padhna mana kiya," yaani Farz Asr ki namaz ke baad ki do rakat.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَاطِمَةُ بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي، فَمَنْ أَغْضَبَهَا أَغْضَبَنِي ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Fatima is a part of me, and whoever makes her angry, makes me angry
62.hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) mera ek hissa hai, aur jo bhi unhe naraaj karta hai, mujhe naraaj karta hai."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ إِنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَ، هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ يُقْرِئُكِ السَّلاَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، تَرَى مَا لاَ أَرَى‏.‏ تُرِيدُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha said, "Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to me), 'O Aish (`Aisha)! This is Gabriel greeting you.' I said, 'Peace and Allah's Mercy and Blessings be on him, you see what I don't see' " She was addressing Allah's Apostle
62.hi: Abu Salama bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Ek baar Allah ke Rasool ne (mujhse) kaha, 'Aye Aish (Ayesha)! Yeh Jibreel hain jo tumhe salaam kah rahe hain.' Maine kaha, 'Unpar shaanti aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkaten hon; aap woh dekhte hain jo main nahi dekhti.'" Woh Allah ke Rasool se mukhatib ho rahi thi.

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَمَلَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ كَثِيرٌ، وَلَمْ يَكْمُلْ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ مَرْيَمُ بِنْتُ عِمْرَانَ، وَآسِيَةُ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ، وَفَضْلُ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Many amongst men attained perfection but amongst women none attained the perfection except Mary, the daughter of `Imran and Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh. And the superiority of `Aisha to other women is like the superiority of Tharid (i.e. an Arabic dish) to other meals
62.hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Ash'ari bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Bahut se mard purnata tak pahunche, magar aurton mein koi bhi purnata tak nahi pahunchi siwaye Maryam, Imran ki beti, aur Asiya, Firaun ki biwi ke. Aur Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri aurton par superiority aisi hai jaisa Tharid (yaani ek Arbi vyanjan) doosre khaanon par."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ فَضْلُ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The superiority of `Aisha over other women is like the superiority of Tharid to other meals
62.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki doosri aurton par superiority aisi hai jaisa Tharid ki doosre khaanon par."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، اشْتَكَتْ، فَجَاءَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، تَقْدَمِينَ عَلَى فَرَطِ صِدْقٍ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Al-Qasim bin Muhammad:Once `Aisha became sick and Ibn `Abbas went to see her and said, "O mother of the believers! You are leaving for truthful fore-runners i.e. for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr
62.hi: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad bataate hain: Ek baar Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bimar pada aur Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) unse milne gaye aur kaha, "Aye mominon ki maa! Aap sachche pathpradarshkon ke paas ja rahi hain, yaani Allah ke Rasool aur Abu Bakr ke paas."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا بَعَثَ عَلِيٌّ عَمَّارًا وَالْحَسَنَ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ لِيَسْتَنْفِرَهُمْ خَطَبَ عَمَّارٌ فَقَالَ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ أَنَّهَا زَوْجَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ ابْتَلاَكُمْ لِتَتَّبِعُوهُ أَوْ إِيَّاهَا‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Abu Wail:When `Ali sent `Ammar and Al-Hasan to (the people of) Kufa to urge them to fight, `Ammar addressed them saying, "I know that she (i.e. `Aisha) is the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) in this world and in the Hereafter (world to come), but Allah has put you to test, whether you will follow Him (i.e. Allah) or her
62.hi: Abu Wail bataate hain: Jab Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Ammar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Al-Hasan ko Kufa ke logon ke paas bheja unhe jung ke liye taiyaar karne, Ammar ne unse khitaab karte huye kaha, "Mujhe pata hai ke woh (yaani Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا)) is duniya aur Aakhirat mein Nabi ki biwi hain, magar Allah ne tumhein aazmane ke liye rakha hai, kya tum Us (yaani Allah) ki pairvi karoge ya unki."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها أَنَّهَا اسْتَعَارَتْ مِنْ أَسْمَاءَ قِلاَدَةً فَهَلَكَتْ، فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِي طَلَبِهَا، فَأَدْرَكَتْهُمُ الصَّلاَةُ، فَصَلَّوْا بِغَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ، فَلَمَّا أَتَوُا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَكَوْا ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ، فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ التَّيَمُّمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ جَزَاكِ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا نَزَلَ بِكِ أَمْرٌ قَطُّ إِلاَّ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكِ مِنْهُ مَخْرَجًا، وَجَعَلَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ بَرَكَةً‏.‏
62.en: Narrated `Aisha:That she borrowed a necklace from Asma' and it was lost. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some of his companions to look for it. During their journey the time of prayer was due and they prayed without ablution. When they returned to the Prophet (ﷺ) they complained about it. So the Divine Verse of Tayammum was revealed. Usaid bin Hudair said (to `Aisha), "May Allah reward you handsomely. By Allah, whenever you have a difficulty, Allah took you out of it and brought with it, a Blessing for the Muslims
62.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Unhone Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) se ek haar udhaar liya jo kho gaya. Allah ke Rasool ne apne kuch sahaba ko use dhoondne bheja. Unki safar ke dauran, namaz ka waqt aa gaya aur unhonne bina wudu ke namaz padhi. Jab woh Nabi ke paas wapas aaye, unhonne iski shikaayat ki. Isliye Tayammum ki Divine Ayat naazil hui. Usaid bin Hudair ne (Ayesha se) kaha, "Allah aapko behtareen ajr de. Allah ki qasam, jab bhi aapko koi mushkil hoti hai, Allah aapko usse nikal deta hai aur uske saath, Musalmanon ke liye ek barkat lata hai."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا كَانَ فِي مَرَضِهِ، جَعَلَ يَدُورُ فِي نِسَائِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ أَنَا غَدًا أَيْنَ أَنَا غَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ حِرْصًا عَلَى بَيْتِ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمِي سَكَنَ‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Hisham's father:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in his fatal illness, he started visiting his wives and saying, "Where will I be tomorrow?" He was anxious to be in `Aisha's home. `Aisha said, "So when it was my day, the Prophet became silent (no longer asked the question)
62.hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool apni aakhri bimari mein the, woh apni biwiyon se milne jate aur puchte, "Kal main kahaan hoonga?" Woh Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein hone ke liye betaab the. Ayesha ne kaha, "Isliye jab mera din aaya, Nabi khaamosh ho gaye (aur unhone phir yeh sawal nahi pucha)."

62.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،، قَالَ كَانَ النَّاسُ يَتَحَرَّوْنَ بِهَدَايَاهُمْ يَوْمَ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَاجْتَمَعَ صَوَاحِبِي إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، فَقُلْنَ يَا أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَتَحَرَّوْنَ بِهَدَايَاهُمْ يَوْمَ عَائِشَةَ، وَإِنَّا نُرِيدُ الْخَيْرَ كَمَا تُرِيدُهُ عَائِشَةُ، فَمُرِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَأْمُرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يُهْدُوا إِلَيْهِ حَيْثُ مَا كَانَ أَوْ حَيْثُ مَا دَارَ، قَالَتْ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنِّي، فَلَمَّا عَادَ إِلَىَّ ذَكَرْتُ لَهُ ذَاكَ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنِّي، فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ذَكَرْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ لاَ تُؤْذِينِي فِي عَائِشَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا نَزَلَ عَلَىَّ الْوَحْىُ وَأَنَا فِي لِحَافِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْكُنَّ غَيْرِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
62.en: Narrated Hisham's father:The people used to send presents to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of `Aisha's turn. `Aisha said, "My companions (i.e. the other wives of the Prophet) gathered in the house of Um Salama and said, "O Um Salama! By Allah, the people choose to send presents on the day of `Aisha's turn and we too, love the good (i.e. presents etc.) as `Aisha does. You should tell Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to tell the people to send their presents to him wherever he may be, or wherever his turn may be." Um Salama said that to the Prophet and he turned away from her, and when the Prophet (ﷺ) returned to her (i.e. Um Salama), she repeated the same, and the Prophet (ﷺ) again turned away, and when she told him the same for the third time, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Um Salama! Don't trouble me by harming `Aisha, for by Allah, the Divine Inspiration never came to me while I was under the blanket of any woman amongst you except her
62.hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Log Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki baari ke din Nabi ko tohfe bhejte the. Ayesha ne kaha, "Meri sathiyaan (yaani Nabi ki doosri biwiyaan) Um Salama (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke ghar mein jama hui aur kaha, 'Aye Um Salama! Allah ki qasam, log Ayesha ki baari ke din tohfe bhejna chunte hain, aur hum bhi achhi cheezen (yaani tohfe) pasand karte hain jaise Ayesha karti hain. Aapko Allah ke Rasool ko yeh kehna chahiye ke woh logon ko bataen apne tohfe unhe bhejne chahiye chahe woh kahin bhi hon, ya unki jo bhi baari ho.'" Um Salama ne yeh Nabi ko bataya aur woh unse mude, aur jab Nabi unke (yaani Um Salama ke) paas wapas aaye, unhonne phir wahi kaha, aur Nabi phir mude, aur jab unhonne teesri baar unse yeh kaha, Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Um Salama! Mujhe Ayesha ko dukh dekar pareshaan mat karo, kyunke Allah ki qasam, Divine Ilham mujhe kabhi nahi mila jabke main tum mein se kisi ke bhi kambal ke neeche tha siwaye unke (yaani Ayesha ke)."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غَيْلاَنُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ أَرَأَيْتَ اسْمَ الأَنْصَارِ كُنْتُمْ تُسَمَّوْنَ بِهِ، أَمْ سَمَّاكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ بَلْ سَمَّانَا اللَّهُ، كُنَّا نَدْخُلُ عَلَى أَنَسٍ فَيُحَدِّثُنَا مَنَاقِبَ الأَنْصَارِ وَمَشَاهِدَهُمْ، وَيُقْبِلُ عَلَىَّ أَوْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَزْدِ فَيَقُولُ فَعَلَ قَوْمُكَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Ghailan bin Jarir:I asked Anas, "Tell me about the name 'Al-Ansar.; Did you call yourselves by it or did Allah call you by it?" He said, "Allah called us by it." We used to visit Anas (at Basra) and he used to narrate to us the virtues and deeds of the Ansar, and he used to address me or a person from the tribe of Al-Azd and say, "Your tribe did so-and-so on such-and-such a day
63.hi: Ghailan bin Jarir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Mujhe bataiye 'Al-Ansaar' naam ke baare mein. Kya tumne khud ko yeh naam diya ya Allah ne tumhe is naam se pukara?" Unhone kaha, "Allah ne humein is naam se pukara." Hum Anas (Basra mein) se milne jate the aur woh humein Ansaar ke neik amal aur khoobiyon ki riwaayaten sunate the, aur woh mujhe ya Al-Azd qabile ke kisi shaks ko sambodhit karte huye kahte, "Tumhari qaum ne falaan-falaan din aisa-aisa kiya."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَوْمُ بُعَاثَ يَوْمًا قَدَّمَهُ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدِ افْتَرَقَ مَلَؤُهُمْ، وَقُتِلَتْ سَرَوَاتُهُمْ، وَجُرِّحُوا، فَقَدَّمَهُ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي دُخُولِهِمْ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated `Aisha:The day of Bu'ath (i.e. Day of fighting between the two tribes of the Ansar, the Aus and Khazraj) was brought about by Allah for the good of His Apostle so that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reached (Medina), the tribes of Medina had already divided and their chiefs had been killed and wounded. So Allah had brought about the battle for the good of H is Apostle in order that they (i.e. the Ansar) might embrace Islam
63.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Bu'ath ka din (yaani Ansaar ke do qabilon, Aus aur Khazraj, ke beech jung ka din) Allah ne apne Rasool ki bhalaee ke liye laaya, taake jab Allah ke Rasool (Madina) pahunche, Madina ke qabile pahle se hi baante hue the aur unke sardaar mare ya zakhmi ho chuke the. Isliye Allah ne apne Rasool ki bhalaee ke liye us jung ko laaya taake woh (yaani Ansaar) Islam qubool kar saken.

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ـ وَأَعْطَى قُرَيْشًا ـ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْعَجَبُ، إِنَّ سُيُوفَنَا تَقْطُرُ مِنْ دِمَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ، وَغَنَائِمُنَا تُرَدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا الأَنْصَارَ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا الَّذِي بَلَغَنِي عَنْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانُوا لاَ يَكْذِبُونَ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا هُوَ الَّذِي بَلَغَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَلاَ تَرْضَوْنَ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ النَّاسُ بِالْغَنَائِمِ إِلَى بُيُوتِهِمْ، وَتَرْجِعُونَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى بُيُوتِكُمْ لَوْ سَلَكَتِ الأَنْصَارُ وَادِيًا أَوْ شِعْبًا، لَسَلَكْتُ وَادِيَ الأَنْصَارِ أَوْ شِعْبَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Anas:On the day of the Conquest of Mecca, when the Prophet (ﷺ) had given (from the booty) to the Quraish, the Ansar said, "By Allah, this is indeed very strange: While our swords are still dribbling with the blood of Quraish, our war booty is distributed amongst them." When this news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) he called the Ansar and said, "What is this news that has reached me from you?" They used not to tell lies, so they replied, "What has reached you is true." He said, "Doesn't it please you that the people take the booty to their homes and you take Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to your homes? If the Ansar took their way through a valley or a mountain pass, I would take the Ansar's valley or a mountain pass
63.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Mecca ke din, jab Nabi ne (maal-e-ghanimat mein se) Quraish ko diya, Ansaar ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam, yeh sach mein bahut ajeeb hai: Jabke humari talwaren abhi bhi Quraish ke khoon se tapak rahi hain, humara jung ka maal unmein baanta ja raha hai." Jab yeh khabar Nabi tak pahunchi, unhone Ansaar ko bulaya aur kaha, "Yeh kya khabar hai jo mujhtak tumse pahunchi hai?" Woh jhoot nahi bolte the, isliye unhone jawab diya, "Jo aaptak pahunchi hai woh sach hai." Unhone kaha, "Kya tumhe khushi nahi hoti ke log apna maal-e-ghanimat apne gharon le jaen aur tum Allah ke Rasool ko apne gharon le jaao? Agar Ansaar kisi waadi ya pahadi raaste se guzarte, main Ansaar ki waadi ya pahadi raaste se guzarta."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ الأَنْصَارَ سَلَكُوا وَادِيًا أَوْ شِعْبًا، لَسَلَكْتُ فِي وَادِي الأَنْصَارِ، وَلَوْلاَ الْهِجْرَةُ لَكُنْتُ امْرَأً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ مَا ظَلَمَ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي، آوَوْهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ‏.‏ أَوْ كَلِمَةً أُخْرَى‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) or Abul-Qasim said, "If the Ansar took their way through a valley or a mountain pass, I would take Ansar's valley. And but for the migration, I would have been one of the Ansar." Abu Huraira used to say, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is not unjust (by saying so). May my parents be sacrificed for him, for the Ansar sheltered and helped him," or said a similar sentence
63.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ya Abul-Qasim ne kaha, "Agar Ansaar kisi waadi ya pahadi raaste se guzarte, main Ansaar ki waadi se guzarta. Aur agar hijrat na hoti, main Ansaar mein se ek hota." Abu Huraira kahte the, "Nabi na-insaafi nahi kar rahe the (yeh kahne mein). Mere maa-baap unke liye qurbaan hon, kyunke Ansaar ne unhe panah di aur unki madad ki," ya isi se milta-julta kuch kahte.

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ آخَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَسَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنِّي أَكْثَرُ الأَنْصَارِ مَالاً فَأَقْسِمُ مَالِي نِصْفَيْنِ، وَلِي امْرَأَتَانِ، فَانْظُرْ أَعْجَبَهُمَا إِلَيْكَ فَسَمِّهَا لِي أُطَلِّقْهَا، فَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا فَتَزَوَّجْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، أَيْنَ سُوقُكُمْ فَدَلُّوهُ عَلَى سُوقِ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ، فَمَا انْقَلَبَ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهُ فَضْلٌ مِنْ أَقِطٍ وَسَمْنٍ، ثُمَّ تَابَعَ الْغُدُوَّ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ يَوْمًا وَبِهِ أَثَرُ صُفْرَةٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْيَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَمْ سُقْتَ إِلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَوَاةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ‏.‏ أَوْ وَزْنَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، شَكَّ إِبْرَاهِيمُ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Sa`d's father:When the emigrants reached Medina. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) established the bond of fraternity between `Abdur-Rahman and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi. Sa`d said to `Abdur-Rahman, "I am the richest of all the Ansar, so I want to divide my property (between us), and I have two wives, so see which of the two you like and tell me, so that I may divorce her, and when she finishes her prescribed period (i.e. 'Idda) of divorce, then marry her." `Abdur-Rahman said, "May Allah bless your family and property for you; where is your market?" So they showed him the Qainuqa' market. (He went there and) returned with a profit in the form of dried yogurt and butter. He continued going (to the market) till one day he came, bearing the traces of yellow scent. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "What is this (scent)?" He replied, "I got married." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "How much Mahr did you give her?" He replied, "I gave her a datestone of gold or a gold piece equal to the weight of a date-stone." (The narrator, Ibrahim, is in doubt as to which is correct)
63.hi: Sa'd ke waalid bataate hain: Jab hijrat karne wale (yaani Muhajir) Madina pahunche, Allah ke Rasool ne Abdur-Rahman aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi ke beech bhaeechaara ka bandhan banaya. Sa'd ne Abdur-Rahman se kaha, "Main sab Ansaar mein sabse ameer hoon, isliye main apni maal taqseem karna chahta hoon (humare beech), aur meri do biwiyaan hain, isliye dekho tumhe in donon mein se kaunsi pasand hai aur mujhe batao, taake main use talaq de dun, aur jab woh apni Iddat (yaani talaq ki muddat) poori kar le, phir usse shaadi kar lena." Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Allah tumhare pariwara aur maal ko barkat de; tumhara bazaar kahaan hai?" Isliye unhone use Qainuqa bazaar dikhaya. (Woh wahaan gaye aur) munafe ke saath wapas aaye, dahi aur ghi ke soorat mein. Woh (bazaar) jate rahe jab tak ek din woh peele rang ki khushbu ke asaraat ke saath aaye. Nabi ne pucha, "Yeh (khushbu) kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Meri shaadi hui hai." Nabi ne pucha, "Tumne unhe kitna Mahr diya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maine unhe sona ki ek khajoor ki gutli jitni maatra di ya khajoor ki gutli ke wazan jitna sona diya." (Raawi Ibrahim ko shak hai kaunsa sahi hai.)

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ، وَآخَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ الْمَالِ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ قَدْ عَلِمَتِ الأَنْصَارُ أَنِّي مِنْ أَكْثَرِهَا مَالاً، سَأَقْسِمُ مَالِي بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ شَطْرَيْنِ، وَلِي امْرَأَتَانِ، فَانْظُرْ أَعْجَبَهُمَا إِلَيْكَ فَأُطَلِّقُهَا، حَتَّى إِذَا حَلَّتْ تَزَوَّجْتَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ يَوْمَئِذٍ حَتَّى أَفْضَلَ شَيْئًا مِنْ سَمْنٍ وَأَقِطٍ، فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ إِلاَّ يَسِيرًا، حَتَّى جَاءَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَيْهِ وَضَرٌ مِنْ صُفْرَةٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْيَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا سُقْتَ فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَزْنَ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، أَوْ نَوَاةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Anas:When `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf came to us, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a bond of fraternity between him and Sa`d bin Ar-Rabi` who was a rich man, Sa`d said, "The Ansar know that I am the richest of all of them, so I will divide my property into two parts between me and you, and I have two wives; see which of the two you like so that I may divorce her and you can marry her after she becomes lawful to you by her passing the prescribed period (i.e. 'Idda) of divorce. `Abdur Rahman said, "May Allah bless you your family (i.e. wives) for you." (But `Abdur-Rahman went to the market) and did not return on that day except with some gain of dried yogurt and butter. He went on trading just a few days till he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) bearing the traces of yellow scent over his clothes. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "What is this scent?" He replied, "I have married a woman from the Ansar." Allah's Apostle asked, "How much Mahr have you given?" He said, "A date-stone weight of gold or a golden date-stone." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Arrange a marriage banquet even with a sheep
63.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdur-Rahman bin Auf humare paas aaye, Allah ke Rasool ne unke aur Sa'd bin Ar-Rabi, jo ek ameer shaks the, ke beech bhaeechaara ka bandhan banaya. Sa'd ne kaha, "Ansaar jaante hain ke main unmein sabse ameer hoon, isliye main apni maal ko donon mein baantunga, tumhare aur mere beech, aur meri do biwiyaan hain; dekho tumhe in donon mein se kaunsi pasand hai taake main use talaq de dun aur tum usse shaadi kar sako jab woh apni Iddat poori karke tumhare liye jaiz ho jaaye." Abdur-Rahman ne kaha, "Allah tumhe tumhare pariwara (yaani biwiyon) ke liye barkat de." (Magar Abdur-Rahman bazaar gaye) aur us din wapas nahi aaye siwaye kuch dahi aur ghi ke munafe ke saath. Woh kuch dinon tak vyaapaar karte rahe jab tak woh Allah ke Rasool ke paas peele rang ki khushbu ke asaraat apne kapdon par lekar aaye. Allah ke Rasool ne unse pucha, "Yeh khushbu kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maine Ansaar ki ek aurat se shaadi ki hai." Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, "Tumne kitna Mahr diya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Sona ki ek khajoor-gutli ke wazan ka sona ya sone ki khajoor-gutli." Nabi ne kaha, "Ek shaadi ki dawat do, chahe ek bhed se hi ho."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَبُو هَمَّامٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ اقْسِمْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمُ النَّخْلَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَكْفُونَا الْمَئُونَةَ وَتُشْرِكُونَا فِي التَّمْرِ‏.‏ قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Ansar said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Please divide the date-palm trees between us and them (i.e. emigrants)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No." The Ansar said, "Let them (i.e. the emigrants) do the labor for us in the gardens and share the date-fruits with us." The emigrants said, "We accepted this
63.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ansaar ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Kripya khajoor ke darakhton ko humare aur unke (yaani Muhajir ke) beech baant dijiye." Nabi ne kaha, "Nahi." Ansaar ne kaha, "Unhe (yaani Muhajir ko) humare liye baagon mein mehnat karne do aur khajoor ke phal humare saath baanten." Muhajir ne kaha, "Humne ise qubool kiya."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الأَنْصَارُ لاَ يُحِبُّهُمْ إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنٌ، وَلاَ يُبْغِضُهُمْ إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ أَحَبَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ أَبْغَضَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Al-Bara:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying (or the Prophet (ﷺ) said), "None loves the Ansar but a believer, and none hates them but a hypocrite. So Allah will love him who loves them, and He will hate him who hates them
63.hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Maine Nabi ko kehte suna (ya Nabi ne kaha), "Sirf ek momin hi Ansaar se mohabbat karta hai, aur sirf ek munafik hi unse nafrat karta hai. Isliye Allah unse mohabbat karega jo unse mohabbat karta hai, aur Allah unse nafrat karega jo unse nafrat karta hai."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ آيَةُ الإِيمَانِ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ، وَآيَةُ النِّفَاقِ بُغْضُ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sign of Belief is to love the Ansar, and the sign of hypocrisy is to hate the Ansar
63.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Iman ki nishaani Ansaar se mohabbat karna hai, aur munafiqat ki nishaani Ansaar se nafrat karna hai."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النِّسَاءَ وَالصِّبْيَانَ مُقْبِلِينَ ـ قَالَ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ مِنْ عُرُسٍ ـ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُمْثِلاً، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتُمْ مِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَهَا ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw the women and children (of the Ansar) coming forward. (The sub-narrator said, "I think that Anas said, 'They were returning from a wedding party.") The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and said thrice, "By Allah! You are from the most beloved people to me
63.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne (Ansaar ki) aurton aur bachchon ko (unki taraf) aate dekha. (Doosre raawi ne kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai Anas ne kaha, 'Woh ek shaadi ki dawat se wapas aa rahe the.'") Nabi khade hue aur teen baar kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Tum mere liye sabse pyare logon mein se ho."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهَا صَبِيٌّ لَهَا، فَكَلَّمَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، إِنَّكُمْ أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَىَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once an Ansari woman, accompanied by a son of hers, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spoke to her and said twice, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, you are the most beloved people to me
63.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar ek Ansaari aurat, apne bete ke saath, Allah ke Rasool ke paas aee. Allah ke Rasool ne unse baat ki aur do baar kaha, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri zindagi hai, tum mere liye sabse pyare log ho."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ‏:‏ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ أَتْبَاعٌ، وَإِنَّا قَدِ اتَّبَعْنَاكَ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ أَتْبَاعَنَا مِنَّا‏.‏ فَدَعَا بِهِ‏.‏ فَنَمَيْتُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى‏.‏ قَالَ قَدْ زَعَمَ ذَلِكَ زَيْدٌ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Zaid bin Al-Arqam:The Ansar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Every prophet has his own followers and we have followed you. So will you invoke Allah to let our followers be considered from us (as Ansar too)?" So he invoked Allah accordingly
63.hi: Zaid bin Al-Arqam bataate hain: Ansaar ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Har Nabi ke apne pairokaar hote hain, aur humne aapki pairvi ki hai. Isliye kya aap Allah se dua karenge ke humare pairokaar bhi humein se maane jaen (yaani Ansaar ki tarah)?" Isliye unhone aisi dua ki.

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَمْزَةَ ـ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ـ قَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ أَتْبَاعًا، وَإِنَّا قَدِ اتَّبَعْنَاكَ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ أَتْبَاعَنَا مِنَّا‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَتْبَاعَهُمْ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فَذَكَرْتُهُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى‏.‏ قَالَ قَدْ زَعَمَ ذَاكَ زَيْدٌ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ أَظُنُّهُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Abu Hamza:(A man from the Ansar) The Ansar said, "Every nation has followers and (O Prophet) we have followed you, so invoke Allah to let our followers be considered from us (as Ansar like ourselves)." So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Let their followers be considered as Ansar like themselves
63.hi: Abu Hamza bataate hain (ek Ansaari shaks): Ansaar ne kaha, "Har ummat ke apne pairokaar hote hain, aur (Aye Nabi) humne aapki pairvi ki hai, isliye Allah se dua kariye ke humare pairokaar bhi humein se maane jaen (yaani Ansaar ki tarah)." Isliye Nabi ne kaha, "Aye Allah! Unke pairokaar ko unke jaisa Ansaar maana jaaye."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ بَنُو النَّجَّارِ، ثُمَّ بَنُو عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ، ثُمَّ بَنُو الْحَارِثِ بْنِ خَزْرَجٍ، ثُمَّ بَنُو سَاعِدَةَ، وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ مَا أَرَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ قَدْ فَضَّلَ عَلَيْنَا فَقِيلَ قَدْ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى كَثِيرٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، قَالَ أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا، وَقَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Abu Usaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best of the Ansar's families (homes) are those of Banu An-Najjar and then (those of) Banu `Abdul Ash-hal, then (those of) Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj and then (those of) Banu Sa`ida; nevertheless, there is good in all the families (houses) of the Ansar." On this, Sa`d (bin Ubada) said, "I see that the Prophet (ﷺ) has preferred some people to us." Somebody said (to him), "No, but he has given you superiority to many." (Hadith similar to above with a different chain)
63.hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ansaar ke sabse behtar pariwara (gharon) Banu An-Najjar hain, phir Banu Abdul Ash-hal, phir Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj, phir Banu Sa'ida; magar phir bhi, Ansaar ke sab pariwaron mein achhaee hai." Isspar Sa'd (bin Ubada) ne kaha, "Mujhe lagta hai Nabi ne kuch logon ko humari tulna mein tarjih di hai." Kisi ne (unse) kaha, "Nahi, balki unhone aapko bahut se doosron par superiority di hai." (Isi tarah ki riwaayat ek doosri chain ke saath)

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ الأَنْصَارِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ خَيْرُ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ ـ بَنُو النَّجَّارِ وَبَنُو عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ وَبَنُو الْحَارِثِ وَبَنُو سَاعِدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Abu Usaid:That he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The best of the Ansar, or the best of the Ansar families (homes) are Banu An-Najjar, Bani `Abdul Ash-hal, Banu Al-Harith and Banu Sai'da
63.hi: Abu Usaid bataate hain: Unhone Nabi ko kehte suna, "Ansaar mein sabse behtar, ya Ansaar ke pariwaron mein sabse behtar, Banu An-Najjar, Banu Abdul Ash-hal, Banu Al-Harith, aur Banu Sa'ida hain."

63.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ خَيْرَ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ دَارُ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ، ثُمَّ عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ، ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي الْحَارِثِ، ثُمَّ بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ، وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَحِقْنَا سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيَّرَ الأَنْصَارَ فَجَعَلَنَا أَخِيرًا فَأَدْرَكَ سَعْدٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، خُيِّرَ دُورُ الأَنْصَارِ فَجُعِلْنَا آخِرًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَلَيْسَ بِحَسْبِكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْخِيَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
63.en: Narrated Abu Humaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best of the Ansar families (homes) are the families (homes) of Banu An- Najjar, and then that of Banu `Abdul Ash-hal, and then that of Banu Al-Harith, and then that of Banu Saida; and there is good in all the families (homes) of the Ansar." Sa`d bin 'Ubada followed us and said, "O Abu Usaid ! Don't you see that the Prophet (ﷺ) compared the Ansar and made us the last of them in superiority? Then Sa`d met the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! In comparing the Ansar's families (homes) as to the degree of superiority, you have made us the last of them." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Isn't it sufficient that you are regarded amongst the best?
63.hi: Abu Humaid bataate hain: Nabi ne kaha, "Ansaar ke sabse behtar pariwara Banu An-Najjar hain, phir Banu Abdul Ash-hal, phir Banu Al-Harith, phir Banu Sa'ida; magar Ansaar ke sab pariwaron mein achhaee hai."
