So when they announced the news of departure, I got up and went away from the army camps, and after finishing from the call of nature, I came back to my riding animal. I touched my chest to find that my necklace which was made of Zifar beads (i.e. Yemenite beads partly black and partly white) was missing. So I returned to look for my necklace and my search for it detained me. (In the meanwhile) the people who used to carry me on my camel, came and took my howdah and put it on the back of my camel on which I used to ride, as they considered that I was in it. In those days women were light in weight for they did not get fat, and flesh did not cover their bodies in abundance as they used to eat only a little food. Those people therefore, disregarded the lightness of the howdah while lifting and carrying it; and at that time I was still a young girl. They made the camel rise and all of them left (along with it). I found my necklace after the army had gone. Then I came to their camping place to find no call maker of them, nor one who would respond to the call. So I intended to go to the place where I used to stay, thinking that they would miss me and come back to me (in my search). While I was sitting in my resting place, I was overwhelmed by sleep and slept. Safwan bin Al-Muattal As-Sulami Adh-Dhakwani was behind the army. When he reached my place in the morning, he saw the figure of a sleeping person and he recognized me on seeing me as he had seen me before the order of compulsory veiling (was prescribed). So I woke up when he recited Istirja' (i.e. "Inna li l-lahi wa inna llaihi raji'un") as soon as he recognized me. I veiled my face with my head cover at once, and by Allah, we did not speak a single word, and I did not hear him saying any word besides his Istirja'. He dismounted from his camel and made it kneel down, putting his leg on its front legs and then I got up and rode on it. Then he set out leading the camel that was carrying me till we overtook the army in the extreme heat of midday while they were at a halt (taking a rest). (Because of the event) some people brought destruction upon themselves and the one who spread the Ifk (i.e. slander) more, was `Abdullah bin Ubai Ibn Salul." (Urwa said, "The people propagated the slander and talked about it in his (i.e. `Abdullah's) presence and he confirmed it and listened to it and asked about it to let it prevail." `Urwa also added, "None was mentioned as members of the slanderous group besides (`Abdullah) except Hassan bin Thabit and Mistah bin Uthatha and Hamna bint Jahsh along with others about whom I have no knowledge, but they were a group as Allah said. It is said that the one who carried most of the slander was `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul." `Urwa added, "`Aisha disliked to have Hassan abused in her presence and she used to say, 'It was he who said: My father and his (i.e. my father's) father and my honor are all for the protection of Muhammad's honor from you."). `Aisha added, "After we returned to Medina, I became ill for a month. The people were propagating the forged statements of the slanderers while I was unaware of anything of all that, but I felt that in my present ailment, I was not receiving the same kindness from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as I used to receive when I got sick. (But now) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would only come, greet me and say,' How is that (lady)?' and leave. That roused my doubts, but I did not discover the evil (i.e. slander) till I went out after my convalescence, I went out with Um Mistah to Al-Manasi' where we used to answer the call of nature and we used not to go out (to answer the call of nature) except at night, and that was before we had latrines near our houses. And this habit of our concerning evacuating the bowels, was similar to the habits of the old 'Arabs living in the deserts, for it would be troublesome for us to take latrines near our houses. So I and Um Mistah who was the daughter of Abu Ruhm bin Al-Muttalib bin `Abd Manaf, whose mother was the daughter of Sakhr bin 'Amir and the aunt of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq and whose son was Mistah bin Uthatha bin `Abbas bin Al-Muttalib, went out. I and Um Mistah returned to my house after we finished answering the call of nature. Um Mistah stumbled by getting her foot entangled in her covering sheet and on that she said, 'Let Mistah be ruined!' I said, 'What a hard word you have said. Do you abuse a man who took part in the battle of Badr?' On that she said, 'O you Hantah! Didn't you hear what he (i.e. Mistah) said? 'I said, 'What did he say?' Then she told me the slander of the people of Ifk. So my ailment was aggravated, and when I reached my home, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me, and after greeting me, said, 'How is that (lady)?' I said, 'Will you allow me to go to my parents?' as I wanted to be sure about the news through them. Allah's Apostle allowed me (and I went to my parents) and asked my mother, 'O mother! What are the people talking about?' She said, 'O my daughter! Don't worry, for scarcely is there a charming woman who is loved by her husband and whose husband has other wives besides herself that they (i.e. women) would find faults with her.' I said, 'Subhan-Allah! (I testify the uniqueness of Allah). Are the people really talking in this way?' I kept on weeping that night till dawn I could neither stop weeping nor sleep then in the morning again, I kept on weeping. When the Divine Inspiration was delayed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called `Ali bin Abi Talib and Usama bin Zaid to ask and consult them about divorcing me. Usama bin Zaid said what he knew of my innocence, and the respect he preserved in himself for me. Usama said, '(O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!) She is your wife and we do not know anything except good about her.' `Ali bin Abi Talib said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah does not put you in difficulty and there are plenty of women other than she, yet, ask the maid-servant who will tell you the truth.' On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called Barira (i.e. the maid-servant) and said, 'O Barira! Did you ever see anything which aroused your suspicion?' Barira said to him, 'By Him Who has sent you with the Truth. I have never seen anything in her (i.e. Aisha) which I would conceal, except that she is a young girl who sleeps leaving the dough of her family exposed so that the domestic goats come and eat it.' So, on that day, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up on the pulpit and complained about `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) before his companions, saying, 'O you Muslims! Who will relieve me from that man who has hurt me with his evil statement about my family? By Allah, I know nothing except good about my family and they have blamed a man about whom I know nothing except good and he used never to enter my home except with me.' Sa`d bin Mu`adh the brother of Banu `Abd Al-Ashhal got up and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I will relieve you from him; if he is from the tribe of Al-Aus, then I will chop his head off, and if he is from our brothers, i.e. Al-Khazraj, then order us, and we will fulfill your order.' On that, a man from Al-Khazraj got up. Um Hassan, his cousin, was from his branch tribe, and he was Sa`d bin Ubada, chief of Al-Khazraj. Before this incident, he was a pious man, but his love for his tribe goaded him into saying to Sa`d (bin Mu`adh). 'By Allah, you have told a lie; you shall not and cannot kill him. If he belonged to your people, you would not wish him to be killed.' On that, Usaid bin Hudair who was the cousin of Sa`d (bin Mu`adh) got up and said to Sa`d bin 'Ubada, 'By Allah! You are a liar! We will surely kill him, and you are a hypocrite arguing on the behalf of hypocrites.' On this, the two tribes of Al-Aus and Al Khazraj got so much excited that they were about to fight while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was standing on the pulpit. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on quietening them till they became silent and so did he. All that day I kept on weeping with my tears never ceasing, and I could never sleep. In the morning my parents were with me and I wept for two nights and a day with my tears never ceasing and I could never sleep till I thought that my liver would burst from weeping. So, while my parents were sitting with me and I was weeping, an Ansari woman asked me to grant her admittance. I allowed her to come in, and when she came in, she sat down and started weeping with me. While we were in this state, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, greeted us and sat down. He had never sat with me since that day of the slander. A month had elapsed and no Divine Inspiration came to him about my case. Allah's Apostle then recited Tashah-hud and then said, 'Amma Badu, O `Aisha! I have been informed so-and-so about you; if you are innocent, then soon Allah will reveal your innocence, and if you have committed a sin, then repent to Allah and ask Him for forgiveness for when a slave confesses his sins and asks Allah for forgiveness, Allah accepts his repentance.' When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished his speech, my tears ceased flowing completely that I no longer felt a single drop of tear flowing. I said to my father, 'Reply to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my behalf concerning what he has said.' My father said, 'By Allah, I do not know what to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .' Then I said to my mother, 'Reply to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on my behalf concerning what he has said.' She said, 'By Allah, I do not know what to say to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' In spite of the fact that I was a young girl and had a little knowledge of Qur'an, I said, 'By Allah, no doubt I know that you heard this (slanderous) speech so that it has been planted in your hearts (i.e. minds) and you have taken it as a truth. Now if I tell you that I am innocent, you will not believe me, and if I confess to you about it, and Allah knows that I am innocent, you will surely believe me. By Allah, I find no similitude for me and you except that of Joseph's father when he said, '(For me) patience is the most fitting against that which you assert; it is Allah (Alone) Whose Help can be sought.' Then I turned to the other side and lay on my bed; and Allah knew then that I was innocent and hoped that Allah would reveal my innocence. But, by Allah, I never thought that Allah would reveal about my case, Divine Inspiration, that would be recited (forever) as I considered myself too unworthy to be talked of by Allah with something of my concern, but I hoped that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) might have a dream in which Allah would prove my innocence. But, by Allah, before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left his seat and before any of the household left, the Divine inspiration came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So there overtook him the same hard condition which used to overtake him, (when he used to be inspired Divinely). The sweat was dropping from his body like pearls though it was a wintry day and that was because of the weighty statement which was being revealed to him. When that state of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was over, he got up smiling, and the first word he said was, 'O `Aisha! Allah has declared your innocence!' Then my Mother said to me, 'Get up and go to him (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)). I replied, 'By Allah, I will not go to him, and I praise none but Allah. So Allah revealed the ten Verses:- - "Verily! They who spread the slander Are a gang, among you............." (24.11-20) Allah revealed those Qur'anic Verses to declare my innocence. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq who used to disburse money for Mistah bin Uthatha because of his relationship to him and his poverty, said, 'By Allah, I will never give to Mistah bin Uthatha anything after what he has said about Aisha.' Then Allah revealed:-- "And let not those among you who are good and wealthy swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kinsmen, those in need, and those who have left their homes for Allah's cause, let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful." (24.22) Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said, 'Yes, by Allah, I would like that Allah forgive me.' and went on giving Mistah the money he used to give him before. He also added, 'By Allah, I will never deprive him of it at all.' Aisha further said:." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also asked Zainab bint Jahsh (i.e. his wife) about my case. He said to Zainab, 'What do you know and what did you see?" She replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I refrain from claiming falsely that I have heard or seen anything. By Allah, I know nothing except good (about `Aisha).' From amongst the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) Zainab was my peer (in beauty and in the love she received from the Prophet) but Allah saved her from that evil because of her piety. Her sister Hamna, started struggling on her behalf and she was destroyed along with those who were destroyed. The man who was blamed said, 'Subhan-Allah! By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I have never uncovered the cover (i.e. veil) of any female.' Later on the man was martyred in Allah's Cause
64.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool ka koee safar karne ka irada hota, woh apni biwiyon ke beech qura karte, aur Allah ke Rasool apne saath use le jate jiska naam qura mein nikal aata. Unhone ek Ghazwe ke dauran humare beech qura kiya jo unhone lada. Qura mera naam nikla, isliye main Allah ke Rasool ke saath gaee uske baad jab parda (yaani hijab) ka hukum naazil ho chuka tha. Mujhe (unt par) mere Howdah mein le jaya jata aur usi mein neeche utaara jata (jab hum rukte). Isliye hum chalte rahe jab tak Allah ke Rasool apne is Ghazwe se faaragh hokar wapas aaye. Jab hum Madina ke qareeb pahunche, unhone raat ko elaan kiya ke chalne ka waqt aa gaya hai. Isliye jab unhone prasthaan ki khabar di, main uthi aur fauj ke padaavon se door chali gaee, aur qaza-e-hajat se faaragh hone ke baad, main apne sawari ke janwar ke paas wapas aee. Maine apna seena chhuya to paaya ke mera haar, jo Zifar motiyon (yaani Yemeni motiyon jo kuch kaale aur kuch safed the) ka bana tha, gaayab tha. Isliye main apna haar dhoondne wapas gaee, aur uski talaash ne mujhe roka rakha. (Isi beech) woh log jo mujhe mere unt par le jate the, aaye aur mera Howdah uthaya aur use mere unt ki peeth par rakh diya, yeh sochkar ke main usmein hoon. Un dinon aurten wazan mein halki hoti thi kyunke woh moti nahi hoti thi, aur gosht unke shareer mein bhaari matra mein nahi hota tha kyunke woh bahut kam khaana khati thi. Isliye un logon ne Howdah uthate waqt uski halki chhodkar dhyaan nahi diya; aur us waqt main abhi ek jawan ladki thi. Unhone unt ko uthaya aur sab chale gaye. Maine apna haar fauj ke jane ke baad paaya. Phir main unke padaav mein aee taaki wahaan koee pukarne wala na paee aur na koee jawab dene wala. Isliye maine wahaan jane ka irada kiya jahaan main pahle rehti thi, yeh sochte huye ke woh mujhe miss karenge aur (meri talaash mein) wapas aenge. Jabke main apni jagah baithi thi, neend ne mujhe apni chapet mein le liya aur main so gaee. Safwan bin Al-Muattal As-Sulami Adh-Dhakwani fauj ke peeche the. Jab woh subah mere paas pahunche, unhone ek sote hue insaan ka soorat dekha aur mujhe pahchan liya jab unhone mujhe dekha, kyunke unhone mujhe parda ke hukum se pahle bhi dekha tha. Isliye main jag gaee jab unhone Istirja (yaani "Inna li l-lahi wa inna llaihi raji'un") padha jaise hi unhone mujhe pahchana. Maine apna chehra apne sar ke odhne wale kapde se turant dhaank liya, aur Allah ki qasam, humne ek bhi shabd nahi bola, aur maine unhe unke Istirja ke ilawa kuch kahte nahi suna. Woh apni unt se utre aur use bithaya, apna paanv uske agle paanvon par rakhkar, phir main uthi aur uspar sawar huee. Phir woh nikle, unt ko le jate hue jo mujhe le ja rahi thi, jab tak humne fauj ko sakht dopahar ki garmi mein pakad liya jabke woh ek padaav par ruke hue the. (Is ghatna ki wajah se) kuch logon ne khud par barbaadi laee, aur Ifk (yaani jhoote ilzaam) ko sabse zyada phailane wale Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubai Ibn Salul the. (Urwa ne kaha, "Log jhoote ilzaam phaila rahe the aur uske (yaani Abdullah ke) saamne iska zikar karte the aur usne ise sahi maan liya aur use suna aur puchha taaki woh phaile.") Urwa ne yeh bhi joda, "Kisi aur ka naam is jhoote giroh ke sadasyon mein nahi liya gaya siwaye (Abdullah ke) Hassan bin Thabit, Mistah bin Uthatha, aur Hamna bint Jahsh ke, aur doosron ke saath jinke baare mein mujhe ilm nahi hai, magar woh ek giroh the jaisa Allah ne kaha. Yeh kaha jata hai ke jisne sabse zyada jhoota ilzaam phailaya woh Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul the." Urwa ne joda, "Ayesha ko Hassan ki unki maujoodgi mein buraee karna napasand tha, aur woh kahti thi, 'Yeh woh the jinhone kaha: Mere waalid aur unke (yaani mere waalid ke) waalid aur meri izzat sab Muhammad ki izzat ki tumse hifaazat ke liye hain.'" Ayesha ne joda, "Jab hum Madina wapas aaye, main ek mahine tak bimar padi. Log jhoote ilzaamon ka prasaar kar rahe the jabke mujhe iske baare mein kuch pata nahi tha, magar mujhe mahsoos hua ke mujhe apni is bimari mein Allah ke Rasool se wahi dayaaluta nahi mil rahi thi jo pahle kisi aur bimari mein milti thi. (Ab) Allah ke Rasool sirf aate, salaam kahte aur puchhte, 'Kaisi ho?' aur chale jate. Isi ne mere man mein shak paida kiya, magar mujhe us buraee ka pata nahi chala jab tak main apni recovery ke baad bahar nikli, main Um Mistah ke saath Al-Manasi gaee jahaan hum qaza-e-hajat karte the aur hum sirf raat mein hi bahar jate the, aur yeh unse pahle tha jab humare gharon ke qareeb latrine (yaani sochalay) nahi the. Aur yeh humare pet saaf karne ki aadat purane Arbon jaisi thi jo registaan mein rahte the, kyunke gharon ke qareeb latrine banana humare liye takleefdeh hota. Isliye main aur Um Mistah, jo Abu Ruhm bin Al-Muttalib bin Abd Manaf ki beti thi, jinki maa Sakhr bin Amir ki beti aur Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ki phuphi thi aur jinke bete Mistah bin Uthatha bin Abbas bin Al-Muttalib the, bahar gaye. Main aur Um Mistah apni qaza-e-hajat se faaragh hone ke baad mere ghar wapas aaye. Um Mistah apni chaadar mein apna paanv uljhne se thokar khakar girne lagi, aur ispar unhone kaha, 'Mistah barbaad ho!' Maine kaha, 'Aapne ek bahut sakht baat kahi hai. Kya aap ek aise shaks ki buraee karti hain jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya?' Ispar unhone kaha, 'Aye tum Hantah! Kya aapne nahi suna jo unhone (yaani Mistah ne) kaha?' Maine kaha, 'Unhone kya kaha?' Phir unhone mujhe logon ke jhoote ilzaam ki poori kahani sunaee. Isliye meri bimari aur badh gaee, aur jab main apne ghar pahunchi, Allah ke Rasool mere paas aaye aur salaam karke puchha, 'Kaisi ho?' Maine kaha, 'Kya aap mujhe mere maa-baap ke paas jane denge?' kyunke main unke zariye is khabar ki pushti karna chahti thi. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe ijazat di (aur main apne maa-baap ke paas gaee) aur meri maa se pucha, 'Aye Maa! Log kya baat kar rahe hain?' Unhone kaha, 'Aye meri beti! Chinta mat karo, kyunke mushkil se koee khoobsurat aurat hoti hai jise uska shohar muhabbat karta ho aur uske shohar ki uske alawa doosri biwiyaan hon, jinke baare mein woh (yaani woh doosri aurten) kamiyaan na nikalen.' Maine kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! (Main Allah ki apeksik ekta ki gawahi deti hoon). Kya log sach mein aisi baat kar rahe hain?' Main us raat subah tak roti rahi, na main rona rokna sakti thi na so pati, phir subah main phir roti rahi. Jab Divine Ilham der se aee, Allah ke Rasool ne Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Talib aur Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bulaya taaki unse mera talaq dene ke maamle mein raay len. Usama bin Zaid ne jo unhone meri begunahi ke baare mein jaante the aur mere prati apna samman zaahir kiya. Usama ne kaha, '(Ya Allah ke Rasool!) Woh aapki biwi hain aur hum unke baare mein achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaante.' Ali bin Abi Talib ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah aapko mushkil mein nahi daalega aur aapke liye unke ilawa bahut sari aurten hain, phir bhi launDi se puchiye jo aapko sach bataegi.' Ispar Allah ke Rasool ne Barira (رضی اللہ عنہا) (yaani launDi) ko bulaya aur kaha, 'Aye Barira! Kya tumne kabhi koee aisi cheez dekhi jisse tumhe shak hua?' Barira ne unse kaha, 'Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko Haqq ke saath bheja hai, maine kabhi unmein (yaani Ayesha mein) aisi koee baat nahi dekhi jise main chhupana chahoon, siwaye iske ke woh ek jawan ladki hain jo apne pariwara ka aata khula chhodkar soti hain isliye ghareloo bakriyaan aakar use kha jati hain.' Isliye, us din, Allah ke Rasool mimbar par chadhe aur apne sahaba ke saamne Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) ki shikaayat karte huye kaha, 'Aye Musalmano! Kaun mujhe us shaks se rahat dega jisne apni buri baat se mere pariwara ko dukh diya hai? Allah ki qasam, main apne pariwara ke baare mein achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaanta, aur unhone ek aise shaks par ilzaam lagaya hai jinke baare mein main achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaanta, aur woh (yaani woh shaks) kabhi mere ghar mein daakhil nahi hue siwaye mere saath ke.' Sa'd bin Mu'adh, jo Banu Abd Al-Ashhal ke bhai the, uthe aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapko usse rahat dunga; agar woh Al-Aus qabile se hain, phir main unka sar kaat dunga, aur agar woh humare bhaiyon mein se hain, yaani Al-Khazraj, phir humein hukum dijiye, aur hum aapka hukum poora karenge.' Ispar, Al-Khazraj se ek shaks uthe. Um Hassan, unki chachere behn, unki hi shaakha se thi, aur woh Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) the, Al-Khazraj ke sardaar. Is ghatna se pahle, woh ek pakbaz shaks the, magar apne qabile ke prati unki mohabbat ne unhe Sa'd (bin Mu'adh) se yeh kahne par majboor kiya, 'Allah ki qasam, tumne jhoot kaha hai; tum unhe qatl nahi kar sakoge aur na hi karoge. Agar woh tumhare logon mein se hote, tum unki maut nahi chahte.' Ispar, Usaid bin Hudair, jo Sa'd (bin Mu'adh) ke chachere bhai the, uthe aur Sa'd bin Ubada se kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Tum jhoote ho! Hum unhe zaroor qatl karenge, aur tum ek munafik ho jo munafikon ki taraf se baat kar rahe ho.' Ispar, Al-Aus aur Al-Khazraj qabile itne uttejit ho gaye ke woh jung karne hi wale the jabke Allah ke Rasool mimbar par khade the. Allah ke Rasool unhe shaant karte rahe jab tak woh khaamosh ho gaye, aur woh bhi khaamosh ho gaye. Us poore din main roti rahi, mere aansu kabhi na rukte, aur main kabhi so na saki. Subah mere maa-baap mere saath the, aur main do raaten aur ek din roti rahi, mere aansu kabhi na rukte, jab tak mujhe laga mera jigar rone se phat jaega. Isliye, jabke mere maa-baap mere saath baithe the aur main ro rahi thi, ek Ansaari aurat ne mujhse andar aane ki ijazat maangi. Maine unhe andar ane diya, aur jab woh andar aee, woh baith gaee aur mere saath rone lagi. Isi haalat mein, Allah ke Rasool aaye, humein salaam kiya, aur baith gaye. Woh us jhoote ilzaam ke din se mere saath kabhi nahi baithe the. Ek mahina guzar chuka tha aur unpar mere maamle ke baare mein koee Divine Ilham naazil nahi hua tha. Allah ke Rasool ne phir Tashah-hud padha aur kaha, 'Amma Ba'du, Aye Ayesha! Mujhe aapke baare mein aisa-aisa bataya gaya hai; agar aap begunah hain, phir jald hi Allah aapki begunahi zaahir karega, aur agar aapne koee gunah kiya hai, phir Allah se tauba kariye aur usse maafi maangiye, kyunke jab ek banda apne gunahon ka iqraar karta hai aur Allah se maafi maangta hai, Allah uski tauba qubool karta hai.' Jab Allah ke Rasool ne apni baat khatm ki, mere aansu poori tarah behna band ho gaye, itna ke mujhe ek bhi bund tapakte mahsoos nahi huee. Maine apne waalid se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool ko mere taraf se jawab dijiye jo unhone kaha hai.' Mere waalid ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool ko kya kahun.' Phir maine apni maa se kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool ko mere taraf se jawab dijiye jo unhone kaha hai.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool ko kya kahun.' Chahe main ek jawan ladki thi aur mujhe Quran ka thoda hi ilm tha, maine kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, mujhe pata hai aapne yeh (buraee bhara) baat sun li hai isi tarah ke woh aapke dilon (yaani manon) mein bas gaee hai aur aapne use sach maan liya hai. Ab agar main aapko bataun ke main begunah hoon, aap mujhpar vishwas nahi karenge, aur agar main aapke saamne iska iqraar karun, aur Allah jaanta hai main begunah hoon, aap zaroor mujhpar vishwas karenge. Allah ki qasam, mujhe apne aur aapke liye Yusuf ke waalid ke ilawa koee misaal nahi milti jab unhone kaha, "(Mere liye) sabr karna hi behtar hai us cheez ke khilaf jo tum daava karte ho; sirf Allah (akele) hai jiski Madad maangi ja sakti hai."' Phir main doosri taraf mudi aur apni bistar par let gaee; aur Allah ko pata tha main begunah hoon, aur mujhe ummeed thi ke Allah meri begunahi zaahir karega. Magar, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi nahi socha ke Allah mere maamle ke baare mein aisa Divine Ilham bhejega jo (hamesha) padha jaayega, kyunke main khud ko itna gair-mahatvapurna maanti thi ke Allah mere baare mein kuch kahega, magar mujhe ummeed thi ke Allah ke Rasool ko ek khwab aayega jismein Allah meri begunahi saabit karega. Magar, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool ke apni jagah chhodne se pahle aur pariwara ke kisi sadasya ke jane se pahle, Divine Ilham Allah ke Rasool tak pahunch gaya. Isliye unhe wahi difficult haalat aee jo unhe Divine Ilham ane ke waqt aati thi. Unke shareer se paseena tapakne laga motiyon ki tarah chahe woh sardi ka din tha, aur yeh usse mahatvapurna baat ki wajah se tha jo unpar naazil ho rahi thi. Jab Allah ke Rasool ki yeh haalat khatm huee, woh muskurate hue uthe, aur unka pahla shabd tha, 'Aye Ayesha! Allah ne aapki begunahi ka elaan kiya hai!' Phir meri maa ne mujhse kaha, 'Utho aur unke (yaani Allah ke Rasool ke) paas jao.' Maine jawab diya, 'Allah ki qasam, main unke paas nahi jaunga, aur main sirf Allah ki taarif karta hoon.' Isliye Allah ne das Ayaten naazil ki: 'Sach mein, jinhone yeh jhoota ilzaam phailaya hai, ve tum hi mein se ek giroh hain...' (24:11-20) Allah ne yeh Quranic Ayaten meri begunahi zaahir karne ke liye naazil ki. Abu Bakr As-Siddiq jo Mistah bin Uthatha ke liye paisa kharch karte the unke rishte aur gareebi ki wajah se, ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, main Mistah bin Uthatha ko kabhi kuch nahi dunga uske jo kuch unhone Ayesha ke baare mein kaha uske baad.' Phir Allah ne naazil kiya: 'Aur tum mein se jo samarth aur daulatmand hain unhe qasam nahi khaani chahiye (kisi madad na dene ki) apne rishtedaron, gareebon, aur unke jinhone Allah ki khaatir apne ghar chhode hain, unhe maaf karna aur kshama karna chahiye. Kya aap yeh pasand nahi karte ke Allah aapko maaf kare? Aur Allah bahut zyada Kshamashil, Rehmaan hai.' (24:22) Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ne kaha, 'Haan, Allah ki qasam, mujhe achha lagega agar Allah mujhe maaf kare.' aur unhone phir Mistah ko woh paisa dena shuru kiya jo woh pahle dete the. Unhone yeh bhi joda, 'Allah ki qasam, main unhe kabhi isse vanchit nahi karunga.' Ayesha ne aage kaha: Allah ke Rasool ne Zainab (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Jahsh (رضی اللہ عنہا) (yaani apni biwi) se bhi mere maamle ke baare mein pucha. Unhone Zainab se kaha, 'Aapko kya pata hai aur aapne kya dekha?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main jhoote daave se bachti hoon ke maine kuch suna ya dekha hai. Allah ki qasam, main achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaanti (Ayesha ke baare mein).' Nabi ki biwiyon mein se, Zainab meri barabar thi (khoobsurati mein aur unko milne wali mohabbat mein), magar Allah ne unhe us buraee se apni pakbaazi ki wajah se bacha liya. Unki behn, Hamna, unke liye jhagda karne lagi, aur woh barbaad hue logon ke saath barbaad hue. Jinke baare mein ilzaam lagaya gaya tha, unhone kaha, 'Subhan-Allah! Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein meri jaan hai, maine kabhi kisi aurat ka parda nahi khola.' Baad mein woh shaks Allah ki raah mein shaheed hue.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَمْلَى عَلَىَّ هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ مِنْ حِفْظِهِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ أَبَلَغَكَ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا، كَانَ فِيمَنْ قَذَفَ عَائِشَةَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ قَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي رَجُلاَنِ مِنْ قَوْمِكِ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَهُمَا كَانَ عَلِيٌّ مُسَلِّمًا فِي شَأْنِهَا‏.‏ فَرَاجَعُوهُ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ وَقَالَ مُسَلِّمًا بِلَا شَكٍّ فِيهِ وَعَلَيْهِ كَانَ فِي أَصْلِ الْعَتِيقِ كَذَلِكَ
64.en: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Al-Walid bin `Abdul Malik said to me, "Have you heard that `Ali' was one of those who slandered `Aisha?" I replied, "No, but two men from your people (named) Abu Salama bin `Abdur-Rahman and Abu Bakr bin `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith have informed me that Aisha told them that `Ali remained silent about her case
64.hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Al-Walid bin Abdul Malik ne mujhse kaha, "Kya tumne suna hai ke Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) (bin Abi Talib) unmein the jinhone Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) par ilzaam lagaya?" Maine jawab diya, "Nahi, magar aapke logon mein se do log, Abu Salama bin Abdur-Rahman aur Abu Bakr bin Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Harith, ne mujhe bataya ke Ayesha ne unse kaha ke Ali unke maamle mein khaamosh rahe."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَسْرُوقُ بْنُ الأَجْدَعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ رُومَانَ ـ وَهْىَ أُمُّ عَائِشَةَ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ بَيْنَا أَنَا قَاعِدَةٌ أَنَا وَعَائِشَةُ إِذْ وَلَجَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَتْ فَعَلَ اللَّهُ بِفُلاَنٍ وَفَعَلَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ رُومَانَ وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَتْ ابْنِي فِيمَنْ حَدَّثَ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَتْ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ سَمِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَخَرَّتْ مَغْشِيًّا عَلَيْهَا، فَمَا أَفَاقَتْ إِلاَّ وَعَلَيْهَا حُمَّى بِنَافِضٍ، فَطَرَحْتُ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابَهَا فَغَطَّيْتُهَا‏.‏ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخَذَتْهَا الْحُمَّى بِنَافِضٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلَعَلَّ فِي حَدِيثٍ تُحُدِّثَ بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَعَدَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ حَلَفْتُ لاَ تُصَدِّقُونِي، وَلَئِنْ قُلْتُ لاَ تَعْذِرُونِي، مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ كَيَعْقُوبَ وَبَنِيهِ، وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ، قَالَتْ وَانْصَرَفَ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ شَيْئًا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عُذْرَهَا ـ قَالَتْ ـ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ لاَ بِحَمْدِ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ بِحَمْدِكَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Masruq bin Al-Ajda:Um Ruman, the mother of `Aisha said that while `Aisha and she were sitting, an Ansari woman came and said, "May Allah harm such and-such a person!" Um Ruman said to her, What is the matter?" She replied, "My son was amongst those who talked of the story (of the Slander)." Um Ruman said, "What is that?" She said, "So-and-so..." and narrated the whole story. On that `Aisha said, "Did Allah's Apostle hear about that?" She replied, "Yes." `Aisha further said, "And Abu Bakr too?" She replied, "Yes." On that, `Aisha fell down fainting, and when she came to her senses, she had got fever with rigors. I put her clothes over her and covered her. The Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked, "What is wrong with this (lady)?" Um Ruman replied, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She (i.e. `Aisha) has got temperature with rigors." He said, "Perhaps it is because of the story that has been talked about?" She said, "Yes." `Aisha sat up and said, "By Allah, if I took an oath (that I am innocent), you would not believe me, and if I said (that I am not innocent), you would not excuse me. My and your example is like that of Jacob and his sons (as Jacob said ): 'It is Allah (Alone) Whose Help can be sought against that you assert.' Um Ruman said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) then went out saying nothing. Then Allah declared her innocence. On that, `Aisha said (to the Prophet), "I thank Allah only; thank neither anybody else nor you
64.hi: Masruq bin Al-Ajda bataate hain: Um Ruman, Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ki maa, ne kaha ke jabke Ayesha aur woh baithi thi, ek Ansaari aurat aee aur boli, "Allah aise-aise shaks ko nuksaan pahunchae!" Um Ruman ne unse kaha, "Kya baat hai?" Unhone jawab diya, "Mera beta un logon mein tha jinhone us kahani (yaani jhoote ilzaam) ke baare mein baat ki." Um Ruman ne pucha, "Woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Falaan-falaan..." aur poori kahani sunaee. Ispar Ayesha ne kaha, "Kya Allah ke Rasool ne iske baare mein suna?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan." Ayesha ne phir pucha, "Aur Abu Bakr bhi?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan." Ispar, Ayesha behosh hokar gir gaee, aur jab unhe hosh aaya, unhe thand wale bukhaar ke saath bukhaar aa gaya. Maine unke kapde unke oopar daale aur unhe dhaanka. Nabi aaye aur pucha, "Ise (yaani Ayesha ko) kya hua hai?" Um Ruman ne jawab diya, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe (yaani Ayesha ko) thand wale bukhaar ke saath bukhaar aa gaya hai." Unhone kaha, "Shaayad yeh us kahani ki wajah se hai jo baat ki ja rahi hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Ayesha uth baithi aur kaha, "Allah ki qasam, agar main qasam khaun (ke main begunah hoon), aap mujhpar vishwas nahi karenge, aur agar main (kahun ke main begunah nahi hoon), aap mujhe maaf nahi karenge. Meri aur aapki misaal Yaqoob aur unke beton jaisi hai (jaisa Yaqoob ne kaha): 'Sirf Allah (akele) hai jiski Madad maangi ja sakti hai us cheez ke khilaf jo tum daava karte ho.'" Um Ruman ne kaha, "Nabi phir kuch kahe bina bahar gaye. Phir Allah ne unki begunahi ka elaan kiya." Ispar, Ayesha ne (Nabi se) kaha, "Main sirf Allah ka shukriya ada karti hoon; na kisi aur ka na aapka."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ كَانَتْ تَقْرَأُ ‏{‏إِذْ تَلِقُونَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ‏}‏ وَتَقُولُ الْوَلْقُ الْكَذِبُ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ وَكَانَتْ أَعْلَمَ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا بِذَلِكَ لأَنَّهُ نَزَلَ فِيهَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika:`Aisha used to recite this Verse:-- 'Ida taliqunahu bi-alsinatikum' (24.15) "(As you tell lie with your tongues.)" and used to say "Al-Walaq" means "telling of a lie. "She knew this Verse more than anybody else as it was revealed about her
64.hi: Ibn Abi Mulaika bataate hain: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) yeh Ayat padha karti thi: "Ida taliqunahu bi-alsinatikum" (24:15) (yaani jab tum apni zubanon se jhoot bolte ho), aur woh kahti thi ke "Al-Walaq" ka matlab hai "jhoot bolna." Woh is Ayat ko kisi se zyada achhi tarah jaanti thi kyunke yeh unke baare mein naazil huee thi.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ أَسُبُّ حَسَّانَ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَسُبَّهُ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُنَافِحُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ اسْتَأْذَنَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هِجَاءِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَيْفَ بِنَسَبِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لأَسُلَّنَّكَ مِنْهُمْ كَمَا تُسَلُّ الشَّعْرَةُ مِنَ الْعَجِينِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ فَرْقَدٍ، سَمِعْتُ هِشَامًا، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَبَبْتُ حَسَّانَ، وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ كَثَّرَ عَلَيْهَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Hisham's father:I started abusing Hassan in front of `Aisha. She said, "Do not abuse him as he used to defend Allah's Apostle (against the infidels). `Aisha added, "Once Hassan took the permission from the Prophet (ﷺ) to say poetic verses against the infidels. On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'How will you exclude my forefathers (from that)? Hassan replied, 'I will take you out of them as one takes a hair out of the dough." Hisham's father added, "I abused Hassan as he was one of those who spoke against `Aisha
64.hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke saamne Hassan ki buraee karna shuru kiya. Unhone kaha, "Unki buraee mat karo, kyunke woh Allah ke Rasool ki (kaafiron ke khilaf) hifaazat karte the." Ayesha ne joda, "Ek baar Hassan ne Nabi se kaafiron ke khilaf kavita likhne ki ijazat maangi. Ispar Nabi ne kaha, 'Tum mere purvajon ko kaise bahar rakhoge (is kavita se)?' Hassan ne jawab diya, 'Main aapko unme se aise nikaalunga jaise aate se ek baal nikala jata hai.'" Hisham ke waalid ne joda, "Maine Hassan ki buraee ki kyunke woh un logon mein se the jinhone Ayesha ke khilaf baat ki thi."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ وَعِنْدَهَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ يُنْشِدُهَا شِعْرًا، يُشَبِّبُ بِأَبْيَاتٍ لَهُ وَقَالَ: حَصَانٌ رَزَانٌ مَا تُزَنُّ بِرِيبَةٍ وَتُصْبِحُ غَرْثَى مِنْ لُحُومِ الْغَوَافِلِ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ عَائِشَةُ لَكِنَّكَ لَسْتَ كَذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا لِمَ تَأْذَنِينَ لَهُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ عَلَيْكِ‏.‏ وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ‏}‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ وَأَىُّ عَذَابٍ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْعَمَى‏.‏ قَالَتْ لَهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُنَافِحُ ـ أَوْ يُهَاجِي ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Masruq:We went to `Aisha while Hassan bin Thabit was with her reciting poetry to her from some of his poetic verses, saying "A chaste wise lady about whom nobody can have suspicion. She gets up with an empty stomach because she never eats the flesh of indiscreet (ladies)." `Aisha said to him, "But you are not like that." I said to her, "Why do you grant him admittance, though Allah said:-- "and as for him among them, who had the greater share therein, his will be a severe torment." (24.11) On that, `Aisha said, "And what punishment is more than blinding?" She, added, "Hassan used to defend or say poetry on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (against the infidels)
64.hi: Masruq bataate hain: Hum Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke paas gaye jabke Hassan bin Thabit unke saath the, unhein apni kuch kavitaon mein se ek sunate hue, kahte huye, "Ek pakbaz, ilm waala mahila jinke baare mein koee bhi shak nahi kar sakta. Woh khali pet uthti hai kyunke woh aparadhsheel aurton ka gosht kabhi nahi khati." Ayesha ne unse kaha, "Magar aap aise nahi hain." Maine unse kaha, "Aap unhe (andar aane ki) ijazat kyun deti hain, jabke Allah ne kaha: 'Aur unmein se jiska hissa ismein (yaani ilzaam phailane mein) sabse zyada tha, uske liye sakht saza hai'? (24:11)" Ispar, Ayesha ne kaha, "Aur andhe ho jane se badtar koee saza kya hai?" Unhone joda, "Hassan Allah ke Rasool ki (kaafiron ke khilaf) hifaazat karte the ya unke liye kavita likhte the."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، فَأَصَابَنَا مَطَرٌ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ، فَصَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصُّبْحَ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَصْبَحَ مِنْ عِبَادِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ بِي، فَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ وَبِرِزْقِ اللَّهِ وَبِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَهْوَ مُؤْمِنٌ بِي، كَافِرٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِنَجْمِ كَذَا‏.‏ فَهْوَ مُؤْمِنٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ، كَافِرٌ بِي ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya. One night it rained and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the Fajr prayer and (after finishing it), turned to us and said, "Do you know what your Lord has said?" We replied, "Allah and His Apostle know it better." He said, "Allah said:-- "(Some of) My slaves got up believing in Me, And (some of them) disbelieving in Me. The one who said: We have been given Rain through Allah's Mercy and Allah's Blessing and Allah's Bounty, then he is a believer in Me, and is a disbeliever in the star. And whoever said: We have been given rain because of such and- such star, then he is a believer in the star, and is a disbeliever in Me
64.hi: Zaid bin Khalid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle. Ek raat barish huee aur Allah ke Rasool ne humein Fajr ki namaz padhaee, aur (namaz khatam karke) humari taraf mude aur kaha, "Kya tumhe pata hai tumhare Rab ne kya kaha hai?" Humne jawab diya, "Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain." Unhone kaha, "Allah ne kaha: '(Kuch) mere bande mujhpar iman rakhte hue jage, aur (kuch) mujhpar avishvaas karte hue. Jisne kaha: Humein Allah ki rehmat, Allah ki barkat, aur Allah ke daan se barish di gaee hai, phir woh mujhpar iman rakhta hai aur sitare ka avishvaas karta hai. Aur jisne kaha: Humein falaan-falaan sitare ki wajah se barish di gaee hai, phir woh sitare par iman rakhta hai aur mera avishvaas karta hai.'"

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ اعْتَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعَ عُمَرٍ كُلُّهُنَّ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، إِلاَّ الَّتِي كَانَتْ مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ‏.‏ عُمْرَةً مِنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، وَعُمْرَةً مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، وَعُمْرَةً مِنَ الْجِعْرَانَةِ حَيْثُ قَسَمَ غَنَائِمَ حُنَيْنٍ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، وَعُمْرَةً مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed four `Umras, all in the month of Dhul-Qa'da, except the one which he performed with his Hajj (i.e. in Dhul-Hijja). He performed one `Umra from Al-Hudaibiya in Dhul- Qa'da, another `Umra in the following year in Dhul Qa'da a third from Al-Jirana where he distributed the war booty of Hunain, in Dhul Qa'da, and the fourth `Umra he performed was with his Hajj
64.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne chaar Umrah kiye, sab Dhul-Qa'da mahine mein, siwaye us ek ke jo unhone apne Hajj ke saath kiya (yaani Dhul-Hijja mein). Unhone ek Umrah Al-Hudaibiya se Dhul-Qa'da mein kiya, ek doosra Umrah agle saal Dhul-Qa'da mein, teesra Al-Jirana se jahaan unhone Hunain ke maal-e-ghanimat ko baanta, Dhul-Qa'da mein, aur chautha Umrah unhone apne Hajj ke saath kiya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ انْطَلَقْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَأَحْرَمَ أَصْحَابُهُ، وَلَمْ أُحْرِمْ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Qatada:We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and all his companions assumed the state of Ihram but I did not
64.hi: Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum Nabi ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle, aur unke sab sahaba ne Ihram ki haalat dhaaran ki magar maine nahi ki.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ تَعُدُّونَ أَنْتُمُ الْفَتْحَ فَتْحَ مَكَّةَ، وَقَدْ كَانَ فَتْحُ مَكَّةَ فَتْحًا، وَنَحْنُ نَعُدُّ الْفَتْحَ بَيْعَةَ الرُّضْوَانِ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ‏.‏ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً، وَالْحُدَيْبِيَةُ بِئْرٌ فَنَزَحْنَاهَا، فَلَمْ نَتْرُكْ فِيهَا قَطْرَةً، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَاهَا، فَجَلَسَ عَلَى شَفِيرِهَا، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَدَعَا، ثُمَّ صَبَّهُ فِيهَا فَتَرَكْنَاهَا غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ إِنَّهَا أَصْدَرَتْنَا مَا شِئْنَا نَحْنُ وَرِكَابَنَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Al-Bara:Do you (people) consider the conquest of Mecca, the Victory (referred to in the Qur'an 48:1). Was the conquest of Mecca a victory? We really consider that the actual Victory was the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance which we gave on the day of Al-Hudaibiya (to the Prophet) . On the day of Al-Hudaibiya we were fourteen hundred men along with the Prophet (ﷺ) Al-Hudaibiya was a well, the water of which we used up leaving not a single drop of water in it. When the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed of that, he came and sat on its edge. Then he asked for a utensil of water, performed ablution from it, rinsed (his mouth), invoked (Allah), and poured the remaining water into the well. We stayed there for a while and then the well brought forth what we required of water for ourselves and our riding animals
64.hi: Al-Bara bataate hain: Kya tum log Mecca ki fatah ko woh Fatah (yaani Vijay, jiska zikar Quran 48:1 mein hai) mante ho? Kya Mecca ki fatah ek Vijay thi? Hum sach mein mante hain ke asli Vijay Ar-Ridwan bai'at thi jo humne Al-Hudaibiya ke din di thi (Nabi ko). Al-Hudaibiya ke din, hum ek hazaar chaar sau log the Nabi ke saath. Al-Hudaibiya ek kuaan tha, jiska paani humne istemal kiya jab tak ismein ek bund bhi paani nahi bacha. Jab Nabi ko iski khabar mili, woh aaye aur uske kinare par baith gaye. Phir unhone paani ka ek bartan maanga, usse wudu kiya, kulla kiya, dua ki, aur baaki paani kue mein daal diya. Hum wahaan kuch der ruke aur phir kue ne humare liye aur humare sawari ke janwaron ke liye jaroorat jitna paani diya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي فَضْلُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ، فَنَزَلُوا عَلَى بِئْرٍ فَنَزَحُوهَا، فَأَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَى الْبِئْرَ، وَقَعَدَ عَلَى شَفِيرِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُونِي بِدَلْوٍ مِنْ مَائِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَبَصَقَ فَدَعَا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ دَعُوهَا سَاعَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَرْوَوْا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَرِكَابَهُمْ حَتَّى ارْتَحَلُوا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Al-Bara bin Azib:That they were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya and their number was 1400 or more. They camped at a well and drew its water till it was dried. When they informed Allah's Apostle of that, he came and sat over its edge and said, "Bring me a bucket of its water." When it was brought, he spat and invoked (Allah) and said, "Leave it for a while." Then they quenched their thirst and watered their riding animals (from that well) till they departed
64.hi: Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Woh Allah ke Rasool ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke din the aur unki tadaad ek hazaar chaar sau ya usse zyada thi. Woh ek kue ke paas padaav daale the aur uska paani nikala jab tak yeh sookh gaya. Jab unhone Allah ke Rasool ko iski khabar di, woh aaye aur uske kinare baith gaye aur kaha, "Iska ek baalti paani mere liye lao." Jab woh laaya gaya, unhone usmein thooka aur dua ki aur kaha, "Ise thoda der ke liye chhod do." Phir unhone apni pyaas bujhaee aur apne sawari ke janwaron ko paani pilaya jab tak woh wahaan se chal pade.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ عَطِشَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ رَكْوَةٌ، فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ النَّاسُ نَحْوَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا لَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا مَاءٌ نَتَوَضَّأُ بِهِ، وَلاَ نَشْرَبُ إِلاَّ مَا فِي رَكْوَتِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فِي الرَّكْوَةِ، فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَفُورُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ كَأَمْثَالِ الْعُيُونِ، قَالَ فَشَرِبْنَا وَتَوَضَّأْنَا‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِجَابِرٍ كَمْ كُنْتُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَالَ لَوْ كُنَّا مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ لَكَفَانَا، كُنَّا خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Salim:Jabir said "On the day of Al-Hudaibiya, the people felt thirsty and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a utensil containing water. He performed ablution from it and then the people came towards him. Allah's Apostle said, 'What is wrong with you?' The people said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We haven't got any water to perform ablution with or to drink, except what you have in your utensil.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) put his hand in the utensil and the water started spouting out between his fingers like springs. So we drank and performed ablution." I said to Jabir, "What was your number on that day?" He replied, "Even if we had been one hundred thousand, that water would have been sufficient for us. Anyhow, we were
64.hi: Salim bataate hain: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Al-Hudaibiya ke din, log pyase ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas paani se bhara ek bartan tha. Unhone usse wudu kiya aur phir log unki taraf badhe. Allah ke Rasool ne pucha, 'Tumhe kya hua hai?' Logon ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Humare paas wudu ya pine ke liye koee paani nahi hai siwaye jo aapke bartan mein hai.' Isliye Nabi ne apna haath bartan mein daala aur paani unki ungliyon ke beech se sroton jaisa nikalne laga. Isliye humne piya aur wudu kiya." Maine Jabir se pucha, "Us din tum kitne the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Chahe hum ek lakh hote, woh paani humare liye kaafi hota, phir bhi hum..."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، كَانَ يَقُولُ كَانُوا أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ كَانُوا خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ
64.en: Narrated Qatada:I said to Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab, "I have been informed that Jabir bin `Abdullah said that the number (of Al-Hudaibiya Muslim warriors) was 1400." Sa`id said to me, "Jabir narrated to me that they were 1500 who gave the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya
64.hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab se kaha, "Mujhe bataya gaya hai ke Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha ke (Al-Hudaibiya ke Musalman mujahidon ki) tadaad ek hazaar chaar sau thi." Sa'id ne mujhse kaha, "Jabir ne mujhse riwaayat ki ke woh ek hazaar paanch sau the jinhone Al-Hudaibiya ke din Nabi ko bai'at di."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ ‏ "‏ أَنْتُمْ خَيْرُ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكُنَّا أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أُبْصِرُ الْيَوْمَ لأَرَيْتُكُمْ مَكَانَ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الأَعْمَشُ سَمِعَ سَالِمًا سَمِعَ جَابِرًا أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَمِائَةٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Al-Hudaibiya, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us' "You are the best people on the earth!" We were 1400 then. If I could see now, I would have shown you the place of the Tree (beneath which we gave the Pledge of Allegiance)." Salim said, "Our number was
64.hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Hudaibiya ke din, Allah ke Rasool ne humse kaha, "Tum zameen par sabse behtareen log ho!" Hum us waqt ek hazaar chaar sau the. Agar main abhi dekh pata, main tumhe darakht ki jagah dikhata (jiske neeche humne Bai'at di). Salim ne kaha, "Humari tadaad..."

64.ar: وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الشَّجَرَةِ أَلْفًا وَثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ، وَكَانَتْ أَسْلَمُ ثُمْنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ‏.‏
64.en: Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa said, "The people (who gave the Pledge of allegiance) under the Tree numbered 1300 and the number of Bani Aslam was 1/8 of the Emigrants
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain: Darakht ke neeche (bai'at dene wale) log ek hazaar teen sau the, aur Banu Aslam ki tadaad Muhajir ki tadaad ka ek-aathvaan hissa thi.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مِرْدَاسًا الأَسْلَمِيَّ، يَقُولُ ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ يُقْبَضُ الصَّالِحُونَ الأَوَّلُ فَالأَوَّلُ، وَتَبْقَى حُفَالَةٌ كَحُفَالَةِ التَّمْرِ وَالشَّعِيرِ، لاَ يَعْبَأُ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ شَيْئًا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Mirdas Al-Aslami:Who was among those (who had given the Pledge of allegiance) under the Tree: Pious people will die in succession, and there will remain the dregs of society who will be like the useless residues of dates and barley and Allah will pay no attention to them
64.hi: Mirdas Al-Aslami bataate hain (jo darakht ke neeche bai'at dene walon mein se the): Pakbaz log ek-ek karke intiqal kar jaenge, aur samaj ke tale ke log baaki rah jaenge, jo khajoor aur jau ke bekaar chhilkon jaise honge, aur Allah unhe koee mahatva nahi dega.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ، وَالْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ وَأَشْعَرَ وَأَحْرَمَ مِنْهَا‏.‏ لاَ أُحْصِي كَمْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ سُفْيَانَ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ لاَ أَحْفَظُ مِنَ الزُّهْرِيِّ الإِشْعَارَ وَالتَّقْلِيدَ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي ـ يَعْنِي ـ مَوْضِعَ الإِشْعَارِ وَالتَّقْلِيدِ، أَوِ الْحَدِيثَ كُلَّهُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out in the company of 1300 to 1500 of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when they reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded and marked his Hadi and assumed the state of Ihram
64.hi: Marwan aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ek hazaar teen sau se paanchon sau ke beech apne sathiyon ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ke saal nikle, aur jab woh Dhul-Hulaifa pahunche, unhone apni Hadi (yaani qurbani ke janwar) par malaen daali aur use nishaanit kiya aur Ihram ki haalat dhaaran ki.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ خَلَفٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، وَرْقَاءَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَآهُ وَقَمْلُهُ يَسْقُطُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَحْلِقَ وَهْوَ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، لَمْ يُبَيِّنْ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ يَحِلُّونَ بِهَا، وَهُمْ عَلَى طَمَعٍ أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا مَكَّةَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الْفِدْيَةَ، فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُطْعِمَ فَرَقًا بَيْنَ سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ، أَوْ يُهْدِيَ شَاةً، أَوْ يَصُومَ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ka`b bin Ujra:That Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him with the lice falling (from his head) on his face. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Are your lice troubling you? Ka`b said, "Yes." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thus ordered him to shave his head while he was at Al-Hudaibiya. Up to then there was no indication that all of them would finish their state of Ihram and they hoped that they would enter Mecca. Then the order of Al-Fidya was revealed, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Ka`b to feed six poor persons with one Faraq of food or slaughter a sheep or fast for three days
64.hi: Ka'b bin Ujra bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne unhe dekha jinke sar se joonen (yaani joon) unke chehre par gir rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Kya joonen tumhe pareshaan kar rahi hain?" Ka'b ne kaha, "Haan." Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne unhe apna sar munwane ka hukum diya jabke woh Al-Hudaibiya mein the. Us waqt tak koee ishara nahi tha ke woh sab Ihram khatm karenge aur unhe ummeed thi ke woh Mecca daakhil honge. Phir Al-Fidya (yaani prayaschit) ka hukum naazil hua, isliye Allah ke Rasool ne Ka'b ko chhah gareebon ko khilane ka hukum diya ek Faraq (naap) khaane se, ya ek bhed zabah karne ka, ya teen din roza rakhne ka.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِلَى السُّوقِ، فَلَحِقَتْ عُمَرَ امْرَأَةٌ شَابَّةٌ فَقَالَتْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ هَلَكَ زَوْجِي وَتَرَكَ صِبْيَةً صِغَارًا، وَاللَّهِ مَا يُنْضِجُونَ كُرَاعًا، وَلاَ لَهُمْ زَرْعٌ وَلاَ ضَرْعٌ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَهُمُ الضَّبُعُ، وَأَنَا بِنْتُ خُفَافِ بْنِ إِيمَاءَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، وَقَدْ شَهِدَ أَبِي الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَوَقَفَ مَعَهَا عُمَرُ، وَلَمْ يَمْضِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ مَرْحَبًا بِنَسَبٍ قَرِيبٍ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى بَعِيرٍ ظَهِيرٍ كَانَ مَرْبُوطًا فِي الدَّارِ، فَحَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ غِرَارَتَيْنِ مَلأَهُمَا طَعَامًا، وَحَمَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا نَفَقَةً وَثِيَابًا، ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهَا بِخِطَامِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اقْتَادِيهِ فَلَنْ يَفْنَى حَتَّى يَأْتِيَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِخَيْرٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَكْثَرْتَ لَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَى أَبَا هَذِهِ وَأَخَاهَا قَدْ حَاصَرَا حِصْنًا زَمَانًا، فَافْتَتَحَاهُ، ثُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا نَسْتَفِيءُ سُهْمَانَهُمَا فِيهِ‏.‏
64.en: (Narrated Aslam:Once I went with `Umar bin Al-Khattab to the market. A young woman followed `Umar and said, "O chief of the believers! My husband has died, leaving little children. By Allah, they have not even a sheep's trotter to cook; they have no farms or animals. I am afraid that they may die because of hunger, and I am the daughter of Khufaf bin Ima Al-Ghafari, and my father witnessed the Pledge of allegiance) of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet.' `Umar stopped and did not proceed, and said, "I welcome my near relative." Then he went towards a strong camel which was tied in the house, and carried on to it, two sacks he had loaded with food grains and put between them money and clothes and gave her its rope to hold and said, "Lead it, and this provision will not finish till Allah gives you a good supply." A man said, "O chief of the believers! You have given her too much." "`Umar said disapprovingly. "May your mother be bereaved of you! By Allah, I have seen her father and brother besieging a fort for a long time and conquering it, and then we were discussing what their shares they would have from that war booty
64.hi: Aslam bataate hain: Ek baar main Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab ke saath bazaar gaya. Ek jawan aurat Umar ke peeche aee aur kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Mere shohar ka intiqal ho gaya hai, chhote bachche chhodkar. Allah ki qasam, unke paas pakane ke liye ek bhed ki taang bhi nahi hai; unke paas na khet hain na janwar. Mujhe dar hai ke woh bhookh se mar na jaen, aur main Khufaf bin Ima Al-Ghafari ki beti hoon, aur mere waalid ne Nabi ke saath Al-Hudaibiya ki bai'at dekhi thi." Umar ruke aur aage nahi badhe, aur kaha, "Main apne qareebi rishtedaar ka swagat karta hoon." Phir woh ek takatvaar unt ki taraf gaye jo ghar mein baandha hua tha, aur uspar unhone do bore laade jinmein unhone anaaj bhara tha, aur beech mein paisa aur kapde rakhe, aur uski rassi unhe pakadne ko di aur kaha, "Ise le jao, aur yeh saamaan tab tak khatm nahi hoga jab tak Allah tumhe achhi zeevika na de." Ek shaks ne kaha, "Aye Mominon ke Ameer! Aapne unhe bahut zyada de diya hai." Umar ne napasand karte huye kaha, "Teri maa tumhe khoe! Allah ki qasam, maine unke waalid aur bhai ko ek qile ka lamba ghera daalte aur use fatah karte dekha hai, aur phir hum charcha kar rahe the ke us jung mein unke kya hisse honge."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ أَبُو عَمْرٍو الْفَزَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الشَّجَرَةَ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهَا بَعْدُ فَلَمْ أَعْرِفْهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ ثُمَّ أُنْسِيتُهَا بَعْدُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That his father said, "I saw the Tree (of the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance) and when I returned to it later, I was not able to recognize it. (The sub--narrator Mahmud said, Al-Musaiyab said, 'Then I forgot it (i.e., the Tree)
64.hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain (apne waalid se): "Maine woh darakht dekha (jiske neeche Ar-Ridwan ki bai'at di gaee) aur jab main baad mein wapas aaya, main use pahchan nahi paya." (Subordinate raawi Mahmud ne kaha, Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, "Phir main ise (yaani darakht ko) bhool gaya.")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ حَاجًّا فَمَرَرْتُ بِقَوْمٍ يُصَلُّونَ قُلْتُ مَا هَذَا الْمَسْجِدُ قَالُوا هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةُ، حَيْثُ بَايَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْعَةَ الرُّضْوَانِ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِيمَنْ بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ، قَالَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجْنَا مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ نَسِينَاهَا، فَلَمْ نَقْدِرْ عَلَيْهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَعْلَمُوهَا وَعَلِمْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ، فَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Tariq bin `Abdur-Rahman:When I set out for Hajj, I passed by some people offering a prayer, I asked, "What is this mosque?" They said, "This is the Tree where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the Ar-Ridwan Pledge of allegiance. Then I went to Sa`id bin Musaiyab and informed him about it. Sa`id said, "My father said that he was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beneath the Tree. He (i.e. my father) said, "When we set out the following year, we forgot the Tree and were unable to recognize it. "Then Sa`id said (perhaps ironically) "The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) could not recognize it; nevertheless, you do recognize it; therefore you have a better knowledge
64.hi: Tariq bin Abdur-Rahman bataate hain: Jab main Hajj ke liye nikla, main kuch logon ke paas se guzra jo namaz padh rahe the. Maine pucha, "Yeh kaunsi masjid hai?" Unhone kaha, "Yeh woh darakht hai jahaan Allah ke Rasool ne Ar-Ridwan bai'at li thi." Phir main Sa'id bin Musaiyab ke paas gaya aur unhe iske baare mein bataya. Sa'id ne kaha, "Mere waalid ne kaha ke woh un logon mein the jinhone Allah ke Rasool ko us darakht ke neeche bai'at di thi. Unhone (yaani mere waalid ne) kaha, 'Jab humne agle saal prasthaan kiya, hum darakht ko bhool gaye aur use pahchaanne mein asamartha rahe.'" Phir Sa'id ne kaha (shaayad vyangatmak tor par), "Nabi ke sahaba use pahchan nahi paye; phir bhi tum ise pahchante ho; isliye tumhe behtar ilm hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا طَارِقٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِمَّنْ بَايَعَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ، فَرَجَعْنَا إِلَيْهَا الْعَامَ الْمُقْبِلَ فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْنَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:That his father was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) beneath the Tree, and the next year when they went towards the Tree, they were not able to recognize it
64.hi: Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab bataate hain (apne waalid se): Woh un logon mein the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Nabi ko) bai'at di thi, aur agle saal jab woh darakht ki taraf gaye, woh use pahchaanne mein asamartha rahe.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ، قَالَ ذُكِرَتْ عِنْدَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ الشَّجَرَةُ فَضَحِكَ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي وَكَانَ، شَهِدَهَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Tariq:(The tree where the Ridwan Pledge of allegiance was taken by the Prophet) was mentioned before Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab. On that he smiled and said, "My father informed me (about it) and he had witnessed it (i.e. the Pledge)
64.hi: Tariq bataate hain: (Woh darakht jahaan Ridwan bai'at Nabi dwaara li gaee thi) Sa'id bin Al-Musaiyab ke saamne iska zikar hua. Ispar woh muskurae aur kaha, "Mere waalid ne mujhe (iske baare mein) bataya aur unhone ise dekha tha (yaani us bai'at ko)."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ قَوْمٌ بِصَدَقَةٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ أَبِي بِصَدَقَتِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى آلِ أَبِي أَوْفَى ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:(Who was one of those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the Tree) When the people brought Sadaqa (i.e. Zakat) to the Prophet (ﷺ) he used to say, "O Allah! Bless them with your Mercy." Once my father came with his Sadaqa to him whereupon he (i.e. the Prophet) said. "O Allah! Bless the family of Abu `Aufa
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abi Aufa bataate hain (jo un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche Nabi ko bai'at di thi): Jab log Nabi ke paas Sadaqa (yaani Zakat) laate, woh kahte, "Aye Allah! Inhe apni Rehmat se barkat de." Ek baar mere waalid apni Sadaqa lekar unke paas aaye, ispar unhone (yaani Nabi ne) kaha, "Aye Allah! Abu Aufa ke pariwara ko barkat de."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْحَرَّةِ وَالنَّاسُ يُبَايِعُونَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ عَلَى مَا يُبَايِعُ ابْنُ حَنْظَلَةَ النَّاسَ قِيلَ لَهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أُبَايِعُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَحَدًا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَكَانَ شَهِدَ مَعَهُ الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abbas bin Tamim:When it was the day (of the battle) of Al-Harra the people were giving Pledge of allegiance to `Abdullah bin Hanzala. Ibn Zaid said, "For what are the people giving Pledge of allegiance to `Abdullah bin Hanzala?" It was said to him, "For death." Ibn Zaid said, "I will never give the Pledge of allegiance for that to anybody else after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Ibn Zaid was one of those who had witnessed the day of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet
64.hi: Abbas bin Tamim bataate hain: Jab Al-Harra ki jung ka din tha, log Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hanzala ko Bai'at de rahe the. Ibn Zaid ne pucha, "Log Abdullah bin Hanzala ko kis cheez ke liye Bai'at de rahe hain?" Unse kaha gaya, "Maut ke liye." Ibn Zaid ne kaha, "Main iske liye Allah ke Rasool ke baad kabhi kisi aur ko Bai'at nahi dunga." Ibn Zaid un logon mein se ek the jinhone Al-Hudaibiya ka din Nabi ke saath dekha tha.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ـ أَبِي وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ قَالَ كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْجُمُعَةَ ثُمَّ نَنْصَرِفُ، وَلَيْسَ لِلْحِيطَانِ ظِلٌّ نَسْتَظِلُّ فِيهِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Iyas bin Salama bin Al-Akwa`:My father who was amongst those who had given the Pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) beneath the Tree, said to me, "We used to offer the Jumua prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then depart at a time when the walls had no shade for us to take shelter in
64.hi: Iyas bin Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mere waalid, jo un logon mein the jinhone darakht ke neeche Nabi ko bai'at di tha, ne mujhse kaha, "Hum Jumme ki namaz Nabi ke saath padhte the aur phir aise waqt chale jate jab deewaron ki koee chhaye nahi hoti thi jahaan hum panah le saken."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ بَايَعْتُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Yazid bin Abi Ubaid:I said to Salama bin Al-Akwa`, "For what did you give the Pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of Al-Hudaibiya?" He replied, "For death (in the Cause of Islam)
64.hi: Yazid bin Abi Ubaid bataate hain: Maine Salama bin Al-Akwa (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, "Aapne Al-Hudaibiya ke din Allah ke Rasool ko kis cheez ke liye Bai'at di?" Unhone jawab diya, "Maut ke liye (Islam ki khaatir)."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِشْكَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَقُلْتُ طُوبَى لَكَ صَحِبْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَايَعْتَهُ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثْنَا بَعْدَهُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Al-Musaiyab:I met Al-Bara bin `Azib and said (to him). "May you live prosperously! You enjoyed the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and gave him the Pledge of allegiance (of Al-Hudaibiya) under the Tree." On that, Al- Bara' said, "O my nephew! You do not know what we have done after him (i.e. his death)
64.hi: Al-Musaiyab bataate hain: Main Al-Bara bin Azib (رضی اللہ عنہ) se mila aur (unse) kaha, "Aap samriddh zindagi jiye! Aapne Nabi ki sohbat paee aur unhe (Al-Hudaibiya ki) Bai'at di darakht ke neeche." Ispar Al-Bara ne kaha, "Aye mere bhatije! Aapko nahi pata hum unke baad kya kar chuke hain (yaani unki maut ke baad)."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَّمٍ ـ عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّ ثَابِتَ بْنَ الضَّحَّاكِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَايَعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Qilaba:that Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak had informed him that he was one of those who had given the Pledge of allegiance (of Al-Hudaibiya) beneath the Tree
64.hi: Abu Qilaba bataate hain: Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak ne unhe bataya ke woh un logon mein the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Al-Hudaibiya ki) Bai'at di thi.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏ قَالَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَصْحَابُهُ هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا فَمَا لَنَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لِيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ‏}‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَقَدِمْتُ الْكُوفَةَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا كُلِّهِ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ أَمَّا ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ‏}‏ فَعَنْ أَنَسٍ، وَأَمَّا هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا فَعَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:regarding Allah's Statement: "Verily! We have granted you (O, Muhammad) Manifest victory." (48.1) It refers to the Al-Hudaibiya Pledge. And the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to the Prophet), "Congratulations and happiness for you; but what reward shall we get?" So Allah revealed:-- "That He may admit the believing men and women to gardens beneath which rivers flow
64.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (Allah ke is farmaan ke baare mein): "Beshak, Humne aapko (Aye Muhammad) ek saaf Vijay diya hai." (48:1) Yeh Al-Hudaibiya ki Bai'at ka ishara hai. Aur Nabi ke sahaba ne (unse) kaha, "Aapko mubaarak ho aur khushi ho; magar humein kya ajr milega?" Ispar Allah ne naazil kiya: "Taaki woh momin mardon aur aurton ko baagon mein daakhil kare jinke neeche nadiyaan behti hain..."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مَجْزَأَةَ بْنِ زَاهِرٍ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ الشَّجَرَةَ ـ قَالَ إِنِّي لأُوقِدُ تَحْتَ الْقِدْرِ بِلُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ إِذْ نَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Zahir Al-Aslami:(who was one of those who had witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree) While I was making fire beneath the cooking pots containing donkey's meat, the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) announced, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbids you to eat donkey's meat
64.hi: Zahir Al-Aslami bataate hain (jo un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Bai'at) dekhi thi): Jabke main gadhe ke gosht wale bartan ke neeche aag jala raha tha, Allah ke Rasool ke elaan karne wale ne elaan kiya, "Allah ke Rasool tumhe gadhe ka gosht khaane se mana karte hain."

64.ar: وَعَنْ مَجْزَأَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ اسْمُهُ أُهْبَانُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ وَكَانَ اشْتَكَى رُكْبَتَهُ، وَكَانَ إِذَا سَجَدَ جَعَلَ تَحْتَ رُكْبَتِهِ وِسَادَةً‏.‏
64.en: The same narration was told by Majzaa from a man called Uhban bin Aus who was one of those who had witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree., and who had some trouble in his knee so that while doing prostrations, he used to put a pillow underneath his knee
64.hi: (yehi riwaayat Majzaa ne ek shaks se sunaee jinka naam Uhban bin Aus tha, jo un logon mein se ek the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Bai'at) dekhi thi, aur jinke ghutne mein kuch takleef thi, isliye sajda karte waqt, woh apne ghutne ke neeche ek takiya rakhte the.)

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ أُتُوا بِسَوِيقٍ فَلاَكُوهُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُعَاذٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Suwaid bin An-Nu`man:who was one of those who witnessed (the Pledge of allegiance beneath) the Tree: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions were given Sawiq and they chewed it
64.hi: Suwaid bin An-Nu'man (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (jo un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche (Bai'at) dekhi thi): Allah ke Rasool aur unke sahaba ko Sawiq (yaani pisa hua jau) diya gaya aur unhone use chabaya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَاذَانُ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِذَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الشَّجَرَةِ هَلْ يُنْقَضُ الْوِتْرُ قَالَ إِذَا أَوْتَرْتَ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِ، فَلاَ تُوتِرْ مِنْ آخِرِهِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Jamra:I asked Aidh bin `Amr, who was one of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) one of those (who gave the allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) under the Tree): "Can the witr prayer be repeated (in one night)?" He said, "If you have offered it in the first part of the night, you should not repeat it in the last part of the night." (See Fath-ul-Bari page 458 Vol 8th)
64.hi: Abu Jamra bataate hain: Maine Aidh bin Amr se pucha, jo Nabi ke sahaba mein se the aur un logon mein se the jinhone darakht ke neeche Nabi ko Bai'at di thi, "Kya Witr ki namaz (ek raat mein) doharaee ja sakti hai?" Unhone kaha, "Agar aapne ise raat ke pahle hisse mein padha hai, aapko ise raat ke aakhri hisse mein doharana nahi chahiye."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسِيرُ فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَسِيرُ مَعَهُ لَيْلاً، فَسَأَلَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ يَا عُمَرُ، نَزَرْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ لاَ يُجِيبُكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَحَرَّكْتُ بَعِيرِي ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمْتُ أَمَامَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ، فَمَا نَشِبْتُ أَنْ سَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَصْرُخُ بِي ـ قَالَ ـ فَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ نَزَلَ فِيَّ قُرْآنٌ‏.‏ وَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَىَّ اللَّيْلَةَ سُورَةٌ لَهِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا‏}‏‏.‏‏"‏
64.en: Narrated Zaid bin Aslam:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was proceeding at night on one of his journeys and `Umar bin Al- Khattab was going along with him. `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked him (about something) but Allah's Apostle did not answer him. `Umar asked him again, but he did not answer him. He asked him again (for the third time) but he did not answer him. On that `Umar bin Al-Khattab addressed himself saying, "May your mother be bereaved of you, O `Umar, for you have asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thrice, yet he has not answered you." `Umar said, "Then I made my camel run fast and took it in front of the other Muslims, and I was afraid that something might be revealed in my connection. I had hardly waited for a moment when I heard somebody calling me. I said, 'I was afraid that something might have been revealed about me.' Then I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greeted him. He (i.e. the Prophet) said, 'Tonight there has been revealed to me, a Sura which is dearer to me than (all the world) on which the sun rises,' and then he recited: 'Verily! We have granted you (O Muhammad) A manifest victory
64.hi: Zaid bin Aslam bataate hain (apne waalid se): Allah ke Rasool apne ek safar ki raat mein aage badh rahe the aur Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab unke saath ja rahe the. Umar bin Al-Khattab ne unse (kuch) pucha, magar Allah ke Rasool ne unhe jawab nahi diya. Umar ne phir pucha, magar unhone phir jawab nahi diya. Unhone phir pucha (teesri baar), magar unhone phir jawab nahi diya. Ispar Umar bin Al-Khattab ne khud se kaha, "Teri maa tumhe khoe, Aye Umar, kyunke tumne Allah ke Rasool se teen baar pucha, phir bhi unhone tumhe jawab nahi diya." Umar ne kaha, "Phir maine apne unt ko tezi se daudaya aur use doosre Musalmanon se aage le liya, aur mujhe dar tha ke mere silsile mein kuch naazil ho sakta hai. Main mushkil se ek pal ruka tha jab maine kisi ko mujhe bulate suna. Maine kaha, 'Mujhe dar tha mere baare mein kuch naazil hua hoga.' Phir main Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya aur unhe salaam kiya. Unhone (yaani Nabi ne) kaha, 'Aaj raat mujhpar ek Surah naazil huee hai jo mujhe (saari duniya) se, jispar suraj chadhta hai, zyada pyari hai,' aur phir unhone padha: 'Beshak, Humne aapko (Aye Muhammad) ek saaf Vijay diya hai...'"

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، حِينَ حَدَّثَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ،، حَفِظْتُ بَعْضَهُ، وَثَبَّتَنِي مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَمَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، يَزِيدُ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ، وَأَشْعَرَهُ، وَأَحْرَمَ مِنْهَا بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَبَعَثَ عَيْنًا لَهُ مِنْ خُزَاعَةَ، وَسَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كَانَ بِغَدِيرِ الأَشْطَاطِ، أَتَاهُ عَيْنُهُ قَالَ إِنَّ قُرَيْشًا جَمَعُوا لَكَ جُمُوعًا، وَقَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكَ الأَحَابِيشَ، وَهُمْ مُقَاتِلُوكَ وَصَادُّوكَ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ وَمَانِعُوكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشِيرُوا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَىَّ، أَتَرَوْنَ أَنْ أَمِيلَ إِلَى عِيَالِهِمْ وَذَرَارِيِّ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَصُدُّونَا عَنِ الْبَيْتِ، فَإِنْ يَأْتُونَا كَانَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ قَطَعَ عَيْنًا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَإِلاَّ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ مَحْرُوبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، خَرَجْتَ عَامِدًا لِهَذَا الْبَيْتِ، لاَ تُرِيدُ قَتْلَ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ حَرْبَ أَحَدٍ، فَتَوَجَّهْ لَهُ، فَمَنْ صَدَّنَا عَنْهُ قَاتَلْنَاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ امْضُوا عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan bin Al-Hakam:(one of them said more than his friend): The Prophet (ﷺ) set out in the company of more than onethousand of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when he reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded his Hadi (i.e. sacrificing animal), assumed the state of Ihram for `Umra from that place and sent a spy of his from Khuzi'a (tribe). The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded on till he reached (a village called) Ghadir-al-Ashtat. There his spy came and said, "The Quraish (infidels) have collected a great number of people against you, and they have collected against you the Ethiopians, and they will fight with you, and will stop you from entering the Ka`ba and prevent you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Give me your opinion. Do you recommend that I should destroy the families and offspring of those who want to stop us from the Ka`ba? If they should come to us (for peace) then Allah will destroy a spy from the pagans, or otherwise we will leave them in a miserable state." On that Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Apostle! You have come with the intention of visiting this House (i.e. Ka`ba) and you do not want to kill or fight anybody. So proceed to it, and whoever should stop us from it, we will fight him." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Proceed on, in the Name of Allah
