64.en: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me, Az-Zubair and Al-Miqdad saying, "Proceed till you reach Rawdat Khakh where there is a lady carrying a letter, and take that (letter) from her." So we proceeded on our way with our horses galloping till we reached the Rawda, and there we found the lady and said to her, "Take out the letter." She said, "I have no letter." We said, "Take out the letter, or else we will take off your clothes." So she took it out of her braid, and we brought the letter to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . The letter was addressed from Hatib, bin Abi Balta'a to some pagans of Mecca, telling them about what Allah's Apostle intended to do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Hatib! What is this?" Hatib replied, "O Allah's Apostle! Do not make a hasty decision about me. I was a person not belonging to Quraish but I was an ally to them from outside and had no blood relation with them, and all the Emigrants who were with you, have got their kinsmen (in Mecca) who can protect their families and properties. So I liked to do them a favor so that they might protect my relatives as I have no blood relation with them. I did not do this to renegade from my religion (i.e. Islam) nor did I do it to choose Heathenism after Islam." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his companions." As regards him, he (i.e. Hatib) has told you the truth." `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop off the head of this hypocrite!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He (i.e. Hatib) has witnessed the Badr battle (i.e. fought in it) and what could tell you, perhaps Allah looked at those who witnessed Badr and said, "O the people of Badr (i.e. Badr Muslim warriors), do what you like, for I have forgiven you. "Then Allah revealed the Sura:-- "O you who believe! Take not my enemies And your enemies as friends offering them (Your) love even though they have disbelieved in that Truth (i.e. Allah, Prophet Muhammad and this Qur'an) which has come to you ....(to the end of Verse)....(And whosoever of you (Muslims) does that, then indeed he has gone (far) astray (away) from the Straight Path
64.hi: Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe, Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Al-Miqdad (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko bheja, kehte huye, "Jaao jab tak tum Rawdat Khakh na pahunch jao jahaan ek aurat khat lekar ja rahi hai, aur use (yaani khat) unse le lo." Isliye hum apne ghodon ko daudate huye badhe jab tak hum Rawda pahunche, aur wahaan humne woh aurat paee aur unse kaha, "Khat nikalo." Unhone kaha, "Mere paas koee khat nahi hai." Humne kaha, "Khat nikalo, warna hum tumhe nanga kar denge." Isliye unhone use apni choti mein se nikala, aur humne woh khat Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaya. Yeh khat Hatib bin Abi Balta'a se Mecca ke kuch mushrikon ke naam tha, unhe batate huye Allah ke Rasool ka irada kya tha. Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Aye Hatib! Yeh kya hai?" Hatib ne jawab diya, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere baare mein jaldbaazi mat kariye. Main Quraish se mutaliq nahi tha, magar unke saath ek baahri muahid tha, aur unse mera koee khoon ka rishta nahi tha, aur sab Muhajir jo aapke saath the, unke (Mecca mein) rishtedaar hain jo unke pariwaron aur maal ki hifaazat kar sakte hain. Isliye maine socha unpar ek ehsaan karun taaki woh mere rishtedaron ki hifaazat karenge kyunke mera unse koee khoon ka rishta nahi hai. Maine yeh apne deen (yaani Islam) se peeth pherne ke liye nahi kiya, na hi maine Islam ke baad phir se but-parasti chunne ke liye kiya." Allah ke Rasool ne apne sahaba se kaha, "Jahaan tak unka (yaani Hatib ka) sawal hai, unhone aapko sach kaha." Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe is munafik ka sar kaatne dijiye!" Nabi ne kaha, "Woh (yaani Hatib) Badr ki jung ke gawah hain (yaani unmein ladne wale the), aur tumhe kya pata, shaayad Allah ne Badr ke gawahon ki taraf dekhkar kaha ho, 'Aye Badr ke log (yaani Badr ke Musalman mujahid), jo chaho karo, kyunke maine tumhe maaf kar diya hai.'" Phir Allah ne yeh Surah naazil ki: "Aye mominon! Mere dushmanon aur tumhare dushmanon ko dost mat banao, unhe mohabbat pesh karte huye chahe unhone us Sach (yaani Allah, Nabi Muhammad, aur is Quran) ka inkaar kiya ho jo tumhare paas aaya hai...." (aakhri tak)...."Aur tummein se jo bhi (Musalman) aisa karta hai, woh (door) Seedhe Raste se bhata gaya hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزَا غَزْوَةَ الْفَتْحِ فِي رَمَضَانَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ يَقُولُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ وَعَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ صَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ الْكَدِيدَ ـ الْمَاءَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ قُدَيْدٍ وَعُسْفَانَ ـ أَفْطَرَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ مُفْطِرًا حَتَّى انْسَلَخَ الشَّهْرُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah bin `Utba:Ibn `Abbas said, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought the Ghazwa (i.e. battles of Al-Fath during Ramadan." Narrated Az-Zuhri: Ibn Al-Musaiyab (also) said the same. Ibn `Abbas added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) fasted and when he reached Al-Kadid, a place where there is water between Qudaid and 'Usfan, he broke his fast and did not fast afterwards till the whole month had passed away
64.hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Utba bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, Allah ke Rasool ne Ghazwa Al-Fath Ramadan mein lada." Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne bhi yehi kaha. Ibn Abbas ne joda, "Nabi ne roza rakha aur jab woh Al-Kadid pahunche, ek jagah jahaan Qudaid aur Usfan ke beech paani hai, unhone apna roza tod diya aur baad mein poore mahine ke guzarne tak roza nahi rakha."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مَحْمُودٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَعْمَرٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ فِي رَمَضَانَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَمَعَهُ عَشَرَةُ آلاَفٍ، وَذَلِكَ عَلَى رَأْسِ ثَمَانِ سِنِينَ وَنِصْفٍ مِنْ مَقْدَمِهِ الْمَدِينَةَ، فَسَارَ هُوَ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ، يَصُومُ وَيَصُومُونَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْكَدِيدَ ـ وَهْوَ مَاءٌ بَيْنَ عُسْفَانَ وَقُدَيْدٍ ـ أَفْطَرَ وَأَفْطَرُوا‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَإِنَّمَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الآخِرُ فَالآخِرُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) left Medina (for Mecca) in the company of ten-thousand (Muslim warriors) in (the month of) Ramadan, and that was eight and a half years after his migration to Medina. He and the Muslims who were with him, proceeded on their way to Mecca. He was fasting and they were fasting, but when they reached a place called Al-Kadid which was a place of water between 'Usfan and Qudaid, he broke his fast and so did they. (Az-Zuhri said, "One should take the last action of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and leave his early action (while taking a verdict)
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi ne Madina chhoda (Mecca ke liye) das hazaar (Musalman mujahidon) ki sohbat mein Ramadan mein, aur yeh unki Madina hijrat ke aadhe saal baad thi. Woh aur unke saath ke Musalman Mecca ki taraf badhe. Woh roza rakhe hue the aur woh (Musalman) bhi rakhe hue the, magar jab woh Al-Kadid naam ki jagah pahunche jo Usfan aur Qudaid ke beech ek paani wali jagah thi, unhone apna roza tod diya aur unhone bhi (usi tarah kiya). (Az-Zuhri ne kaha, "Insaan ko Allah ke Rasool ka aakhri amal lena chahiye aur unka pahla amal chhodna chahiye (faisla lete waqt).")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ إِلَى حُنَيْنٍ، وَالنَّاسُ مُخْتَلِفُونَ فَصَائِمٌ وَمُفْطِرٌ، فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَى عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ أَوْ مَاءٍ، فَوَضَعَهُ عَلَى رَاحَتِهِ أَوْ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ الْمُفْطِرُونَ لِلصُّوَّامِ أَفْطِرُوا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out towards Hunain in the month of Ramadan and some of the people were fasting while some others were not fasting, and when the Prophet (ﷺ) mounted his she-camel, he asked for a tumbler of milk or water and put it on the palm of his hand or on his she-camel and then the people looked at him; and those who were not fasting told those who were fasting, to break their fast (i.e. as the Prophet (ﷺ) had done so
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Hunain ki taraf Ramadan mein nikle aur kuch log roza rakhe hue the jabke kuch nahi. Jab Nabi apni untni par chadhe, unhone doodh ya paani ka ek pyala maanga aur use apni hatheli ya apni untni par rakha, aur phir logon ne unhe dekha, aur jinhone roza nahi rakha tha unhone un logon se, jinhone roza rakha tha, apna roza todne ko kaha (yaani jaise Nabi ne kiya tha).

64.ar: وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Ibn `Abbas added:"The Prophet (ﷺ) went (to Hunain) in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca)
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda: Nabi (Hunain) gaye Fatah-e-Mecca ke saal.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَافَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَصَامَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ عُسْفَانَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَشَرِبَ نَهَارًا، لِيُرِيَهُ النَّاسَ، فَأَفْطَرَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ صَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السَّفَرِ وَأَفْطَرَ، فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَ، وَمَنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) travelled in the month of Ramadan and he fasted till he reached (a place called) 'Usfan, then he asked for a tumbler of water and drank it by the daytime so that the people might see him. He broke his fast till he reached Mecca." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "Allah's Apostle fasted and sometimes did not fast while traveling, so one may fast or may not (on journeys)
64.hi: Tawus bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Allah ke Rasool ne Ramadan ke mahine mein safar ki aur unhone roza rakha jab tak woh (ek jagah jise) Usfan pahunche, phir unhone paani ka ek pyala maanga aur use din mein piya taaki log unhe dekhen. Unhone Mecca pahunchne tak apna roza tod diya." Ibn Abbas kaha karte the, "Allah ke Rasool ne safar karte waqt kabhi roza rakha aur kabhi nahi rakha, isliye koee bhi (safar ke dauran) roza rakh sakta hai ya nahi rakh sakta."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا سَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ قُرَيْشًا، خَرَجَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَحَكِيمُ بْنُ حِزَامٍ وَبُدَيْلُ بْنُ وَرْقَاءَ يَلْتَمِسُونَ الْخَبَرَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلُوا يَسِيرُونَ حَتَّى أَتَوْا مَرَّ الظَّهْرَانِ، فَإِذَا هُمْ بِنِيرَانٍ كَأَنَّهَا نِيرَانُ عَرَفَةَ، فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ مَا هَذِهِ لَكَأَنَّهَا نِيرَانُ عَرَفَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بُدَيْلُ بْنُ وَرْقَاءَ نِيرَانُ بَنِي عَمْرٍو‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ عَمْرٌو أَقَلُّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَرَآهُمْ نَاسٌ مِنْ حَرَسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَدْرَكُوهُمْ فَأَخَذُوهُمْ، فَأَتَوْا بِهِمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَسْلَمَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، فَلَمَّا سَارَ قَالَ لِلْعَبَّاسِ ‏"‏ احْبِسْ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ عِنْدَ حَطْمِ الْخَيْلِ حَتَّى يَنْظُرَ إِلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَبَسَهُ الْعَبَّاسُ، فَجَعَلَتِ الْقَبَائِلُ تَمُرُّ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَمُرُّ كَتِيبَةً كَتِيبَةً عَلَى أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، فَمَرَّتْ كَتِيبَةٌ قَالَ يَا عَبَّاسُ مَنْ هَذِهِ قَالَ هَذِهِ غِفَارُ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا لِي وَلِغِفَارَ ثُمَّ مَرَّتْ جُهَيْنَةُ، قَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ مَرَّتْ سَعْدُ بْنُ هُذَيْمٍ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَمَرَّتْ سُلَيْمُ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، حَتَّى أَقْبَلَتْ كَتِيبَةٌ لَمْ يَرَ مِثْلَهَا، قَالَ مَنْ هَذِهِ قَالَ هَؤُلاَءِ الأَنْصَارُ عَلَيْهِمْ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ مَعَهُ الرَّايَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ يَا أَبَا سُفْيَانَ الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْمَلْحَمَةِ، الْيَوْمَ تُسْتَحَلُّ الْكَعْبَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ يَا عَبَّاسُ حَبَّذَا يَوْمُ الذِّمَارِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ كَتِيبَةٌ، وَهْىَ أَقَلُّ الْكَتَائِبِ، فِيهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ، وَرَايَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ، فَلَمَّا مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَبِي سُفْيَانَ قَالَ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ مَا قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا قَالَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَذَبَ سَعْدٌ، وَلَكِنْ هَذَا يَوْمٌ يُعَظِّمُ اللَّهُ فِيهِ الْكَعْبَةَ، وَيَوْمٌ تُكْسَى فِيهِ الْكَعْبَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُرْكَزَ رَايَتُهُ بِالْحَجُونِ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ وَأَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَبَّاسَ يَقُولُ لِلزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، هَا هُنَا أَمَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَرْكُزَ الرَّايَةَ، قَالَ وَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ مِنْ أَعْلَى مَكَّةَ مِنْ كَدَاءٍ، وَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ كُدَا، فَقُتِلَ مِنْ خَيْلِ خَالِدٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ رَجُلاَنِ حُبَيْشُ بْنُ الأَشْعَرِ وَكُرْزُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ الْفِهْرِيُّ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Hisham's father:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out (towards Mecca) during the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) and this news reached (the infidels of Quraish), Abu Sufyan, Hakim bin Hizam and Budail bin Warqa came out to gather information about Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , They proceeded on their way till they reached a place called Marr-az-Zahran (which is near Mecca). Behold! There they saw many fires as if they were the fires of `Arafat. Abu Sufyan said, "What is this? It looked like the fires of `Arafat." Budail bin Warqa' said, "Banu `Amr are less in number than that." Some of the guards of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw them and took them over, caught them and brought them to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Abu Sufyan embraced Islam. When the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded, he said to Al-Abbas, "Keep Abu Sufyan standing at the top of the mountain so that he would look at the Muslims. So Al-`Abbas kept him standing (at that place) and the tribes with the Prophet (ﷺ) started passing in front of Abu Sufyan in military batches. A batch passed and Abu Sufyan said, "O `Abbas Who are these?" `Abbas said, "They are (Banu) Ghifar." Abu Sufyan said, I have got nothing to do with Ghifar." Then (a batch of the tribe of) Juhaina passed by and he said similarly as above. Then (a batch of the tribe of) Sa`d bin Huzaim passed by and he said similarly as above. then (Banu) Sulaim passed by and he said similarly as above. Then came a batch, the like of which Abu Sufyan had not seen. He said, "Who are these?" `Abbas said, "They are the Ansar headed by Sa`d bin Ubada, the one holding the flag." Sa`d bin Ubada said, "O Abu Sufyan! Today is the day of a great battle and today (what is prohibited in) the Ka`ba will be permissible." Abu Sufyan said., "O `Abbas! How excellent the day of destruction is! "Then came another batch (of warriors) which was the smallest of all the batches, and in it there was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions and the flag of the Prophet (ﷺ) was carried by Az-Zubair bin Al Awwam. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by Abu Sufyan, the latter said, (to the Prophet), "Do you know what Sa`d bin 'Ubada said?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What did he say?" Abu Sufyan said, "He said so-and-so." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sa`d told a lie, but today Allah will give superiority to the Ka`ba and today the Ka`ba will be covered with a (cloth) covering." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered that his flag be fixed at Al-Hajun. Narrated `Urwa: Nafi` bin Jubair bin Mut`im said, "I heard Al-Abbas saying to Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam, 'O Abu `Abdullah! Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) order you to fix the flag here?' " Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Khalid bin Al-Walid to enter Mecca from its upper part from Ka'da while the Prophet (ﷺ) himself entered from Kuda. Two men from the cavalry of Khalid bin Al-Walid named Hubaish bin Al-Ash'ar and Kurz bin Jabir Al-Fihri were martyred on that day
64.hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (Mecca ki taraf) nikle Fatah ke saal aur yeh khabar (Quraish ke kaafiron tak) pahunchi, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ), Hakim bin Hizam (رضی اللہ عنہ), aur Budail bin Warqa Allah ke Rasool ke baare mein jaankari lene nikle. Woh apne raste par badhe jab tak woh Marr-az-Zahran (yaani Mecca ke qareeb ek jagah) pahunche. Dekho! Wahaan unhone bahut sari aagen dekhi mano Arafat ki aagen hon. Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Yeh kya hai? Yeh Arafat ki aagon jaisa dikhta hai." Budail bin Warqa ne kaha, "Banu Amr isse kam hain tadaad mein." Allah ke Rasool ke kuch paharedaron ne unhe dekha aur unhe pakad liya, unhe giraftaar kiya, aur Allah ke Rasool ke paas laaye. Abu Sufyan ne Islam qubool kiya. Jab Nabi aage badhe, unhone Al-Abbas se kaha, "Abu Sufyan ko pahad ki choti par khade rakho taaki woh Musalmanon ko dekh saken." Isliye Al-Abbas ne unhe wahaan khade rakha aur Nabi ke saath ke qabile Abu Sufyan ke saamne paltanon mein guzarne lage. Ek paltan guzari aur Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Aye Abbas! Yeh kaun hain?" Abbas ne kaha, "Yeh (Banu) Ghifar hain." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Mera Ghifar se koee matlab nahi." Phir (Juhaina qabile ki ek paltan) guzari aur unhone usi tarah kaha jaisa upar tha. Phir (Sa'd bin Huzaim qabile ki ek paltan) guzari aur unhone usi tarah kaha. Phir (Banu) Sulaim guzre aur unhone usi tarah kaha. Phir ek paltan aee jaisi Abu Sufyan ne pahle kabhi nahi dekhi thi. Unhone pucha, "Yeh kaun hain?" Abbas ne kaha, "Yeh Ansaar hain, Sa'd bin Ubada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke netritva mein, jo jhanda thaame hue hain." Sa'd bin Ubada ne kaha, "Aye Abu Sufyan! Aaj ek bade jung ka din hai aur aaj Ka'ba mein jo mana hai woh jaayaz ho jaayega." Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Aye Abbas! Barbaadi ka din kitna behtareen hai!" Phir ek doosri paltan aee jo sab paltnon se sabse chhoti thi, aur usmein Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathi the, aur Nabi ka jhanda Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Awwam thaam rahe the. Jab Allah ke Rasool Abu Sufyan ke paas se guzre, unhone (Nabi se) kaha, "Kya aapko pata hai Sa'd bin Ubada ne kya kaha?" Nabi ne pucha, "Unhone kya kaha?" Abu Sufyan ne kaha, "Unhone falaan-falaan kaha." Nabi ne kaha, "Sa'd ne jhoot kaha, magar aaj Allah Ka'ba ko superiority dega aur aaj Ka'ba ek (kapde se) dhaanka jaayega." Allah ke Rasool ne hukum diya ke unka jhanda Al-Hajun mein gaada jaaye. Urwa bataate hain: Nafi bin Jubair bin Mut'im ne kaha, "Maine Al-Abbas ko Az-Zubair bin Al-Awwam se kehte suna, 'Aye Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ)! Kya Allah ke Rasool ne aapko hukum diya jhanda yahaan gaadne ka?'" Allah ke Rasool ne Khalid bin Al-Walid ko hukum diya ke woh Mecca ke oonche hisse se, Kada se, daakhil hon, jabke Nabi khud Kuda se daakhil hue. Khalid bin Al-Walid ke ghodswaron mein se do log, Hubaish bin Al-Ash'ar aur Kurz bin Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Fihri, us din shaheed hue.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُغَفَّلٍ، يَقُولُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ، وَهْوَ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ يُرَجِّعُ، وَقَالَ لَوْلاَ أَنْ يَجْتَمِعَ النَّاسُ حَوْلِي لَرَجَّعْتُ كَمَا رَجَّعَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mughaffal:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of the Conquest of Mecca over his she-camel, reciting Surat-al-Fath in a vibrant quivering tone. (The sub-narrator, Mu'awiya added, "Were I not afraid that the people may gather around me, I would recite in vibrant quivering tone as he (i.e. `Abdullah bin Mughaffal) did, imitating Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Mughaffal bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool ko Fatah-e-Mecca ke din apni untni par dekha, Surat-al-Fath ek kaanpti huee aawaaz mein padhte hue. (Subordinate raawi, Muawiya (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne joda, "Agar mujhe dar na hota ke log mere aas-paas jama ho jaenge, main bhi Surat-al-Fath usi kaanpti huee aawaaz mein padhta jaisa unhone (yaani Abdullah bin Mughaffal ne) padha tha, Allah ke Rasool ki nakal karte huye.")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَهَلْ تَرَكَ لَنَا عَقِيلٌ مِنْ مَنْزِلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَرِثُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْكَافِرَ، وَلاَ يَرِثُ الْكَافِرُ الْمُؤْمِنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ لِلزُّهْرِيِّ وَمَنْ وَرِثَ أَبَا طَالِبٍ قَالَ وَرِثَهُ عَقِيلٌ وَطَالِبٌ‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَيْنَ تَنْزِلُ غَدًا‏.‏ فِي حَجَّتِهِ، وَلَمْ يَقُلْ يُونُسُ حَجَّتِهِ وَلاَ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Amr bin `Uthman:Usama bin Zaid said during the Conquest (of Mecca), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Where will we encamp tomorrow?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "But has `Aqil left for us any house to lodge in?" He then added, "No believer will inherit an infidel's property, and no infidel will inherit the property of a believer." Az- Zuhri was asked, "Who inherited Abu Talib?" Az-Zuhri replied, "Aqil and Talib inherited him
64.hi: Amr bin Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Fatah (Mecca) ke dauran kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hum kal kahaan padaav dalenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Kya Aqil ne humare liye koee ghar chhoda hai jahaan hum rah saken?" Unhone aage kaha, "Koee bhi momin kaafir ki maal ki waraasat nahi karega, aur koee bhi kaafir momin ki maal ki waraasat nahi karega." Az-Zuhri se pucha gaya, "Abu Talib ka waaris kaun tha?" Az-Zuhri ne jawab diya, "Aqil aur Talib ne unki waraasat li."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْزِلُنَا ـ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، إِذَا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ ـ الْخَيْفُ، حَيْثُ تَقَاسَمُوا عَلَى الْكُفْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If Allah makes us victorious, our encamping place will be Al-Khaif, the place where the infidels took an oath to be loyal to Heathenism (by boycotting Banu Hashim, the Prophet's folk)
64.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Agar Allah humein fatah deta hai, humara padaav Al-Khaif hoga, jahaan kaafiron ne jhoote buton (yaani but-parasti) ke prati wafadaar rehne ki qasam khaee thi (Banu Hashim, Nabi ke khaandaan ka bahishkaar karte huye)."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ أَرَادَ حُنَيْنًا ‏ "‏ مَنْزِلُنَا غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِخَيْفِ بَنِي كِنَانَةَ، حَيْثُ تَقَاسَمُوا عَلَى الْكُفْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) intended to carry on the Ghazwa of Hunain, he said, "Tomorrow, if Allah wished, our encamping) plaice will be Khaif Bani Kinana where (the infidels) took an oath to be loyal to Heathenism
64.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool ne Hunain ke Ghazwe ke liye jane ka irada kiya, unhone kaha, "Kal, Insha Allah, humara padaav Khaif Bani Kinana hoga jahaan (kaafiron ne) jhoote buton (yaani but-parasti) ke prati wafadaar rehne ki qasam khaee thi."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ الْمِغْفَرُ، فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ ابْنُ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْتُلْهُ ‏"‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ وَلَمْ يَكُنِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا نُرَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُحْرِمًا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:On the day of the Conquest, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head. When he took it off, a man came and said, "Ibn Khatal is clinging to the curtain of the Ka`ba." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill him." (Malik a sub-narrator said, "On that day the Prophet (ﷺ) was not in a state of Ihram as it appeared to us, and Allah knows better
64.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah ke din, Nabi ne Mecca mein pravesh kiya, apne sar par ek khod pahne hue. Jab unhone ise utaara, ek shaks aaya aur kaha, "Ibn Khatal Ka'ba ke parde se chipka hua hai." Nabi ne kaha, "Unhe qatl karo." (Subordinate raawi, Malik ne kaha, "Us din Nabi Ihram ki haalat mein nahi the jaisa humein lagta hai, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai.")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ وَحَوْلَ الْبَيْتِ سِتُّونَ وَثَلاَثُمِائَةِ نُصُبٍ، فَجَعَلَ يَطْعُنُهَا بِعُودٍ فِي يَدِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ، جَاءَ الْحَقُّ، وَمَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abdullah:When the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca on the day of the Conquest, there were 360 idols around the Ka`ba. The Prophet (ﷺ) started striking them with a stick he had in his hand and was saying, "Truth has come and Falsehood will neither start nor will it reappear
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Fatah ke din Mecca mein daakhil hue, Ka'ba ke aas-paas teen saath (360) but the. Nabi ne apne haath mein pakdi ek laathi se unhe maarna shuru kiya aur kah rahe the, "Sach aa gaya hai, aur jhoot na uthega na phir prakat hoga."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ أَبَى أَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْبَيْتَ وَفِيهِ الآلِهَةُ، فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَأُخْرِجَتْ، فَأُخْرِجَ صُورَةُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمَا مِنَ الأَزْلاَمِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَاتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ لَقَدْ عَلِمُوا مَا اسْتَقْسَمَا بِهَا قَطُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ، فَكَبَّرَ فِي نَوَاحِي الْبَيْتِ، وَخَرَجَ وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ فِيهِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in Mecca, he refused to enter the Ka`ba while there were idols in it. So he ordered that they be taken out. The pictures of the (Prophets) Abraham and Ishmael, holding arrows of divination in their hands, were carried out. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah ruin them (i.e. the infidels) for they knew very well that they (i.e. Abraham and Ishmael) never drew lots by these (divination arrows). Then the Prophet (ﷺ) entered the Ka`ba and said. "Allahu Akbar" in all its directions and came out and did not offer any prayer therein
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool Mecca pahunche, unhone Ka'ba mein daakhil hone se inkaar kiya jab tak usmein but the. Isliye unhone unhe bahar nikalne ka hukum diya. Ibrahim aur Ismail (Nabiyon) ki chitren, jinke haathon mein peshangoi ke teer the, bahar nikali gaee. Nabi ne kaha, "Allah unhe (yaani kaafiron ko) barbaad kare, kyunke unhe achhi tarah pata tha ke unhone (yaani Ibrahim aur Ismail ne) kabhi in (peshangoi ke) teer se qura nahi kiya." Phir Nabi ne Ka'ba mein pravesh kiya aur uski har taraf mein "Allahu Akbar" kaha aur bahar aaye aur wahaan koee namaz nahi padhi.

64.ar: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْبَلَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ مِنْ أَعْلَى مَكَّةَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، مُرْدِفًا أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ وَمَعَهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، مِنَ الْحَجَبَةِ حَتَّى أَنَاخَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِمِفْتَاحِ الْبَيْتِ، فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَبِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، فَمَكَثَ فِيهِ نَهَارًا طَوِيلاً ثُمَّ خَرَجَ، فَاسْتَبَقَ النَّاسُ، فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ دَخَلَ، فَوَجَدَ بِلاَلاً وَرَاءَ الْبَابِ قَائِمًا، فَسَأَلَهُ أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَشَارَ لَهُ إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَنَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ كَمْ صَلَّى مِنْ سَجْدَةٍ
64.en: Narrated 'Abdullãh bin 'Umar (ra):Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Makkah through its upper part and he was riding his she-camel. Usãma bin Zaid was his Companion-rider behind him (on the same she-camel). In his company were Bilãl and 'Uthmãn bin Talha, who was one of the Al-Hajabah (who keep the key of the gate of the Ka'bah). When he made his she-camel kneel down in the Mosque (i.e., Al-Masjid al-Haram), he ordered him (i.e., 'Uthman) to bring the key of the Ka'bah. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the Ka'bah along with 'Usãma bin Zaid, Bilãl and 'Uthmãn bin Talha, and he stayed in it for a long period and then came out. The people rushed (to get in) and `Abdullãh bin 'Umar was the first to enter and he found Bilãl standing behind the door. Ibn `Umar asked Bilãl, "Where did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offer the Salat (prayer)?" Bilãl showed him the place where he (ﷺ) had offered Salat (prayer). `Abdullah later on said, "I forgot to ask Bilãl how many prostrations (i.e., Rak'a) the Prophet offered
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Mecca mein uske oonche hisse se pravesh kiya, apni untni par sawar hokar. Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) unke saath ek hi untni par peeche baithe the. Unke saath Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) the, jo Al-Hajabah mein se ek the (jo Ka'ba ke darwaze ki chaabi rakhte hain). Jab unhone apni untni masjid mein bithaee (yaani Al-Masjid-ul-Haram mein), unhone unhe (yaani Uthman ko) Ka'ba ki chaabi lane ka hukum diya. Phir Allah ke Rasool ne Usama bin Zaid, Bilal, aur Uthman bin Talha ke saath Ka'ba mein pravesh kiya, aur woh ismein ek lambe waqt tak ruke aur phir bahar aaye. Log andar jane ke liye daude, aur Abdullah bin Umar sabse pahle daakhil hue aur unhone Bilal ko darwaze ke peeche khade paaya. Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Bilal se pucha, "Allah ke Rasool ne namaz kahaan padhi?" Bilal ne unhe woh jagah dikhaee jahaan unhone namaz padhi thi. Abdullah ne baad mein kaha, "Main Bilal se puchna bhool gaya ki Nabi ne kitni rakaten padhi thi."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ خَارِجَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ مِنْ كَدَاءٍ الَّتِي بِأَعْلَى مَكَّةَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَوُهَيْبٌ فِي كَدَاءٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:During the year of the Conquest (of Mecca), the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca through Kada which was at the upper part of Mecca
64.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Fatah ke saal, Nabi Mecca mein Kada se daakhil hue, jo Mecca ke oonche hisse mein tha.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ مِنْ أَعْلَى مَكَّةَ مِنْ كَدَاءٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Hisham's father:During the year of the Conquest (of Mecca), the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca through its upper part through Kada
64.hi: Hisham ke waalid bataate hain: Fatah ke saal, Nabi Mecca mein uske oonche hisse se Kada se daakhil hue.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، مَا أَخْبَرَنَا أَحَدٌ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى غَيْرَ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ، فَإِنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ أَنَّهُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ اغْتَسَلَ فِي بَيْتِهَا ثُمَّ صَلَّى ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ، قَالَتْ لَمْ أَرَهُ صَلَّى صَلاَةً أَخَفَّ مِنْهَا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:None informed us that he saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha (i.e. forenoon) prayer, except Um Hani who mentioned that the Prophet (ﷺ) took a bath in her house on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) and then offered an eight rak`at prayer. She added, "I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering a lighter prayer than that prayer, but he was performing perfect bowing and prostrations
64.hi: Ibn Abi Laila bataate hain: Humein kisi ne bhi yeh nahi bataya ke unhone Nabi ko Duha (yaani dopahar se pahle ki) namaz padhte dekha, siwaye Um Hani ke jinhone zikar kiya ke Nabi ne unke ghar mein Fatah ke din ghusal kiya aur phir aath rakaton ki namaz padhi. Unhone joda, "Maine Nabi ko us namaz se halki koee namaz kabhi nahi padhte dekha, magar woh poori tarah ruku aur sajda kar rahe the."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَسُجُودِهِ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ، رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated 'Aishah (ra):The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say in his bowings and prostrations, "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbanã wa bihamdika, Allãhumma ighfirli" (Glorified be You, O Allah, our Lord! All the praises are for You. O Allah, forgive me)
64.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi apne ruku aur sajdon mein kaha karte the, "Subhanaka Allahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfirli" (yaani Aapki pavitrata ho, Aye Allah, humare Rab! Sab taarifen tere liye hain. Aye Allah, mujhe maaf kar).

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ يُدْخِلُنِي مَعَ أَشْيَاخِ بَدْرٍ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِمَ تُدْخِلُ هَذَا الْفَتَى مَعَنَا، وَلَنَا أَبْنَاءٌ مِثْلُهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ مِمَّنْ قَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعَاهُمْ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، وَدَعَانِي مَعَهُمْ قَالَ وَمَا رُئِيتُهُ دَعَانِي يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ لِيُرِيَهُمْ مِنِّي فَقَالَ مَا تَقُولُونَ ‏{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ * وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ‏}‏ حَتَّى خَتَمَ السُّورَةَ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ أُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَحْمَدَ اللَّهَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرَهُ، إِذَا نُصِرْنَا وَفُتِحَ عَلَيْنَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ نَدْرِي‏.‏ أَوْ لَمْ يَقُلْ بَعْضُهُمْ شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَكَذَاكَ تَقُولُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا تَقُولُ قُلْتُ هُوَ أَجَلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْلَمَهُ اللَّهُ لَهُ ‏{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ فَتْحُ مَكَّةَ، فَذَاكَ عَلاَمَةُ أَجَلِكَ ‏{‏فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا‏}‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ مَا تَعْلَمُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:`Umar used to admit me (into his house) along with the old men who had fought in the Badr battle. Some of them said (to `Umar), "Why do you allow this young man to enter with us, while we have sons of his own age? " `Umar said, "You know what person he is." One day `Umar called them and called me along with them, I had thought he called me on that day to show them something about me (i.e. my knowledge). `Umar asked them, "What do you say about (the Sura): "When comes the help of Allah and the Conquest (of Mecca) And you see mankind entering the Religion of Allah (i.e. Islam) in crowds. 'So celebrate the Praises Of your Lord and ask for His forgiveness, Truly, He is the One Who accepts repentance and forgives." (110.1-3) Some of them replied, "We are ordered to praise Allah and repent to Him if we are helped and granted victory." Some said, "We do not know." Others kept quiet. `Umar then said to me, "Do you say similarly?" I said, "No." `Umar said "What do you say then?" I said, "This Verse indicates the approaching of the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) of which Allah informed him. When comes the help of Allah and the Conquest, i.e. the Conquest of Mecca, that will be the sign of your Prophet's) approaching death, so testify the uniqueness of your Lord (i.e. Allah) and praise Him and repent to Him as He is ready to forgive." On that, `Umar said, "I do not know about it anything other than what you know
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) mujhe (apne ghar mein) un boodhe logon ke saath daakhil hone dete the jinhone Badr ki jung mein hissa liya tha. Unmein se kuch ne (Umar se) kaha, "Aap is jawan shaks ko humare saath aane kyun dete hain, jabke humare khud ke bete bhi unki hi umr ke hain?" Umar ne kaha, "Tumhe pata hai woh kaisa shaks hain." Ek din Umar ne unhe bulaya aur mujhe bhi unke saath bulaya, aur maine socha unhone mujhe us din is liye bulaya taaki woh (unke saamne) mera kuch dikha sakon (yaani mera ilm). Umar ne unse pucha, "Aap in (Surah) ke baare mein kya kahte hain: 'Jab Allah ki madad aati hai aur Vijay (yaani Mecca ki fatah), aur aap dekhte hain log dal ke dal Allah ke deen (yaani Islam) mein daakhil ho rahe hain, isliye apne Rab ki taarif gaiye aur usse kshama maangiye. Wahi hai jo tauba qubool karta hai aur maaf karta hai.'" (110:1-3) Unmein se kuch ne jawab diya, "Humein hukum diya gaya hai ke agar humein madad aur fatah di jaaye, hum Allah ki taarif karen aur usse tauba karen." Kuch ne kaha, "Humein nahi pata." Doosre khaamosh rahe. Umar ne phir mujhse kaha, "Kya tum bhi yehi kahte ho?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Umar ne pucha, "Phir tum kya kahte ho?" Maine kaha, "Yeh Ayat Allah ke Rasool ki nikat wafat ka ishara karti hai jiski Allah ne unhe khabar di thi. 'Jab Allah ki madad aur Vijay aae,' yaani Mecca ki fatah, yehi aapke Nabi ki nikat maut ka nishaan hoga, isliye apne Rab ki ekta ki gawahi dijiye aur uski taarif kijiye aur usse tauba kijiye kyunke woh maaf karne ke liye taiyaar hai." Ispar, Umar ne kaha, "Mujhe iske baare mein wahi pata hai jo tumhe pata hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَهْوَ يَبْعَثُ الْبُعُوثَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ ائْذَنْ لِي أَيُّهَا الأَمِيرُ أُحَدِّثْكَ قَوْلاً قَامَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْغَدَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ، سَمِعَتْهُ أُذُنَاىَ وَوَعَاهُ قَلْبِي، وَأَبْصَرَتْهُ عَيْنَاىَ، حِينَ تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مَكَّةَ حَرَّمَهَا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُحَرِّمْهَا النَّاسُ، لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرِئٍ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ يَسْفِكَ بِهَا دَمًا، وَلاَ يَعْضِدَ بِهَا شَجَرًا، فَإِنْ أَحَدٌ تَرَخَّصَ لِقِتَالِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا فَقُولُوا لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَذِنَ لِرَسُولِهِ، وَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَكُمْ‏.‏ وَإِنَّمَا أَذِنَ لِي فِيهَا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، وَقَدْ عَادَتْ حُرْمَتُهَا الْيَوْمَ كَحُرْمَتِهَا بِالأَمْسِ، وَلْيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لأَبِي شُرَيْحٍ مَاذَا قَالَ لَكَ عَمْرٌو قَالَ قَالَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ مِنْكَ يَا أَبَا شُرَيْحٍ، إِنَّ الْحَرَمَ لاَ يُعِيذُ عَاصِيًا، وَلاَ فَارًّا بِدَمٍ، وَلاَ فَارًّا بِخَرْبَةٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Shuraih:Al-Adawi that he said to `Amr bin Sa`id while the latter was sending troops in batches to Mecca, "O chief! Allow me to tell you a statement which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the second day of the Conquest of Mecca. My two ears heard it and my heart remembered it and my two eyes saw him when he said it. He (i.e. the Prophet) praised Allah and then said, 'Mecca has been made a sanctuary by Allah and not by the people, so it is not lawful for a person, who believes in Allah and the Last Day to shed blood in it, or to cut its trees and if someone asks the permission to fight in Mecca because Allah's Apostle was allowed to fight in it, say to him; Allah permitted His Apostle and did not allow you, and even he (i.e. the Apostle) was allowed for a short period of the day, and today its (Mecca's sanctity has become the same as it was before (of old) so those who are present should inform those who are absent (this Hadith)." Then Abu Shuraih, was asked, "What did `Amr say to you? Abu Shuraih said, "He said, "I knew that better than you, O Abu Shuraih! The Haram (i.e. Mecca) does not give refuge to a sinner or a fleeing murderer or a person running away after causing destruction
64.hi: Abu Shuraih (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Adawi ne Amr bin Sa'id se kaha jabke woh Mecca ki taraf dale-dale sainikon ko bhej rahe the, "Aye sardaar! Mujhe aapko ek baat batane dijiye jo Allah ke Rasool ne Mecca ki Fatah ke doosre din kahi thi. Mere donon kaan ne ise suna aur mere dil ne ise yaad rakha aur meri donon aankhon ne unhe dekha jab unhone ise kaha. Unhone (yaani Nabi ne) Allah ki taarif ki aur phir kaha, 'Mecca ko Allah ne pavitra banaya hai, na ke logon ne, isliye yeh kisi aise shaks ke liye jaayaz nahi hai jo Allah aur Akhirat ke din par iman rakhta ho ke woh yahaan khoon bahaye, ya iske darakhton ko kate; aur agar koee yeh kahne ki ijazat maangta hai ke woh Mecca mein jung kar sakta hai kyunke Allah ke Rasool ko ismein jung karne ki ijazat mili thi, unse kaho; Allah ne apne Rasool ko ijazat di aur tumhe nahi, aur unhe bhi din ke ek chhote hisse ke liye hi ijazat mili thi, aur aaj iski pavitrata phir waisi hi ho gaee hai jaisi woh pahle thi, isliye jo yahaan hain unhe jinke yahaan nahi hain unhe iski khabar deni chahiye (yeh Hadith).'" Phir Abu Shuraih se pucha gaya, "Amr ne aapko kya kaha?" Abu Shuraih ne kaha, "Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe yeh tumse behtar pata hai, Aye Abu Shuraih! Al-Haram (yaani Mecca) kisi gunahgaar ko, ya bhaagte hue qaatil ko, ya tabaahi phailane ke baad bhaagte hue kisi insaan ko panah nahi deta.'"

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَهْوَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ حَرَّمَ بَيْعَ الْخَمْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying in the year of the Conquest (of Mecca) while he was in Mecca, "Allah and His Apostle have made the selling of wine (i.e. alcoholic drinks) unlawful
64.hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool ko Fatah ke saal, jabke woh Mecca mein the, yeh kahte huye suna, "Allah aur uske Rasool ne sharab (yaani nashile pey padaarthon) ka vyaapaar haram kar diya hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ،‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَقَمْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشْرًا نَقْصُرُ الصَّلاَةَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Anas:We stayed (in Mecca) for ten days along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to offer shortened prayers (i.e. journey prayers)
64.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Hum (Mecca mein) das din tak Nabi ke saath ruke aur usmein hum choti (yaani safar ki) namazen padhte rahe.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما قَالَ أَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْمًا يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for 19 days during which he prayed 2 rak`at in each prayer
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi Mecca mein unnees din ruke jinke dauran unhone har namaz mein do rakaten padhi.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَقَمْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ نَقْصُرُ الصَّلاَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَنَحْنُ نَقْصُرُ مَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ، فَإِذَا زِدْنَا أَتْمَمْنَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said, "We stayed for 19 days with the Prophet on a journey during which we used to offer shortened prayers." Ibn `Abbas added, "We offer the Qasr prayer (i.e. shortened prayer) If we stay up to 19 days as travelers, But if we stay longer, we offer complete prayers
64.hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Hum ek safar ke dauran Nabi ke saath unnees din ruke jinke dauran hum choti (yaani safar ki) namazen padhte the." Ibn Abbas ne joda, "Hum Qasr (yaani choti) namaz padhte hain agar hum yaatriyon ke tor par unnees din tak rukte hain, magar agar hum isse zyada rukte hain, hum poori namaz padhte hain."

64.ar: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ صُعَيْرٍ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ مَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin Tha`laba bin Su`air whose face was rubbed by the Prophet during the year of the Conquest (of Makkah)
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Tha'laba bin Su'air bataate hain, jinke chehre ko Nabi ne Fatah ke saal (apne haathon se muhabbat se) chhuya tha.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سُنَيْنٍ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا وَنَحْنُ، مَعَ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ قَالَ وَزَعَمَ أَبُو جَمِيلَةَ أَنَّهُ أَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَخَرَجَ مَعَهُ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Az-Zuhri:While we were in the company of Ibn Al-Musaiyab, Sunain Abi Jamila informed us (a Hadith), Abu Jamila said that he lived during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) and that he had accompanied him ( to Mecca) during the year of the Conquest (of Mecca)
64.hi: Az-Zuhri bataate hain: Jabke hum Ibn Al-Musaiyab ki sohbat mein the, Sunain Abi Jamila ne humein ek Hadith sunaee. Abu Jamila ne kaha ke woh Nabi ki zindagi mein rahte the aur unhone Fatah ke saal unke saath (Mecca) jane ka saath diya tha.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَلِمَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ أَلاَ تَلْقَاهُ فَتَسْأَلَهُ، قَالَ فَلَقِيتُهُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ كُنَّا بِمَاءٍ مَمَرَّ النَّاسِ، وَكَانَ يَمُرُّ بِنَا الرُّكْبَانُ فَنَسْأَلُهُمْ مَا لِلنَّاسِ مَا لِلنَّاسِ مَا هَذَا الرَّجُلُ فَيَقُولُونَ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَرْسَلَهُ أَوْحَى إِلَيْهِ، أَوْ أَوْحَى اللَّهُ بِكَذَا‏.‏ فَكُنْتُ أَحْفَظُ ذَلِكَ الْكَلاَمَ، وَكَأَنَّمَا يُغْرَى فِي صَدْرِي، وَكَانَتِ الْعَرَبُ تَلَوَّمُ بِإِسْلاَمِهِمِ الْفَتْحَ، فَيَقُولُونَ اتْرُكُوهُ وَقَوْمَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ ظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَهْوَ نَبِيٌّ صَادِقٌ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ وَقْعَةُ أَهْلِ الْفَتْحِ بَادَرَ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِإِسْلاَمِهِمْ، وَبَدَرَ أَبِي قَوْمِي بِإِسْلاَمِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ قَالَ جِئْتُكُمْ وَاللَّهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقًّا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلُّوا صَلاَةَ كَذَا فِي حِينِ كَذَا، وَصَلُّوا كَذَا فِي حِينِ كَذَا، فَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ أَحَدُكُمْ، وَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْثَرُكُمْ قُرْآنًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَظَرُوا فَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ أَكْثَرَ قُرْآنًا مِنِّي، لِمَا كُنْتُ أَتَلَقَّى مِنَ الرُّكْبَانِ، فَقَدَّمُونِي بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ، وَأَنَا ابْنُ سِتٍّ أَوْ سَبْعِ، سِنِينَ وَكَانَتْ عَلَىَّ بُرْدَةٌ، كُنْتُ إِذَا سَجَدْتُ تَقَلَّصَتْ عَنِّي، فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْحَىِّ أَلاَ تُغَطُّوا عَنَّا اسْتَ قَارِئِكُمْ‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَوْا فَقَطَعُوا لِي قَمِيصًا، فَمَا فَرِحْتُ بِشَىْءٍ فَرَحِي بِذَلِكَ الْقَمِيصِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Amr bin Salama:We were at a place which was a thoroughfare for the people, and the caravans used to pass by us and we would ask them, "What is wrong with the people? What is wrong with the people? Who is that man?. They would say, "That man claims that Allah has sent him (as an Apostle), that he has been divinely inspired, that Allah has revealed to him such-and-such." I used to memorize that (Divine) Talk, and feel as if it was inculcated in my chest (i.e. mind) And the 'Arabs (other than Quraish) delayed their conversion to Islam till the Conquest (of Mecca). They used to say." "Leave him (i.e. Muhammad) and his people Quraish: if he overpowers them then he is a true Prophet. So, when Mecca was conquered, then every tribe rushed to embrace Islam, and my father hurried to embrace Islam before (the other members of) my tribe. When my father returned (from the Prophet) to his tribe, he said, "By Allah, I have come to you from the Prophet (ﷺ) for sure!" The Prophet (ﷺ) afterwards said to them, 'Offer such-and-such prayer at such-and-such time, and when the time for the prayer becomes due, then one of you should pronounce the Adhan (for the prayer), and let the one amongst you who knows Qur'an most should, lead the prayer." So they looked for such a person and found none who knew more Qur'an than I because of the Qur'anic material which I used to learn from the caravans. They therefore made me their Imam ((to lead the prayer) and at that time I was a boy of six or seven years, wearing a Burda (i.e. a black square garment) proved to be very short for me (and my body became partly naked). A lady from the tribe said, "Won't you cover the anus of your reciter for us?" So they bought (a piece of cloth) and made a shirt for me. I had never been so happy with anything before as I was with that shirt
64.hi: Amr bin Salama bataate hain: Hum ek aisi jagah par the jo logon ka aane-jane ka raasta thi, aur caravan humare paas se guzarte the aur hum unse puchte, "Logon ko kya hua hai? Logon ko kya hua hai? Woh shaks kaun hai?" Woh kahte, "Woh shaks daava karta hai ke Allah ne unhe (Nabi ke tor par) bheja hai, ke unhe Divine ilham mila hai, ke Allah ne unpar falaan-falaan nazil kiya hai." Main us (Divine) baat ko yaad rakhta tha aur mahsoos karta tha mano yeh mere seene (yaani manasika) mein ghusa hua ho. Aur (doosre) Arb log (Quraish ke ilawa) apni Islam qubool karne ki taarikh ko Fatah tak deri karte rahe. Woh kahte, "Leave unhe (yaani Muhammad ko) aur unki qaum Quraish ko chhod do: agar woh unpar haavi ho jate hain, phir woh ek sachcha Nabi hain." Isliye jab Mecca fatah huee, har qabile ne Islam qubool karne ke liye daud lagaee, aur mere waalid ne apni qaum se pahle Islam qubool karne ki jaldbaazi ki. Jab mere waalid (Nabi se milne ke baad) apni qaum ke paas wapas aaye, unhone kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main sach mein Nabi ki taraf se tumhare paas aaya hoon!" Nabi ne baad mein unse kaha, "Falaan-falaan namaz falaan-falaan waqt par padho, aur jab namaz ka waqt aa jaye, tummein se koee ek Adhan de, aur tummein se jo Quran sabse zyada jaanta ho use Imam banaya jaaye." Isliye unhone aise shaks ko dhoondha aur mujhse behtar koee nahi mila kyunke maine caravan se jitna Quranic saamagri seekhi thi. Isliye unhone mujhe apna Imam bana diya, aur us waqt main chhah ya saat saal ka bachcha tha, ek Burda (yaani ek kaala vaiga kapda) pahne hue jo mere liye bahut chhota saabit hua (aur mera shareer thoda nanga ho gaya). Qabile ki ek mahilla ne kaha, "Kya aap humare liye humare padhne wale (yaani mujhe) ki peeth ko dhaank nahi sakte?" Isliye unhone (kapde ka ek tukda) khareeda aur mere liye ek qameej banaee. Maine kabhi kisi cheez se itni khushi mahsoos nahi ki jitni us qameej se ki.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ كَانَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَهِدَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ سَعْدٍ أَنْ يَقْبِضَ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، وَقَالَ عُتْبَةُ إِنَّهُ ابْنِي‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ فِي الْفَتْحِ أَخَذَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَأَقْبَلَ مَعَهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ، فَقَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ هَذَا ابْنُ أَخِي، عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ابْنُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا أَخِي، هَذَا ابْنُ زَمْعَةَ، وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى ابْنِ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، فَإِذَا أَشْبَهُ النَّاسِ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ لَكَ، هُوَ أَخُوكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ، وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ يَا سَوْدَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِمَا رَأَى مِنْ شَبَهِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَكَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يَصِيحُ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:`Utba bin Abi Waqqas authorized his brother Sa`d to take the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a into his custody. `Utba said (to him). "He is my son." When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in Mecca during the Conquest (of Mecca), Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas took the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and took him to the Prophet (ﷺ) `Abd bin Zam`a too came along with him. Sa`d said. "This is the son of my brother and the latter has informed me that he is his son." `Abd bin Zam`a said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This is my brother who is the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and was born on his (i.e. Zam'as) bed.' Allah's Apostle looked at the son of the slave-girl of Zam`a and noticed that he, of all the people had the greatest resemblance to `Utba bin Abi Waqqas. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said (to `Abd), " He is yours; he is your brother, O `Abd bin Zam`a, he was born on the bed (of your father)." (At the same time) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to his wife Sauda), "Veil yourself before him (i.e. the son of the slave-girl) O Sauda," because of the resemblance he noticed between him and `Utba bin Abi Waqqas. Allah's Apostle added, "The boy is for the bed (i.e. for the owner of the bed where he was born), and stone is for the adulterer." (Ibn Shihab said, "Abu Huraira used to say that (i.e. the last statement of the Prophet in the above Hadith 596, publicly)
64.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Utba bin Abi Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd ko Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko apni hifaazat mein lene ka ikhtiyar diya. Utba ne (unse) kaha, "Woh mera beta hai." Jab Allah ke Rasool Fatah ke dauran Mecca pahunche, Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ko liya aur use Nabi ke paas le gaye. Abd bin Zam'a bhi unke saath aaye. Sa'd ne kaha, "Yeh mere bhai ka beta hai aur unhone mujhe bataya ke woh unka beta hai." Abd bin Zam'a ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Yeh mera bhai hai, jo Zam'a ki launDi ka beta hai aur unke (yaani Zam'a ke) bistar par paida hua tha." Allah ke Rasool ne Zam'a ki launDi ke bete ki taraf dekha aur mahsoos kiya ke woh, sab logon mein se, Utba bin Abi Waqqas se sabse zyada milta-julta tha. Allah ke Rasool ne phir (Abd se) kaha, "Woh tumhara hai; woh tumhara bhai hai, Aye Abd bin Zam'a, woh (tumhare waalid ke) bistar par paida hua tha." (usi waqt) Allah ke Rasool ne (apni biwi Sauda (رضی اللہ عنہا) se) kaha, "Unke saamne parda karo (yaani launDi ke bete ke), Aye Sauda," us milte-julte soorat ki wajah se jo unhone Utba bin Abi Waqqas ke saath dekha tha. Allah ke Rasool ne joda, "Bachcha uski hai jinke bistar par woh paida hua (yaani jiska woh bistar hai), aur zina karne wale ke liye pathar (yaani saza)." (Ibn Shihab ne kaha, "Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the ke [yeh aakhri farmaan upar wali Hadith 596 mein] khule-aam kaha gaya tha.")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَرَقَتْ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةِ الْفَتْحِ، فَفَزِعَ قَوْمُهَا إِلَى أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ يَسْتَشْفِعُونَهُ، قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ فِيهَا تَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتُكَلِّمُنِي فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أُسَامَةُ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَشِيُّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطِيبًا، فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ النَّاسَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ، وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمِ الضَّعِيفُ أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ، لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتِلْكَ الْمَرْأَةِ، فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهَا، فَحَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَتَزَوَّجَتْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَتْ تَأْتِي بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَأَرْفَعُ حَاجَتَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:A lady committed theft during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Ghazwa of Al-Fath, ((i.e. Conquest of Mecca). Her folk went to Usama bin Zaid to intercede for her (with the Prophet). When Usama interceded for her with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), the color of the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed and he said, "Do you intercede with me in a matter involving one of the legal punishments prescribed by Allah?" Usama said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Ask Allah's Forgiveness for me." So in the afternoon, Allah's Apostle got up and addressed the people. He praised Allah as He deserved and then said, "Amma ba'du ! The nations prior to you were destroyed because if a noble amongst them stole, they used to excuse him, and if a poor person amongst them stole, they would apply (Allah's) Legal Punishment to him. By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad stole, I would cut her hand." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his order in the case of that woman and her hand was cut off. Afterwards her repentance proved sincere and she got married. `Aisha said, "That lady used to visit me and I used to convey her demands to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
64.hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek mahilla ne Allah ke Rasool ki zindagi mein Ghazwa Al-Fath (yaani Mecca ki Fatah) ke dauran chori ki. Unke log Usama bin Zaid (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke paas gaye taaki woh unke liye (Nabi se) sifarish karen. Jab Usama ne Allah ke Rasool se unke liye sifarish ki, Allah ke Rasool ke chehre ka rang badal gaya aur unhone kaha, "Kya tum mujhse ek aise maamle mein sifarish kar rahe ho jismein Allah ke nirdharit qanooni sazaon mein se ek shaamil hai?" Usama ne kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye Allah se maafi maangiye." Isliye dopahar ko, Allah ke Rasool uthe aur logon ko sambodhit kiya. Unhone Allah ki taarif ki jaisa woh deserve karte hain, aur phir kaha, "Amma Ba'du! Tumse pahle ki qaumen isliye barbaad huee kyunke agar unmein se koee izzatdaar shaks chori karta, woh unhe maaf kar dete, magar agar koee gareeb shaks chori karta, woh unpar (Allah ka) qanooni saza laagu karte. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haathon mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, agar Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا), Muhammad ki beti, chori karti, main unka haath kaatta." Phir Allah ke Rasool ne us aurat ke maamle mein apna hukum diya aur unka haath kaata gaya. Baad mein unki tauba sachchi saabit huee aur unki shaadi ho gaee. Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, "Woh mahilla mujhse milne aati thi aur main unki guzaarishen Allah ke Rasool tak pahunchati thi."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُجَاشِعٌ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَخِي بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، جِئْتُكَ بِأَخِي لِتُبَايِعَهُ عَلَى الْهِجْرَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَهَبَ أَهْلُ الْهِجْرَةِ بِمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ تُبَايِعُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أُبَايِعُهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالْجِهَادِ‏" فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ بَعْدُ وَكَانَ أَكْبَرَهُمَا فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ مُجَاشِعٌ‏
64.en: Narrated Mujashi:I took my brother to the Prophet (ﷺ) after the Conquest (of Mecca) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have come to you with my brother so that you may take a pledge of allegiance from him for migration." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, The people of migration (i.e. those who migrated to Medina before the Conquest) enjoyed the privileges of migration (i.e. there is no need for migration anymore)." I said to the Prophet, "For what will you take his pledge of allegiance?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will take his pledge of allegiance for Islam, Belief, and for Jihad (i.e. fighting in Allah's Cause)
64.hi: Mujashi bataate hain: Main apne bhai ko Fatah ke baad Nabi ke paas lekar gaya aur kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Main aapke paas apne bhai ke saath aaya hoon taaki aap hijrat ke liye unse bai'at len." Nabi ne kaha, "Hijrat karne walon (yaani jinhone Fatah se pahle Madina hijrat ki thi) ne hijrat ke sab labh utha liye (isliye ab hijrat ki zaroorat nahi hai)." Maine Nabi se kaha, "Phir aap unse kis cheez ke liye bai'at lenge?" Nabi ne kaha, "Main unse Islam, Iman, aur Jihad (yaani Allah ki raah mein jung) ke liye bai'at lunga."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ مُجَاشِعِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، انْطَلَقْتُ بِأَبِي مَعْبَدٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُبَايِعَهُ عَلَى الْهِجْرَةِ، قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَضَتِ الْهِجْرَةُ لأَهْلِهَا، أُبَايِعُهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَالْجِهَادِ." فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ مُجَاشِعٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ خَالِدٌ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُجَاشِعٍ أَنَّهُ جَاءَ بِأَخِيهِ مُجَالِدٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Mujashi bin Masud:I took Abu Mabad to the Prophet (ﷺ) in order that he might give him the pledge of allegiance for migration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Migration has gone to its people, but I take the pledge from him (i.e. Abu Mabad) for Islam and Jihad
64.hi: Mujashi bin Masud bataate hain: Main Abu Mabad ko Nabi ke paas lekar gaya taaki woh unhe hijrat ke liye bai'at den. Nabi ne kaha, "Hijrat unke logon ke paas ja chuki hai, magar main unse (yaani Abu Mabad se) Islam aur Jihad ke liye bai'at lunga."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُهَاجِرَ إِلَى الشَّأْمِ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ هِجْرَةَ وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ، فَانْطَلِقْ فَاعْرِضْ نَفْسَكَ، فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ شَيْئًا وَإِلاَّ رَجَعْتَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Mujahid:I said to Ibn `Umar, "I want to migrate to Sham." He said, "There is no migration, but Jihad (for Allah's Cause). Go and offer yourself for Jihad, and if you find an opportunity for Jihad (stay there) otherwise, come back
64.hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Maine Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) se kaha, "Main Sham hijrat karna chahta hoon." Unhone kaha, "Ab koee hijrat nahi hai, magar Jihad (Allah ki raah mein) hai. Jaao aur Jihad ke liye khud ko pesh karo, aur agar tumhe Jihad ka koee mauka milta hai (wahaan ruko) warna, wapas aa jao."

64.ar: وَقَالَ النَّضْرُ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ لاَ هِجْرَةَ الْيَوْمَ، أَوْ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
64.en: (In another narration) Ibn `Umar said:"There is no migration today or after Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." (and completed his statement as above)
64.hi: (ek doosri riwaayat mein) Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: "Aaj ya Allah ke Rasool ke baad koee hijrat nahi hai." (aur upar jaisa hi apni baat poori ki)

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَمْرٍو الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ الْمَكِّيِّ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ يَقُولُ لاَ هِجْرَةَ بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Mujahid bin Jabr:`Abdullah bin `Umar used to say, "There is no migration after the Conquest (of Mecca)
64.hi: Mujahid bin Jabr bataate hain: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) kaha karte the, "Fatah (Mecca) ke baad koee hijrat nahi hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ زُرْتُ عَائِشَةَ مَعَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ فَسَأَلَهَا عَنِ الْهِجْرَةِ، فَقَالَتْ لاَ هِجْرَةَ الْيَوْمَ، كَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَفِرُّ أَحَدُهُمْ بِدِينِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يُفْتَنَ عَلَيْهِ، فَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَقَدْ أَظْهَرَ اللَّهُ الإِسْلاَمَ، فَالْمُؤْمِنُ يَعْبُدُ رَبَّهُ حَيْثُ شَاءَ، وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةٌ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Ata' bin Abi Rabah:`Ubaid bin `Umar and I visited `Aisha, and he asked her about the migration. She said, "There is no migration today. A believer used to flee with his religion to Allah and His Prophet for fear that he might be put to trial as regards his religion. Today Allah has rendered Islam victorious; therefore a believing one can worship one's Lord wherever one wishes. But there is Jihad (for Allah's Cause) and intentions." (See Hadith 42, in the 4th Vol. for its Explanation)
64.hi: Ata bin Abi Rabah bataate hain: Ubaid bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) aur main Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) se mile, aur unhone unse hijrat ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, "Aaj koee hijrat nahi hai. Ek momin apne deen ke saath Allah aur uske Nabi ki taraf bhaagta tha is dar se ke use apne deen ke baare mein aazmaish na jhelni pade. Aaj Allah ne Islam ko fatah dilaee hai; isliye ek momin jahaan chahe apne Rab ki ibadat kar sakta hai. Magar Jihad aur (achhi) niyyaten (abhi bhi ajr wale hain)."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَامَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ، فَهْىَ حَرَامٌ بِحَرَامِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، لَمْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي، وَلاَ تَحِلُّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي، وَلَمْ تَحْلِلْ لِي إِلاَّ سَاعَةً مِنَ الدَّهْرِ، لاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا، وَلاَ يُعْضَدُ شَوْكُهَا، وَلاَ يُخْتَلَى خَلاَهَا وَلاَ تَحِلُّ لُقَطَتُهَا إِلاَّ لِمُنْشِدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهُ لِلْقَيْنِ وَالْبُيُوتِ، فَسَكَتَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ فَإِنَّهُ حَلاَلٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ بِمِثْلِ هَذَا أَوْ نَحْوِ هَذَا‏.‏ رَوَاهُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Mujahid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up on the day of the Conquest of Mecca and said, "Allah has made Mecca a sanctuary since the day He created the Heavens and the Earth, and it will remain a sanctuary by virtue of the sanctity Allah has bestowed on it till the Day of Resurrection. It (i.e. fighting in it) was not made lawful to anyone before me, nor will it be made lawful to anyone after me, and it was not made lawful for me except for a short period of time. Its game should not be chased, nor should its trees be cut, nor its vegetation or grass uprooted, nor its Luqata (i.e. Most things) picked up except by one who makes a public announcement about it." Al-Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib said, "Except the Idhkhir, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), as it is indispensable for blacksmiths and houses." On that, the Prophet (ﷺ) kept quiet and then said, "Except the Idhkhir as it is lawful to cut
64.hi: Mujahid bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Fatah-e-Mecca ke din uthe aur kaha, "Allah ne Mecca ko us din se pavitra banaya hai jab usne aasman aur zameen banaee thi, aur yeh us pavitrata ki wajah se pavitra hi rahega jo Allah ne ise diya hai Qiyamat ke din tak. Yeh (yaani ismein jung karna) mujhse pahle kisi ke liye jaayaz nahi tha, na hi yeh mere baad kisi ke liye jaayaz hoga, aur yeh mere liye bhi sirf ek chhote waqt ke liye jaayaz tha. Iske shikaar janwaron ka picha nahi karna chahiye, na iske darakhton ko kaatna chahiye, na iski ghaas ya vanaspati ko ukhaadna chahiye, na iski Luqata (yaani khoee huee cheezen) uthana chahiye siwaye us shaks ke jo iske baare mein saarvajanik elaan kare." Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne kaha, "Siwaye Idhkhir (yaani ek qisam ki ghaas) ke, Aye Allah ke Rasool, kyunke yeh lohaaron aur gharon ke liye zaroori hai." Ispar, Nabi khaamosh rahe aur phir kaha, "Siwaye Idhkhir ke, kyunke ise kaatna jaayaz hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، رَأَيْتُ بِيَدِ ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى ضَرْبَةً، قَالَ ضُرِبْتُهَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ‏.‏ قُلْتُ شَهِدْتَ حُنَيْنًا قَالَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Isma`il:I saw (a healed scar of) blow over the hand of Ibn Abi `Aufa who said, "I received that blow in the battle of Hunain in the company of the Prophet." I said, "Did you take part in the battle of Hunain?" He replied, "Yes (and in other battles) before it
64.hi: Ismail bataate hain: Maine Ibn Abi Aufa ke haath par ek (bhara hua) zakhm ka nishaan dekha jinhone kaha, "Mujhe woh zakhm Hunain ki jung mein mila, Nabi ki sohbat mein." Maine pucha, "Kya aapne Hunain ki jung mein hissa liya?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan (aur isse pahle bhi doosri jungon mein)."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، رضى الله عنه وَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عُمَارَةَ أَتَوَلَّيْتَ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ فَقَالَ أَمَّا أَنَا فَأَشْهَدُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُوَلِّ، وَلَكِنْ عَجِلَ سَرَعَانُ الْقَوْمِ، فَرَشَقَتْهُمْ هَوَازِنُ، وَأَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ آخِذٌ بِرَأْسِ بَغْلَتِهِ الْبَيْضَاءِ يَقُولُ ‏{‏أَنَا النَّبِيُّ لاَ كَذِبْ، أَنَا ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبْ‏}‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:I heard Al-Bara' narrating when a man came and said to him, "O Abu '`Umara! Did you flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" Al-Bara' replied, "I testify that the Prophet (ﷺ) did not flee, but the hasty people hurried away and the people of Hawazin threw arrows at them. At that time, Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith was holding the white mule of the Prophet (ﷺ) by the head, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly: I am the son of `Abdul-Muttalib
64.hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Maine Al-Bara ko suna jab ek shaks ne unse pucha, "Aye Abu Umara! Kya aap Hunain ke din bhaag gaye the?" Al-Bara ne jawab diya, "Main gawahi deta hoon ke Nabi nahi bhage, magar jaldbaaz log jaldi se chale gaye aur Hawazin ke log unpar teer chalane lage. Us waqt, Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Harith Nabi ke safed khachchar ka sar pakde huye the, aur Nabi kah rahe the, 'Main bilkul Nabi hoon: main Abdul-Muttalib ka beta hoon.'"

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قِيلَ لِلْبَرَاءِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ، أَوَلَّيْتُمْ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ فَقَالَ أَمَّا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ، كَانُوا رُمَاةً فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنَا النَّبِيُّ لاَ كَذِبْ أَنَا ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبْ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:Al-Bara' was asked while I was listening, "Did you flee (before the enemy) along with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of (the battle of) Hunain?" He replied, "As for the Prophet, he did not (flee). The enemy were good archers and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly; I am the son of `Abdul Muttalib
64.hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Al-Bara se puchha gaya jabke main sun raha tha, "Kya aap Nabi ke saath Hunain ke din bhage the?" Unhone jawab diya, "Jahaan tak Nabi ka sawal hai, woh nahi bhage. Dushman achhe tirandaaz the aur Nabi kah rahe the, 'Main bilkul Nabi hoon; main Abdul Muttalib ka beta hoon.'"

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ ـ وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَيْسٍ ـ أَفَرَرْتُمْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ فَقَالَ لَكِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَفِرَّ، كَانَتْ هَوَازِنُ رُمَاةً، وَإِنَّا لَمَّا حَمَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمِ انْكَشَفُوا، فَأَكْبَبْنَا عَلَى الْغَنَائِمِ، فَاسْتُقْبِلْنَا بِالسِّهَامِ، وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى بَغْلَتِهِ الْبَيْضَاءِ، وَإِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ آخِذٌ بِزِمَامِهَا وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏{‏أَنَا النَّبِيُّ لاَ كَذِبْ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِسْرَائِيلُ وَزُهَيْرٌ نَزَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ بَغْلَتِهِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:That he heard Al-Bara narrating when a man from Qais (tribe) asked him "Did you flee leaving Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" Al-Bara' replied, "But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not flee. The people of Hawazin were good archers, and when we attacked them, they fled. But rushing towards the booty, we were confronted by the arrows (of the enemy). I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) riding his white mule while Abu Sufyan was holding its reins, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly." (Israil and Zuhair said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) dismounted from his Mule
64.hi: Abu Ishaq bataate hain: Unhone Al-Bara se suna jab Qais qabile ke ek shaks ne unse pucha, "Kya aap Allah ke Rasool ko chhodkar Hunain ke din bhage?" Al-Bara ne jawab diya, "Magar Allah ke Rasool nahi bhage. Hawazin ke log achhe tirandaaz the, aur jab humne unpar hamla kiya, woh bhage. Magar maal-e-ghanimat ki taraf daudte hue, hum (dushman ke) teeron ka saamna karne lage. Maine Nabi ko apne safed khachchar par sawar dekha jabke Abu Sufyan (رضی اللہ عنہ) uski lagaam thaame huye the, aur Nabi kah rahe the, 'Main bilkul Nabi hoon.'" (Israil aur Zuhair ne kaha, "Nabi apne khachchar se utre.")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي لَيْثٌ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ،، قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شِهَابٍ وَزَعَمَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ حِينَ جَاءَهُ وَفْدُ هَوَازِنَ مُسْلِمِينَ، فَسَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَسَبْيَهُمْ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَعِي مَنْ تَرَوْنَ، وَأَحَبُّ الْحَدِيثِ إِلَىَّ أَصْدَقُهُ، فَاخْتَارُوا إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ إِمَّا السَّبْىَ، وَإِمَّا الْمَالَ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ اسْتَأْنَيْتُ بِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَنْظَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً، حِينَ قَفَلَ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ رَادٍّ إِلَيْهِمْ إِلاَّ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ قَالُوا فَإِنَّا نَخْتَارُ سَبْيَنَا‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ قَدْ جَاءُونَا تَائِبِينَ، وَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَنْ أَرُدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ سَبْيَهُمْ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يُطَيِّبَ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْعَلْ، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَلَى حَظِّهِ، حَتَّى نُعْطِيَهُ إِيَّاهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَا يُفِيءُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا، فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ قَدْ طَيَّبْنَا ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّا لاَ نَدْرِي مَنْ أَذِنَ مِنْكُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ فَارْجِعُوا حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْنَا عُرَفَاؤُكُمْ أَمْرَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ النَّاسُ فَكَلَّمَهُمْ عُرَفَاؤُهُمْ ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ طَيَّبُوا وَأَذِنُوا‏.‏ هَذَا الَّذِي بَلَغَنِي عَنْ سَبْىِ هَوَازِنَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:When the delegate of Hawazin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) declaring their conversion to Islam and asked him to return their properties and captives, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and said to them, "There Is involved in this matter, the people whom you see with me, and the most beloved talk to me, is the true one. So choose one of two alternatives: Either the captives or the properties. I have been waiting for you (i.e. have not distributed the booty)." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had delayed the distribution of their booty over ten nights after his return from Ta'if. So when they came to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was not going to return to them but one of the two, they said, "We prefer to have our captives." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up amongst the Muslims, and praising Allah as He deserved, said, "To proceed! Your brothers have come to you with repentance and I see (it logical) to return their captives. So, whoever of you likes to do that as a favor then he can do it. And whoever of you likes to stick to his share till we give him from the very first booty which Allah will give us, then he can do so." The people said, "We do that (i.e. return the captives) willingly as a favor, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We do not know which of you have agreed to it and which have not; so go back and let your chiefs forward us your decision." They went back and their chief's spoke to them, and they (i.e. the chiefs) returned to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him that all of them had agreed (to give up their captives) with pleasure, and had given their permission (i.e. that the captives be returned to their people). (The sub-narrator said, "That is what has reached me about the captives of Hawazin tribe)
64.hi: Marwan aur Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Hawazin ka pratinidhimandal Allah ke Rasool ke paas aaya, Islam qubool karne ka elaan karte huye aur apni maal aur qaidiyon ko wapas maangte huye, Allah ke Rasool uthe aur unse kaha, "Is maamle mein log shaamil hain jinhe tum mere saath dekh rahe ho, aur mere liye sabse pyari baat woh hai jo sachchi ho. Isliye do ikhtiyaaron mein se ek chuniye: ya to qaidi ya maal. Main tumhara intezaar kar raha hoon (yaani maine maal-e-ghanimat abhi taqseem nahi ki)." Allah ke Rasool ne Taif se wapasi ke baad das raaton tak unki maal-e-ghanimat ki taqseem ko deri se rakha tha. Isliye jab unhe pata chala ke Allah ke Rasool unhe donon nahi, balki sirf ek denge, unhone kaha, "Hum apne qaidiyon ko tarjih dete hain." Isliye Allah ke Rasool Musalmanon ke beech uthe, aur Allah ki taarif jitni woh laayak hai karke, kaha, "Iske baad! Tumhare bhaee tauba ke saath tumhare paas aaye hain aur mujhe (yeh) lagta hai ke main unke qaidi unhe wapas dese lautaun. Isliye tum mein se jo koee ise ek ehsaan ke tor par karna chahta hai, woh aisa kar sakta hai. Aur jo koee apna hissa tab tak rakhna chahta hai jab tak hum unhe pahli hi maal-e-ghanimat mein se de nahi dete jo Allah humein dega, phir woh aisa kar sakta hai." Logon ne kaha, "Hum aisa (yaani qaidiyon ko wapas karna) khushi se karte hain, Aye Allah ke Rasool!" Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Humein nahi pata tummein se kaun isse sahmat hai aur kaun nahi; isliye wapas jao aur apne sardaron ko humare paas humara faisla bhejne do." Woh wapas gaye aur unke sardaron ne unse baat ki, aur woh (yaani sardaar) Allah ke Rasool ke paas wapas aaye aur unhe bataya ke sab ne khushi se sahmati di thi (qaidiyon ko chhodne ki), aur ijazat di thi. (Subordinate raawi ne kaha, "Yehi mujhtak pahuncha hai Hawazin qabile ke qaidiyon ke baare mein.")
