مِنْهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ حَلَفُوا لَهُ، فَبَايَعَهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُمْ وَأَرْجَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْرَنَا حَتَّى قَضَى اللَّهُ فِيهِ، فَبِذَلِكَ قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏وَعَلَى الثَّلاَثَةِ الَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا‏}‏ وَلَيْسَ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ مِمَّا خُلِّفْنَا عَنِ الْغَزْوِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ تَخْلِيفُهُ إِيَّانَا وَإِرْجَاؤُهُ أَمْرَنَا عَمَّنْ حَلَفَ لَهُ وَاعْتَذَرَ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَبِلَ مِنْهُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b bin Malik:Who, from among Ka`b's sons, was the guide of Ka`b when he became blind: I heard Ka`b bin Malik narrating the story of (the Ghazwa of) Tabuk in which he failed to take part. Ka`b said, "I did not remain behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in any Ghazwa that he fought except the Ghazwa of Tabuk, and I failed to take part in the Ghazwa of Badr, but Allah did not admonish anyone who had not participated in it, for in fact, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had gone out in search of the caravan of Quraish till Allah made them (i.e. the Muslims) and their enemy meet without any appointment. I witnessed the night of Al-`Aqaba (pledge) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when we pledged for Islam, and I would not exchange it for the Badr battle although the Badr battle is more popular amongst the people than it (i.e. Al-`Aqaba pledge). As for my news (in this battle of Tabuk), I had never been stronger or wealthier than I was when I remained behind the Prophet (ﷺ) in that Ghazwa. By Allah, never had I two she-camels before, but I had then at the time of this Ghazwa. Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to make a Ghazwa, he used to hide his intention by apparently referring to different Ghazwa till it was the time of that Ghazwa (of Tabuk) which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought in severe heat, facing, a long journey, desert, and the great number of enemy. So the Prophet (ﷺ) announced to the Muslims clearly (their destination) so that they might get prepared for their Ghazwa. So he informed them clearly of the destination he was going to. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was accompanied by a large number of Muslims who could not be listed in a book namely, a register." Ka`b added, "Any man who intended to be absent would think that the matter would remain hidden unless Allah revealed it through Divine Revelation. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fought that Ghazwa at the time when the fruits had ripened and the shade looked pleasant. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his companions prepared for the battle and I started to go out in order to get myself ready along with them, but I returned without doing anything. I would say to myself, 'I can do that.' So I kept on delaying it every now and then till the people got ready and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the Muslims along with him departed, and I had not prepared anything for my departure, and I said, I will prepare myself (for departure) one or two days after him, and then join them.' In the morning following their departure, I went out to get myself ready but returned having done nothing. Then again in the next morning, I went out to get ready but returned without doing anything. Such was the case with me till they hurried away and the battle was missed (by me). Even then I intended to depart to take them over. I wish I had done so! But it was not in my luck. So, after the departure of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whenever I went out and walked amongst the people (i.e, the remaining persons), it grieved me that I could see none around me, but one accused of hypocrisy or one of those weak men whom Allah had excused. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not remember me till he reached Tabuk. So while he was sitting amongst the people in Tabuk, he said, 'What did Ka`b do?' A man from Banu Salama said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He has been stopped by his two Burdas (i.e. garments) and his looking at his own flanks with pride.' Then Mu`adh bin Jabal said, 'What a bad thing you have said! By Allah! O Allah's Apostle! We know nothing about him but good.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept silent." Ka`b bin Malik added, "When I heard that he (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was on his way back to Medina. I got dipped in my concern, and began to think of false excuses, saying to myself, 'How can I avoid his anger tomorrow?' And I took the advice of every wise member of my family in this matter. When it was said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), had come near all the evil false excuses abandoned from my mind and I knew well that I could never come out of this problem by forging a false statement. Then I decided firmly to speak the truth. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) arrived in the morning, and whenever he returned from a journey., he used to visit the Mosque first of all and offer a two-rak`at prayer therein and then sit for the people. So when he had done all that (this time), those who had failed to join the battle (of Tabuk) came and started offering (false) excuses and taking oaths before him. They were something over eighty men; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) accepted the excuses they had expressed, took their pledge of allegiance asked for Allah's Forgiveness for them, and left the secrets of their hearts for Allah to judge. Then I came to him, and when I greeted him, he smiled a smile of an angry person and then said, 'Come on.' So I came walking till I sat before him. He said to me, 'What stopped you from joining us. Had you not purchased an animal For carrying you?' I answered, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! But by Allah, if I were sitting before any person from among the people of the world other than you, I would have avoided his anger with an excuse. By Allah, I have been bestowed with the power of speaking fluently and eloquently, but by Allah, I know well that if today I tell you a lie to seek your favor, Allah would surely make you angry with me in the near future, but if I tell you the truth, though you will get angry because of it, I hope for Allah's Forgiveness. Really, by Allah, there was no excuse for me. By Allah, I had never been stronger or wealthier than I was when I remained behind you.' Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'As regards this man, he has surely told the truth. So get up till Allah decides your case.' I got up, and many men of Banu Salama followed me and said to me, 'By Allah, we never witnessed you doing any sin before this. Surely, you failed to offer excuse to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as the others who did not join him, have offered. The prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to Allah to forgive you would have been sufficient for you.' By Allah, they continued blaming me so much that I intended to return (to the Prophet) and accuse myself of having told a lie, but I said to them, 'Is there anybody else who has met the same fate as I have?' They replied, 'Yes, there are two men who have said the same thing as you have, and to both of them was given the same order as given to you.' I said, 'Who are they?' They replied, 'Murara bin Ar-Rabi Al-Amri and Hilal bin Umaiya Al-Waqifi.' By that they mentioned to me two pious men who had attended the Ghazwa (Battle) of Badr, and in whom there was an example for me. So I did not change my mind when they mentioned them to me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade all the Muslims to talk to us, the three aforesaid persons out of all those who had remained behind in that Ghazwa. So we kept away from the people and they changed their attitude towards us till the very land (where I lived) appeared strange to me as if I did not know it. We remained in that condition for fifty nights. As regards my two fellows, they remained in their houses and kept on weeping, but I was the youngest of them and the firmest of them, so I used to go out and witness the prayers along with the Muslims and roam about in the markets, but none would talk to me, and I would come to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and greet him while he was sitting In his gathering after the prayer, and I would wonder whether the Prophet (ﷺ) did move his lips in return to my greetings or not. Then I would offer my prayer near to him and look at him stealthily. When I was busy with my prayer, he would turn his face towards me, but when I turned my face to him, he would turn his face away from me. When this harsh attitude of the people lasted long, I walked till I scaled the wall of the garden of Abu Qatada who was my cousin and the dearest person to me, and I offered my greetings to him. By Allah, he did not return my greetings. I said, 'O Abu Qatada! I beseech you by Allah! Do you know that I love Allah and His Apostle?' He kept quiet. I asked him again, beseeching him by Allah, but he remained silent. Then I asked him again in the Name of Allah. He said, "Allah and His Apostle know it better.' Thereupon my eyes flowed with tears and I returned and jumped over the wall." Ka`b added, "While I was walking in the market of Medina, suddenly I saw a Nabati (i.e. a Christian farmer) from the Nabatis of Sham who came to sell his grains in Medina, saying, 'Who will lead me to Ka`b bin Malik?' The people began to point (me) out for him till he came to me and handed me a letter from the king of Ghassan in which the following was written: "To proceed, I have been informed that your friend (i.e. the Prophet (ﷺ) ) has treated you harshly. Anyhow, Allah does not let you live at a place where you feel inferior and your right is lost. So join us, and we will console you." When I read it, I said to myself, 'This is also a sort of a test.' Then I took the letter to the oven and made a fire therein by burning it. When forty out of the fifty nights elapsed, behold ! There came to me the messenger of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) orders you to keep away from your wife,' I said, 'Should I divorce her; or else what should I do?' He said, 'No, only keep aloof from her and do not cohabit her.' The Prophet (ﷺ) sent the same message to my two fellows. Then I said to my wife. 'Go to your parents and remain with them till Allah gives His Verdict in this matter." Ka`b added, "The wife of Hilal bin Umaiya came to Allah's Apostle and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Hilal bin Umaiya is a helpless old man who has no servant to attend on him. Do you dislike that I should serve him? ' He said, 'No (you can serve him) but he should not come near you.' She said, 'By Allah, he has no desire for anything. By, Allah, he has never ceased weeping since his case began till this day of his.' On that, some of my family members said to me, 'Will you also ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to permit your wife (to serve you) as he has permitted the wife of Hilal bin Umaiya to serve him?' I said, 'By Allah, I will not ask the permission of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) regarding her, for I do not know What Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would say if I asked him to permit her (to serve me) while I am a young man.' Then I remained in that state for ten more nights after that till the period of fifty nights was completed starting from the time when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the people from talking to us. When I had offered the Fajr prayer on the 50th morning on the roof of one of our houses and while I was sitting in the condition which Allah described (in the Qur'an) i.e. my very soul seemed straitened to me and even the earth seemed narrow to me for all its spaciousness, there I heard the voice of one who had ascended the mountain of Sala' calling with his loudest voice, 'O Ka`b bin Malik! Be happy (by receiving good tidings).' I fell down in prostration before Allah, realizing that relief has come. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had announced the acceptance of our repentance by Allah when he had offered the Fajr prayer. The people then went out to congratulate us. Some bringers of good tidings went out to my two fellows, and a horseman came to me in haste, and a man of Banu Aslam came running and ascended the mountain and his voice was swifter than the horse. When he (i.e. the man) whose voice I had heard, came to me conveying the good tidings, I took off my garments and dressed him with them; and by Allah, I owned no other garments than them on that day. Then I borrowed two garments and wore them and went to Allah's Apostle. The people started receiving me in batches, congratulating me on Allah's Acceptance of my repentance, saying, 'We congratulate you on Allah's Acceptance of your repentance." Ka`b further said, "When I entered the Mosque, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sitting with the people around him. Talha bin Ubaidullah swiftly came to me, shook hands with me and congratulated me. By Allah, none of the Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants) got up for me except him (i.e. Talha), and I will never forget this for Talha." Ka`b added, "When I greeted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) his face being bright with joy, he said, "Be happy with the best day that you have got ever since your mother delivered you." Ka`b added, "I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) 'Is this forgiveness from you or from Allah?' He said, 'No, it is from Allah.' Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became happy, his face would shine as if it were a piece of moon, and we all knew that characteristic of him. When I sat before him, I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Because of the acceptance of my repentance I will give up all my wealth as alms for the Sake of Allah and His Apostle. Allah's Apostle said, 'Keep some of your wealth, as it will be better for you.' I said, 'So I will keep my share from Khaibar with me,' and added, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah has saved me for telling the truth; so it is a part of my repentance not to tell but the truth as long as I am alive. By Allah, I do not know anyone of the Muslims whom Allah has helped fortelling the truth more than me. Since I have mentioned that truth to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till today, I have never intended to tell a lie. I hope that Allah will also save me (from telling lies) the rest of my life. So Allah revealed to His Apostle the Verse:-- "Verily, Allah has forgiven the Prophet, the Muhajirin (i.e. Emigrants (up to His Saying) And be with those who are true (in word and deed)." (9.117-119) By Allah, Allah has never bestowed upon me, apart from His guiding me to Islam, a Greater blessing than the fact that I did not tell a lie to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which would have caused me to perish as those who have told a lie perished, for Allah described those who told lies with the worst description He ever attributed to anybody else. Allah said:-- "They (i.e. the hypocrites) will swear by Allah to you when you return to them (up to His Saying) Certainly Allah is not pleased with the rebellious people-- " (9.95-96) Ka`b added, "We, the three persons, differed altogether from those whose excuses Allah's Apostle accepted when they swore to him. He took their pledge of allegiance and asked Allah to forgive them, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left our case pending till Allah gave His Judgment about it. As for that Allah said):-- And to the three (He did forgive also) who remained behind." (9.118) What Allah said (in this Verse) does not indicate our failure to take part in the Ghazwa, but it refers to the deferment of making a decision by the Prophet (ﷺ) about our case in contrast to the case of those who had taken an oath before him and he excused them by accepting their excuses
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ka'b bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain (jo, Ka'b ke beton mein se, Ka'b ke andhe hone par unke margdarshak the): Maine Ka'b bin Malik ko Tabuk (ki jung) ki kahani sunate suna jismein woh shaamil nahi ho paye. Ka'b ne kaha, "Main kabhi Allah ke Rasool ki kisi Ghazwe se peeche nahi raha jo unhone ladi siwaye Tabuk ke Ghazwe ke, aur main Badr ki jung mein bhi shaamil nahi ho paya, magar Allah ne usmein shaamil na hone wale kisi ko bhi doshi nahi thahraya, kyunke asal mein, Allah ke Rasool Quraish ke caravan ka picha karne nikle the jab tak Allah ne unhe (yaani Musalmanon ko) aur unke dushman ko bina koee pahle se tay ke aamne-saamne la diya. Maine Al-Aqaba ki raat Allah ke Rasool ke saath dekhi jab humne Islam ke liye bai'at di, aur main ise Badr ki jung se badal nahi karunga chahe Badr ki jung logon ke beech isse (yaani Al-Aqaba bai'at se) zyada prasiddh hai. Jahaan tak meri khabar (is Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein) ka sawal hai, main kabhi itna taakatvar ya daulatvaan nahi tha jitna main tha jab main Nabi se is Ghazwa mein peeche raha. Allah ki qasam, mere paas kabhi do untniyaan pahle nahi thi, magar mere paas is Ghazwa ke waqt thi. Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool koee Ghazwa karna chahte, woh apna irada chhupate hue doosre Ghazwe ka zikar karte the jab tak (Tabuk ki) Ghazwa ka waqt aaya, jise Allah ke Rasool ne sakht garmi mein lada, lambe safar, registaan, aur bade tadaad mein dushman ka saamna karte huye. Isliye Nabi ne Musalmanon ko saaf-saaf (unki manzil) elaan ki taaki woh apni Ghazwa ki taiyaari kar saken. Isliye unhone unhe saaf-saaf bataya ke woh kahaan ja rahe the. Allah ke Rasool ke saath bade tadaad mein Musalman the jinhe ek kitaab, yaani register mein nahi likha ja sakta tha." Ka'b ne joda, "Koee bhi shaks jo gair-hazir rehne ka irada rakhta tha, sochta tha ke maamla chhipa rah jaayega jab tak Allah use Divine Ilham ke zariye zaahir na kare. Isliye Allah ke Rasool ne yeh Ghazwa us waqt lada jab phal pak chuke the aur chhaye achhi lag rahi thi. Allah ke Rasool aur unke sathi jung ki taiyaari karne lage aur main bhi unke saath taiyaari karne ke liye nikla, magar main kuch kiye bina wapas aa gaya. Main khud se kahta, 'Main woh kar sakta hoon.' Isliye main ise baat-baat mein taalta raha jab tak log taiyaar ho gaye aur Allah ke Rasool aur Musalman unke saath rawana hue, aur maine apne prasthaan ke liye kuch taiyaar nahi kiya tha, aur maine kaha, 'Main unke ek ya do din baad khud ko taiyaar karunga, aur phir unse ja milunga.' Unke prasthaan ke agli subah, main taiyaar hone ke liye nikla magar kuch kiye bina wapas aa gaya. Phir agli subah bhi, main taiyaar hone ke liye nikla magar kuch kiye bina wapas aaya. Yehi haalat meri rahi jab tak woh jaldi se chale gaye aur jung chhut gaee (mujhse). Phir bhi maine unke saath milne ke liye prasthaan karne ka irada kiya. Kaash maine aisa kiya hota! Magar yeh mere naseeb mein nahi tha. Isliye, Allah ke Rasool ke prasthaan ke baad, jab bhi main bahar jata aur logon (yaani baaki rah gaye logon) ke beech ghumta, mujhe dukh hota ke main apne aas-paas koee bhi nahi dekh pata siwaye un logon ke jinpar munafik hone ka ilzaam tha ya un kamzor logon ke jinhe Allah ne maaf kar diya tha. Allah ke Rasool ne mujhe tab tak yaad nahi kiya jab tak woh Tabuk nahi pahunche. Isliye jabke woh Tabuk mein logon ke beech baithe the, unhone kaha, 'Ka'b ne kya kiya?' Banu Salama ke ek shaks ne kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Unhe unke do Burda (yaani kapdon) ne aur unke apne pahluon ko garv se dekhne ne roka hai.' Ispar Mu'adh bin Jabal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Aapne kitni buri baat kahi hai! Allah ki qasam! Aye Allah ke Rasool! Hum unke baare mein achhe ke siwa kuch nahi jaante.' Allah ke Rasool khaamosh rahe." Ka'b bin Malik ne joda, "Jab mujhe khabar mili ke woh (yaani Nabi) Madina wapas aa rahe hain, main chinta mein doob gaya, aur jhoote bahane sochne laga, khud se kahte hue, 'Main kal unke gusse se kaise bachunga?' Aur maine is maamle mein apne pariwara ke har aqlmand sadasya ki raay li. Jab yeh kaha gaya ke Allah ke Rasool nazdik aa chuke hain, sab bure jhoote bahane mere man se hat gaye aur mujhe achhi tarah pata chal gaya ke main is samasya se kabhi ek jhoote byaan ke zariye bahar nahi aa sakta. Phir maine sach kahne ka dradh nirnay liya. Isliye Allah ke Rasool subah pahunche, aur jab bhi woh kisi safar se wapas aate, woh sabse pahle masjid jate aur usmein do rakat namaz padhte aur phir logon ke liye baith jate. Isliye jab unhone aisa kiya (is baar), jinhone jung mein shaamil hone se chhod diya tha woh aaye aur unke saamne (jhoote) bahane pesh karne aur qasamen khane lage. Woh assi se zyada log the; Allah ke Rasool ne unke daava kiye gaye bahanon ko qubool kiya, unki bai'at li, unke liye Allah se maafi maangi, aur unke dilo ke raazon ko Allah ke faisle par chhod diya. Phir main unke paas gaya, aur jab maine unhe salaam kiya, woh ek naraaj insaan ki tarah muskurae aur phir kaha, 'Aao.' Isliye main chalte hue aaya jab tak main unke saamne baith gaya. Unhone mujhse kaha, 'Tumhe humare saath jane se kis cheez ne roka? Kya tumne ek sawari ka janwar khareeda nahi tha?' Maine jawab diya, 'Haan, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Magar Allah ki qasam, agar main duniya ke kisi aur shaks ke saamne baitha hota aapke siwaye, main uske gusse ko ek bahane se tod leta. Allah ki qasam, mujhe ravaan aur naipuny tarike se bolne ki taakat di gaee hai, magar Allah ki qasam, mujhe achhi tarah pata hai ke agar aaj main aapse jhoot bolkar aapki prasannata haasil karna chahta hoon, Allah zaroor mujhse aapka gussa jald hi dilane wala hai, magar agar main aapse sach bolta hoon, chahe aap isse naraaj hon, mujhe Allah ki maafi ki ummeed hai. Sach mein, Allah ki qasam, mere paas koee bahana nahi tha. Allah ki qasam, main aapke saath rahte huye kabhi itna taakatvar ya daulatvaan nahi tha jitna main tha jab main aapse peeche raha.'" Phir Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, "Jahaan tak is shaks ka sawal hai, unhonne zaroor sach kaha hai. Isliye utho jab tak Allah tumhare baare mein faisla na de." Main utha, aur Banu Salama ke bahut se log mere peeche aaye aur mujhse kaha, "Allah ki qasam, humne kabhi aapko isse pahle koee gunah karte dekha hi nahi. Zaroor aap Allah ke Rasool ke saamne ek bahana pesh karne mein asamartha rahe jaisa doosron ne jo unke saath nahi gaye, pesh kiya. Allah ke Rasool ki Allah se aapko maaf karne ki dua hi aapke liye kaafi hoti." Allah ki qasam, woh mujhe itna dosh dete rahe ke maine (Nabi ke paas) wapas jane aur khud par jhoot bolne ka ilzaam lagane ka irada kiya, magar maine unse kaha, "Kya koee aur bhi hai jinke saath aisa hi hua jaisa mere saath?" Unhone jawab diya, "Haan, do log ne bhi aapke jaisi hi baat kahi, aur unhe bhi wahi hukum diya gaya jaisa aapko diya gaya." Maine pucha, "Woh kaun hain?" Unhone jawab diya, "Murara bin Ar-Rabi Al-Amri aur Hilal bin Umaiya Al-Waqifi." Iske zariye unhone mujhe do pakbaz logon ka zikar kiya jo Badr ki jung mein shaamil hue the aur jinmein mere liye ek udaaharan tha. Isliye maine apna man nahi badala jab unhone unka zikar mujhse kiya. Allah ke Rasool ne sab Musalmanon ko humare teenon se baat karne se mana kiya, yaani, us Ghazwe mein peeche rah gaye teenon mein se. Isliye humne apne aap ko logon se door kiya, aur unhone humare prati apna vyavhaar badal diya jab tak zameen tak mere liye ajnabi lagne lagi mano main ise pahchanta hi nahi tha. Hum us haalat mein pachaas raaten rahe. Jahaan tak mere do sathiyon ka sawal hai, woh apne gharon mein rahe aur rote rahe, magar main unmein sabse jawan aur sabse dradh tha, isliye main bahar jata aur Musalmanon ke saath namazen dekhta aur bazaron mein ghumta, magar koee bhi mujhse baat nahi karta, aur main Allah ke Rasool ke paas aata aur namaz ke baad jab woh apni baithak mein baithe hote, unhe salaam karta, aur main sochta ke Nabi ne jawab mein apne honth hilaye ya nahi. Phir main unke qareeb namaz padhta aur churakar unhe dekhta. Jab main apni namaz mein vyast hota, woh apna chehra meri taraf mudte, magar jab main apna chehra unki taraf mudta, woh apna chehra mujhse door kar lete. Jab logon ka yeh sakht vyavhaar lambe waqt tak chala, main chalta hua Abu Qatada (رضی اللہ عنہ) ke baag ki deewaar tak gaya, jo mere chachere bhai the aur mujhe sabse pyare insaan the, aur maine unhe salaam kiya. Allah ki qasam, unhone mera salaam ka jawab nahi diya. Maine kaha, 'Aye Abu Qatada! Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon! Kya aapko pata hai main Allah aur uske Rasool se pyar karta hoon?' Woh khaamosh rahe. Maine unse phir Allah ki qasam dekar pucha, magar woh khaamosh rahe. Phir maine unse Allah ke naam par phir pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Allah aur unke Rasool behtar jaante hain.' Ispar mere aansu behne lage aur main wapas gaya aur deewaar par se kood gaya." Ka'b ne joda, "Jabke main Madina ke bazaar mein chal raha tha, achanak maine dekha Sham ke ek Nabati (yaani Isaee kisan) ko jo apna anaaj bechne Madina aaya tha, kahte huye, 'Kaun mujhe Ka'b bin Malik tak le jaayega?' Log mujhe unke liye ishara karne lage jab tak woh mere paas aaye aur mujhe Ghassan ke baadshah ki taraf se ek khat diya jismein yeh likha tha: 'Aage ki baat yeh hai ki, mujhe pata chala hai ke aapke dost (yaani Nabi) ne aapke saath sakhti se pesh aaya hai. Allah aapko aisi jagah nahi rakhega jahaan aap khud ko heen mahsoos karen aur aapka haqq kho jaaye. Isliye humare saath aa jaiye, aur hum aapko saantvana denge.' Jab maine ise padha, maine khud se kaha, 'Yeh bhi ek qisam ki aazmaish hai.' Phir main ise tandoor mein le gaya aur use jala diya." "Jab pachaas raaton mein se chaalis poori huee, achanak Allah ke Rasool ka ek sandesh-vahak mere paas aaya aur kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool tumhe apni biwi se door rehne ka hukum dete hain.' Maine pucha, 'Kya main unhe talaq de dun, ya main kya karun?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi, sirf unse door raho aur unke saath ta'alluq mat rakho.' Nabi ne mere donon sathiyon ko bhi wahi paighaam bheja. Phir maine apni biwi se kaha, 'Apne maa-baap ke paas jao aur unke saath tab tak raho jab tak Allah is maamle mein apna faisla na de.'" Ka'b ne joda, "Hilal bin Umaiya ki biwi Allah ke Rasool ke paas aee aur kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Hilal bin Umaiya ek asahaya boodhe aadmi hain jinke paas koee gulaam nahi hai jo unki sewa kare. Kya aapko napasand hoga agar main unki sewa karun?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi (aap unki sewa kar sakti hain) magar unhe aapke najdik nahi aana chahiye.' Unhone kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, unmein kisi cheez ki iccha nahi hai. Allah ki qasam, woh jab se unka maamla shuru hua tab se lekar aaj tak rote hi rahe hain.'" Ispar, mere pariwara ke kuch sadasyon ne mujhse kaha, "Kya aap bhi Allah ke Rasool se apni biwi (ki sewa) ke liye ijazat maangenge jaisi unhone Hilal bin Umaiya ki biwi ko unki sewa karne ki ijazat di hai?" Maine kaha, "Allah ki qasam, main iske baare mein Allah ke Rasool se ijazat nahi maagunga, kyunke mujhe nahi pata Allah ke Rasool kya kahenge agar main unse ijazat maagun jabke main ek jawan aadmi hoon." Phir main aur das raaton tak usi haalat mein raha jab tak pachaas raaton ki muddat poori ho gaee, us waqt se lekar jab Allah ke Rasool ne logon ko humme se baat karne se mana kiya tha. Jab maine pachaasvin subah ki Fajr ki namaz humare gharon mein se ek ki chhat par padhi, aur jabke main us haalat mein baitha tha jiska varnan Allah ne (Quran mein) kiya hai, yaani meri jaan mujhe tang lagti thi aur zameen bhi apni vishaalta ke bavjood mujhe tang lagti thi, wahaan maine Sala pahad par chadhe hue ek shakhs ki aawaaz suni jo apni sabse buland aawaaz mein pukar raha tha, "Aye Ka'b bin Malik! Khush ho jao (achhi khabar paane ke liye)." Main Allah ke saamne sajda mein gir gaya, yeh samajhkar ke rahat aa chuki hai. Allah ke Rasool ne Fajr ki namaz padhne ke baad humari tauba ki Allah dwaara sweekar hone ki khabar de di thi. Log humein badhaee dene ke liye nikle. Kuch log achhi khabar lekar mere donon sathiyon ke paas gaye, aur ek sawar jaldi se mere paas aaya, aur Banu Aslam qabile ka ek shaks daudta hua aaya aur pahad par chadha, aur uski aawaaz ghode se tez thi. Jab woh shakhs jinki aawaaz maine suni thi mere paas achhi khabar dene aaya, maine apne kapde utare aur unhe (badhaee ki khaatir) unse pahna diye; aur Allah ki qasam, us din ke ilawa mere paas koee aur kapde nahi the. Phir maine (kisi se) do kapde udhaar liye aur unhe pahna aur Allah ke Rasool ki taraf gaya. Log mujhse girohon mein milne lage, mujhe Allah dwaara meri tauba sweekar hone par badhaee dete huye, kahte huye, "Hum aapko Allah ki taraf se aapki tauba ki sweekriti par badhaee dete hain." Ka'b ne aage kaha, "Jab main masjid mein daakhil hua, maine Allah ke Rasool ko unke aas-paas baithe logon ke saath dekha. Talha (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ubaidullah jaldi se mere paas aaye, mujhse haath milaya aur badhaee di. Allah ki qasam, unke (yaani Talha ke) siwaye Muhajirin mein se koee bhi mere liye khade nahi hue, aur main ise kabhi Talha ke liye nahi bhoolunga." Ka'b ne joda, "Jab maine Allah ke Rasool ko salaam kiya, unka chehra khushi se chamakte huye, unhone kaha, 'Aapko wahi din khushi haasil karna chahiye jo aapke liye sabse achha raha hai jab se aapki maa ne aapko paidaish diya.'" Ka'b ne joda, "Maine Nabi se kaha, 'Kya yeh maafi aapki taraf se hai ya Allah ki taraf se?' Unhone kaha, 'Nahi, yeh Allah ki taraf se hai.' Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool khushi hote, unka chehra chamakta jaise woh chaand ka ek tukda ho, aur hum sab is baat ko unki khasiyat ke soorat mein jaante the. Jab main unke saamne baitha, maine kaha, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Meri tauba ki sweekriti ki wajah se, main apni sari daulat Allah aur unke Rasool ki khaatir sadqe mein dunga.' Allah ke Rasool ne kaha, 'Apni kuch daulat apne paas rakho, kyunke yeh aapke liye behtar hoga.' Maine kaha, 'Isliye main Khaibar mein apna hissa apne paas rakhunga,' aur joda, 'Ya Allah ke Rasool! Allah ne mujhe sach bolne ki wajah se bacha liya hai; isliye mera yeh farz hai ke jab tak main zinda hoon, main sirf sach hi bolun. Allah ki qasam, main kisi aur Musalman ko nahi jaanta jinhe Allah ne sach bolne ki wajah se itna sammanit kiya hoga jitna mujhe kiya hai. Jab se maine yeh sach Allah ke Rasool se kaha, aaj tak, maine kabhi jhoot bolne ka irada nahi kiya. Mujhe ummeed hai Allah mujhe (jhoot se) apni baaki zindagi mein bhi bacha kar rakhega.' Isliye Allah ne apne Nabi par yeh Ayat naazil ki: 'Sach mein, Allah ne Nabi, Muhajir...ko maaf kar diya hai (aage tak)...aur unke saath raho jo sach (baat aur amal mein) hain.' (9:117-119) Allah ki qasam, Allah ne mujhe, Islam ki taraf hidaayat dene ke ilawa, isse bade daan se kabhi nawaza nahi jitna bada daan yeh tha ke maine Allah ke Rasool se jhoot nahi bola jisse main un logon ki tarah barbaad ho jata jinhone jhoot bola, kyunke Allah ne jhooton ka varnan unse bade shabdon mein kiya jitna usne kisi aur ke liye kiya, Allah ne kaha: 'Woh (yaani munafik) tumse Allah ki qasam khaenge jab tum unki taraf lautte ho (aage tak)...Yaqinan Allah bagaavat karne walon se khush nahi hota.' (9:95-96)" Ka'b ne joda, "Hum teenon shaks alag the un logon se jinke bahanen Allah ke Rasool ne qubool kiye jab unhone unke saamne qasam khaee. Unhone unki bai'at li aur unke liye Allah se maafi maangi, magar Allah ke Rasool ne humara maamla lambit rakha jab tak Allah ne iske baare mein apna faisla nahi diya. Jaisa ke Allah ne kaha:) 'Aur teenon (ko bhi maaf kiya) jo peeche rah gaye the.' (9:118) Allah ne (is Ayat mein) jo kaha uska matlab jung mein humari gair-hajari nahi hai, balki yeh Nabi dwaara humare maamle mein faisla dene mein deri ka ishara hai us tulna mein jinhonne unke saamne qasam khaee thi aur unhone unke bahanon ko qubool karke unhe maaf kar diya tha."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحِجْرِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ، أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَنَّعَ رَأْسَهُ وَأَسْرَعَ السَّيْرَ حَتَّى أَجَازَ الْوَادِيَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by Al-Hijr, he said, "Do not enter the dwelling places of those people who were unjust to themselves unless you enter in a weeping state lest the same calamity as of theirs should befall you." Then he covered his head and made his speed fast till he crossed the valley
64.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Nabi Al-Hijr se guzre, unhone kaha, "Un logon ke gharon mein daakhil mat hona jinhone khud par zulm kiya (yaani jinke ghar Thamud qaum ke the) siwaye rote hue haalat mein, is dar se ke tumpar bhi wahi tabaahi na aa jaaye jaisa unpar aaya tha." Phir unhone apna sar dhaanka aur apni raftar tez ki jab tak unhone us waadi ko paar kar liya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَصْحَابِ الْحِجْرِ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ، أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to his companions who were at Al-Hijr, "Do not enter upon these people who are being punished, except in a weeping state, lest the same calamity as of theirs should befall you
64.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne apne sathiyon se, jo Al-Hijr mein the, kaha, "In logon ke paas mat jao jinke saath saza ho rahi hai, siwaye rote hue haalat mein, is dar se ke tumpar bhi wahi tabaahi na aa jaaye jaisa unpar aaya tha."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ ذَهَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِبَعْضِ حَاجَتِهِ، فَقُمْتُ أَسْكُبُ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ ـ لاَ أَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ قَالَ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ ـ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ، وَذَهَبَ يَغْسِلُ ذِرَاعَيْهِ فَضَاقَ عَلَيْهِ كُمُّ الْجُبَّةِ، فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِنْ تَحْتِ جُبَّتِهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا ثُمَّ مَسَحَ عَلَى خُفَّيْهِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Urwa bin Al-Mughira:Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba, said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and (when he had finished) I got up to pour water for him." I think that he said that the event had taken place during the Ghazwa of Tabuk. Al-Mughira added. "The Prophet (ﷺ) washed his face, and when he wanted to wash his forearms, the sleeves of his cloak became tight over them, so he took them out from underneath the cloak and then he washed them (i.e. his forearms) and passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
64.hi: Urwa bin Al-Mughira bataate hain: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Nabi qaza-e-hajat ke liye bahar gaye, aur (jab unhone khatm kiya) main unke liye paani daalne ke liye utha." Mujhe lagta hai unhone kaha ke yeh ghatna Ghazwa Tabuk ke dauran huee thi. Al-Mughira ne joda, "Nabi ne apna chehra dhoya, aur jab woh apni baahen dhone chahte the, unke choge ki aastinen unke haathon par tang ho gaee, isliye unhone unhe (yaani apni baahon ko) choge ke neeche se nikala aur phir unhe (yaani apni baahon ko) dhoya aur apne Khuffs (yaani mote kapde ya chamde se bane mojen) par gile haath phera."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ حَتَّى إِذَا أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذِهِ طَابَةُ، وَهَذَا أُحُدٌ، جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Humaid:We returned in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) from the Ghazwa of Tabuk, and when we looked upon Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is Taba (i.e. Medina), and this is Uhud, a mountain that loves us and is loved by us
64.hi: Abu Humaid bataate hain: Hum Nabi ki sohbat mein Ghazwa Tabuk se wapas aaye, aur jab humne Madina ko dekha, Nabi ne kaha, "Yeh Taba hai (yaani Madina), aur yeh Uhud hai, ek pahad jo humse pyar karta hai aur jise hum pyar karte hain."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَعَ مِنْ غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَدَنَا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَقْوَامًا مَا سِرْتُمْ مَسِيرًا وَلاَ قَطَعْتُمْ وَادِيًا إِلاَّ كَانُوا مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ بِالْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهُمْ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، حَبَسَهُمُ الْعُذْرُ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) returned from the Ghazwa of Tabuk, and when he approached Medina, he said, "There are some people in Medina who were with you all the time, you did not travel any portion of the journey nor crossed any valley, but they were with you." They (i.e. the people) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Even though they were at Medina?" He said, "Yes, because they were stopped by a genuine excuse
64.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool Ghazwa Tabuk se wapas aaye, aur jab woh Madina ke qareeb pahunche, unhone kaha, "Madina mein kuch log hain jo poore safar mein tumhare saath the; tumne safar ka koee hissa tay nahi kiya, na koee waadi paar ki, magar woh tumhare saath the." Unhone (yaani logon ne) kaha, "Ya Allah ke Rasool! Chahe woh Madina mein hi rahe?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, kyunke unhe ek sachcha bahane ne roka tha."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ بِكِتَابِهِ إِلَى كِسْرَى مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ السَّهْمِيِّ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْفَعَهُ إِلَى عَظِيمِ الْبَحْرَيْنِ، فَدَفَعَهُ عَظِيمُ الْبَحْرَيْنِ إِلَى كِسْرَى، فَلَمَّا قَرَأَهُ مَزَّقَهُ ـ فَحَسِبْتُ أَنَّ ابْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ قَالَ ـ فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُمَزَّقُوا كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a letter to Khosrau with `Abdullah bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi and told him to hand it over to the governor of Al-Bahrain. The governor of Al-Bahrain handed it over to Khosrau, and when he read the latter, he tore it into pieces. (The sub-narrator added, "I think that Ibn Al-Musaiyab said, 'Allah's Apostle invoked (Allah) to tear them all (Khosrau and his companions) totally into pieces
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool ne Khosrau ko ek khat Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Hudhafa As-Sahmi ke haathon bheja aur unse kaha ke woh use Al-Bahrain ke gawarnar ko saunp den. Al-Bahrain ke gawarnar ne use Khosrau ko diya, aur jab unhone khat padha, unhone use tukdon mein phaad diya. (Subordinate raawi ne joda, "Mujhe lagta hai Ibn Al-Musaiyab ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool ne bad-dua ki ke woh (yaani Khosrau aur unke sathi) sab bhi poori tarah tukdon mein phaade jaen.'")

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ لَقَدْ نَفَعَنِي اللَّهُ بِكَلِمَةٍ سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَّامَ الْجَمَلِ، بَعْدَ مَا كِدْتُ أَنْ أَلْحَقَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْجَمَلِ فَأُقَاتِلَ مَعَهُمْ قَالَ لَمَّا بَلَغَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ أَهْلَ فَارِسَ قَدْ مَلَّكُوا عَلَيْهِمْ بِنْتَ كِسْرَى قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَنْ يُفْلِحَ قَوْمٌ وَلَّوْا أَمْرَهُمُ امْرَأَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Abu Bakra:During the days (of the battle) of Al-Jamal, Allah benefited me with a word I had heard from Allah's Apostle after I had been about to join the Companions of Al-Jamal (i.e. the camel) and fight along with them. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was informed that the Persians had crowned the daughter of Khosrau as their ruler, he said, "Such people as ruled by a lady will never be successful
64.hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Al-Jamal (yaani unt) ki jung ke dinon mein, Allah ne mujhe ek shabd se faayda diya jo maine Allah ke Rasool se suna tha, ismein mera Al-Jamal ke sathiyon mein shaamil hone aur unke saath jung karne ke bahut qareeb aane ke baad. Jab Allah ke Rasool ko yeh bataya gaya ke Faarsiyon ne Khosrau ki beti ko apni shaasak muqarrar kiya hai, unhone kaha, "Aise log jinki hukumat ek aurat karti hai, kabhi kaamyaab nahi honge."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ أَذْكُرُ أَنِّي خَرَجْتُ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ إِلَى ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ نَتَلَقَّى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:I remember that I went out with the boys to (the place called) Thaniyat-ul-Wada` to receive Allah's Apostle
64.hi: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Mujhe yaad hai main aur baaki bachche Thaniyat-ul-Wada nikle Allah ke Rasool ka swagat karne ke liye.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ، أَذْكُرُ أَنِّي خَرَجْتُ مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ نَتَلَقَّى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى ثَنِيَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مَقْدَمَهُ مِنْ غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated As-Saib:I remember I went out with the boys to Thaniyat-ul-Wada` to receive the Prophet (ﷺ) when he returned from the Ghazwa of Tabuk
64.hi: As-Saib bataate hain: Mujhe yaad hai main aur baaki bachche Thaniyat-ul-Wada nikle Nabi ka swagat karne jab woh Ghazwa Tabuk se wapas aaye.

64.ar: وَقَالَ يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ مَا أَزَالُ أَجِدُ أَلَمَ الطَّعَامِ الَّذِي أَكَلْتُ بِخَيْبَرَ، فَهَذَا أَوَانُ وَجَدْتُ انْقِطَاعَ أَبْهَرِي مِنْ ذَلِكَ السَّمِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) in his ailment in which he died, used to say, "O `Aisha! I still feel the pain caused by the food I ate at Khaibar, and at this time, I feel as if my aorta is being cut from that poison
64.hi: Ayesha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi apni us bimari mein jismein unka intiqal hua, kaha karte the, "Aye Ayesha! Mujhe abhi bhi Khaibar mein khaye hue khaane ka dard mahsoos ho raha hai, aur is waqt, mujhe lagta hai mano meri mukhya dhamani us zahar ki wajah se kati ja rahi hai."

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِ ـ ‏{‏الْمُرْسَلاَتِ عُرْفًا‏}‏ ثُمَّ مَا صَلَّى لَنَا بَعْدَهَا حَتَّى قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Um Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting Surat-al-Mursalat `Urfan (77) in the Maghrib prayer, and after that prayer he did not lead us in any prayer till he died
64.hi: Umm Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith bataati hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko Maghrib ki namaz mein Surah Al-Mursalat padhte suna, aur us namaz ke baad unhone humein kabhi koi aur namaz nahi padhaayi, yahaan tak ke unka wisal ho gaya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُدْنِي ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ إِنَّ لَنَا أَبْنَاءً مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ تَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ عُمَرُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ هَذِهِ الآيَةِ ‏{‏إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ‏}‏ فَقَالَ أَجَلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْلَمَهُ إِيَّاهُ، فَقَالَ مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ مَا تَعْلَمُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: `Umar bin Al-Khattab used to let Ibn `Abbas sit beside him, so `AbdurRahman bin `Auf said to `Umar, "We have sons similar to him." `Umar replied, "(I respect him) because of his status that you know." `Umar then asked Ibn `Abbas about the meaning of this Holy Verse:-- "When comes the help of Allah and the conquest of Mecca . . ." (110.1) Ibn `Abbas replied, "That indicated the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which Allah informed him of." `Umar said, "I do not understand of it except what you understand
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Al-Khattab unhe apne paas baithaya karte the. Isper Abdur Rahman bin Auf (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne Umar se kaha, 'Hamare bhi to iske jaise bete hain (jo yahan baith sakte hain).' Umar ne jawab diya, 'Iska jo martaba tumhe pata hai, usi wajah se (main isse apne paas baithata hoon).' Phir Umar ne Ibn Abbas se is Ayat ka matlab pucha: 'Jab Allah ki madad aur Makkah ki fatah aa jaaye...' Ibn Abbas ne jawab diya, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat ki taraf ishara hai, jiski khabar Allah ne unhe de di thi.' Umar ne kaha, 'Jo tum samajhte ho, main bhi wahi samajhta hoon iska.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ اشْتَدَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُونِي أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لَنْ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَتَنَازَعُوا، وَلاَ يَنْبَغِي عِنْدَ نَبِيٍّ تَنَازُعٌ، فَقَالُوا مَا شَأْنُهُ أَهَجَرَ اسْتَفْهِمُوهُ فَذَهَبُوا يَرُدُّونَ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعُونِي فَالَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا تَدْعُونِي إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَوْصَاهُمْ بِثَلاَثٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْرِجُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ، وَأَجِيزُوا الْوَفْدَ بِنَحْوِ مَا كُنْتُ أُجِيزُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَكَتَ عَنِ الثَّالِثَةِ، أَوْ قَالَ فَنَسِيتُهَا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Thursday! And how great that Thursday was! The ailment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became worse (on Thursday) and he said, "Fetch me something so that I may write to you something after which you will never go astray." The people (present there) differed in this matter, and it was not right to differ before a prophet. Some said, "What is wrong with him ? (Do you think ) he is delirious (seriously ill)? Ask him ( to understand his state )." So they went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked him again. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Leave me, for my present state is better than what you call me for." Then he ordered them to do three things. He said, "Turn the pagans out of the 'Arabian Peninsula; respect and give gifts to the foreign delegations as you have seen me dealing with them." (Sa`id bin Jubair, the sub-narrator said that Ibn `Abbas kept quiet as regards the third order, or he said, "I forgot it.") (See Hadith No. 116 Vol)
64.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Guruwar (Thursday)! Aur wo Guruwar kaisa tha! Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimari us din aur badh gayi thi, aur unhone farmaya, 'Kuch lao, main tumhare liye kuch likh doon jiske baad tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge.' Wahan maujood logon mein ikhtelaf ho gaya, halaanke Nabi ke saamne ikhtelaf karna theek nahi tha. Kuch logon ne kaha, 'Inhe kya ho gaya hai? (Kahin) ye bimari ki shiddat mein bahekne to nahi lage? Inse (saaf saaf) pucho.' Wo Nabi (SAW) ke paas gaye aur dobara pucha. Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Mujhe chhod do, jis haalat mein main hoon wo us se behtar hai jiske liye tum mujhe bula rahe ho.' Phir unhone teen baatein karne ka hukm diya. Farmaya, 'Mushrikon ko Jazeera-e-Arab se nikaal do, aur bahar se aane waale wafdon ki izzat karo aur unhe tohfe do, jaisa tumne mujhe unke saath karte dekha hai.' (Ravi Saeed bin Jubair kehte hain ke Ibn Abbas teesri baat par khamosh ho gaye, ya kaha ke main use bhool gaya.)

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا حُضِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمُّوا أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ غَلَبَهُ الْوَجَعُ وَعِنْدَكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ، حَسْبُنَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَاخْتَلَفَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَاخْتَصَمُوا، فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ قَرِّبُوا يَكْتُبُ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدَهُ‏.‏ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرُوا اللَّغْوَ وَالاِخْتِلاَفَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ الرَّزِيَّةَ كُلَّ الرَّزِيَّةِ مَا حَالَ بَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ لَهُمْ ذَلِكَ الْكِتَابَ لاِخْتِلاَفِهِمْ وَلَغَطِهِمْ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was on his deathbed and there were some men in the house, he said, 'Come near, I will write for you something after which you will not go astray.' Some of them ( i.e. his companions) said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is seriously ill and you have the (Holy) Qur'an. Allah's Book is sufficient for us.' So the people in the house differed and started disputing. Some of them said, 'Give him writing material so that he may write for you something after which you will not go astray.' while the others said the other way round. So when their talk and differences increased, Allah's Apostle said, "Get up." Ibn `Abbas used to say, "No doubt, it was very unfortunate (a great disaster) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prevented from writing for them that writing because of their differences and noise
64.hi: Ubaidullah bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni wafat ki bimari mein the aur ghar mein kuch log maujood the, unhone farmaya, 'Paas aao, main tumhare liye kuch likh doon jiske baad tum gumraah nahi hoge.' Unmein se kuch (sahaba) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sakht bimar hain aur tumhare paas Quran maujood hai, Allah ki Kitaab hamare liye kaafi hai.' Isper ghar ke logon mein ikhtelaf ho gaya aur bahas shuru ho gayi. Kuch ne kaha, 'Inhe likhne ka saamaan do taake ye tumhare liye kuch likh dein jiske baad tum gumraah na ho,' jabke doosron ne iske khilaaf kaha. Jab unki baaton aur ikhtelaf mein izaafa hua, to Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Uth jao (chale jao).' Ibn Abbas kaha karte the, 'Ye bahut bada nuqsaan (musibat) tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko unke ikhtelaf aur shor ki wajah se wo baat likhne se rok diya gaya.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَسَرَةُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ اللَّخْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ، فَسَارَّهَا بِشَىْءٍ، فَبَكَتْ، ثُمَّ دَعَاهَا فَسَارَّهَا بِشَىْءٍ فَضَحِكَتْ فَسَأَلْنَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَارَّنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ يُقْبَضُ فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ فَبَكَيْتُ، ثُمَّ سَارَّنِي فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنِّي أَوَّلُ أَهْلِهِ يَتْبَعُهُ فَضَحِكْتُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) called Fatima during his fatal illness and told her something secretly and she wept. Then he called her again and told her something secretly, and she started laughing. When we asked her about that, she said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) first told me secretly that he would expire in that disease in which he died, so I wept; then he told me secretly that I would be the first of his family to follow him, so I laughed ( at that time)
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni aakhri bimari mein Fatima (رضی اللہ عنہا) ko bulaya aur unse kuch chupke se kaha, jispar wo ro padi. Phir unhone dobara bulaya aur kuch aur chupke se kaha, jispar wo hansne lagi. Jab humne unse iski wajah poochi, to unhone bataya, 'Nabi (SAW) ne pehle mujhe chupke se bataya ke wo isi bimari mein wafat pa jaayenge, is liye main ro padi; phir unhone bataya ke unke gharwalon mein sabse pehle main unse (jaakar) milungi, is liye main has padi.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَمُوتُ نَبِيٌّ حَتَّى يُخَيَّرَ بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، فَسَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ وَأَخَذَتْهُ بُحَّةٌ يَقُولُ ‏{‏مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ، فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ خُيِّرَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:I used to hear (from the Prophet) that no Prophet dies till he is given the option to select either the worldly life or the life of the Hereafter. I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) in his fatal disease, with his voice becoming hoarse, saying, "In the company of those on whom is the grace of Allah ..( to the end of the Verse )." (4.69) Thereupon I thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) had been given the option
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Main (Nabi SAW se) suna karti thi ke koi Nabi tab tak wafat nahi paata jab tak use duniya ki zindagi aur aakhirat ki zindagi mein se ek chunne ka ikhtiyar na diya jaaye. Maine Nabi (SAW) ko unki aakhri bimari mein, jab unki awaaz bhaari ho gayi thi, ye kehte suna, 'Un logon ke saath jinpar Allah ka inaam hua hai...' (aayat ke aakhir tak). Isse mujhe laga ke unhe (aakhirat chunne ka) ikhtiyar de diya gaya hai.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا مَرِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَرَضَ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ جَعَلَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) fell ill in his fatal illness, he started saying, "With the highest companion
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Nabi (SAW) apni aakhri bimari mein bimar pade, to wo kehne lage, '(Mujhe) sabse buland saathi ke saath (rakh).'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ إِنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ صَحِيحٌ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقْبَضْ نَبِيٌّ قَطُّ حَتَّى يَرَى مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُحَيَّا أَوْ يُخَيَّرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا اشْتَكَى وَحَضَرَهُ الْقَبْضُ وَرَأْسُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِ عَائِشَةَ غُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ شَخَصَ بَصَرُهُ نَحْوَ سَقْفِ الْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِذًا لاَ يُجَاوِرُنَا‏.‏ فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ حَدِيثُهُ الَّذِي كَانَ يُحَدِّثُنَا وَهْوَ صَحِيحٌ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Aisha:When Allah's Apostle was in good health, he used to say, "Never does a prophet die unless he is shown his place in Paradise ( before his death ), and then he is made alive or given the option." When the Prophet became ill and his last moments came while his head was on my thigh, he became unconscious, and when he came to his senses, he looked towards the roof of the house and then said, "O Allah! (Please let me be) with the highest companion." Thereupon I said, "Hence he is not going to stay with us?" Then I came to know that his state was the confirmation of the narration he used to mention to us while he was in good health
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) tandurust the, to farmaya karte the, 'Koi Nabi tab tak wafat nahi paata jab tak use jannat mein uski jagah dikha na di jaaye, uske baad use zinda rakha jaata hai ya ikhtiyar diya jaata hai.' Jab Nabi (SAW) bimar hue aur unke aakhri lamhe aaye, us waqt unka sar mere ran par tha, wo behosh ho gaye, aur jab hosh mein aaye to chhat ki taraf dekha aur farmaya, 'Aye Allah! (Mujhe) sabse buland saathi ke saath rakh.' Isper maine (dil mein) socha, 'To ab ye hamare saath nahi rahenge.' Phir mujhe samajh aaya ke unki ye halat usi baat ki tasdeeq thi jo wo tandurusti mein hamein bataya karte the.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، عَنْ صَخْرِ بْنِ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، دَخَلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا مُسْنِدَتُهُ إِلَى صَدْرِي، وَمَعَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ سِوَاكٌ رَطْبٌ يَسْتَنُّ بِهِ، فَأَبَدَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَصَرَهُ، فَأَخَذْتُ السِّوَاكَ فَقَصَمْتُهُ وَنَفَضْتُهُ وَطَيَّبْتُهُ، ثُمَّ دَفَعْتُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَنَّ بِهِ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَنَّ اسْتِنَانًا قَطُّ أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ، فَمَا عَدَا أَنْ فَرَغَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَفَعَ يَدَهُ أَوْ إِصْبَعَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ قَضَى، وَكَانَتْ تَقُولُ مَاتَ بَيْنَ حَاقِنَتِي وَذَاقِنَتِي‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Aisha:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr entered upon the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was supporting the Prophet (ﷺ) on my chest. `AbdurRahman had a fresh Siwak then and he was cleaning his teeth with it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at it, so I took the Siwak, cut it (chewed it with my teeth), shook it and made it soft (with water), and then gave it to the Prophet (ﷺ) who cleaned his teeth with it. I had never seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cleaning his teeth in a better way. After finishing the brushing of his teeth, he lifted his hand or his finger and said thrice, "O Allah! Let me be with the highest companions," and then died. `Aisha used to say, "He died while his head was resting between my chest and chin
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaye, us waqt main Nabi (SAW) ko apne seene se tikaaye hue thi. Abdur Rahman ke paas ek taaza Siwak tha aur wo usse apne daant saaf kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne uski taraf dekha, to maine wo Siwak le liya, use chaba kar aur paani se naram karke Nabi (SAW) ko de diya, unhone usse apne daant saaf kiye. Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko isse pehle kabhi itni achi tarah daant saaf karte nahi dekha tha. Daant saaf karne ke baad, unhone apna haath ya ungli uthaayi aur teen baar farmaya, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe sabse buland saathiyon ke saath rakh,' aur phir wafat ho gayi. Aisha kaha karti thin, 'Unka wisal us waqt hua jab unka sar mere seene aur thodi ke beech tha.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي حِبَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى نَفَثَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَمَسَحَ عَنْهُ بِيَدِهِ فَلَمَّا اشْتَكَى وَجَعَهُ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ طَفِقْتُ أَنْفِثُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ، الَّتِي كَانَ يَنْفِثُ، وَأَمْسَحُ بِيَدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْهُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became ill, he used to recite the Muawidhatan (i.e. the last two surahs of the Qur'an) and blow his breath over himself (after their recitation ) and rubbed his hands over his body. So when he was afflicted with his fatal illness. I started reciting the Muawidhatan and blowing my breath over him as he used to do and then I rubbed the hand of the Prophet (ﷺ) over his body
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Jab bhi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) bimar hote, to Muawwidhatain (Quran ki aakhri do Surahein) padhte, apni saans khud par phoonkte aur apne haathon ko apne badan par phairte. Jab wo apni aakhri bimari mein mubtala hue, to main unki jagah Muawwidhatain padhne aur unpar phoonkne lagi, jaisa wo khud kiya karte the, phir unke apne haath ko unke badan par phairne lagi.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْغَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتَ، وَهْوَ مُسْنِدٌ إِلَىَّ ظَهْرَهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ ‏"‏‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) and listened to him before his death while he was leaning his back on me and saying, "O Allah! Forgive me, and bestow Your Mercy on me, and let me meet the (highest) companions (of the Hereafter)." (See the Qur'an (4:69) and Hadith
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Maine apni maut se pehle Nabi (SAW) ko, jab wo mere upar tek lagaaye hue the, ye kehte suna, 'Aye Allah! Mujhe maaf farma, mujh par apni rehmat naazil farma, aur mujhe (sabse) buland saathiyon se mila de.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ الْوَزَّانِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَقُمْ مِنْهُ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ، اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَوْلاَ ذَلِكَ لأُبْرِزَ قَبْرُهُ‏.‏ خَشِيَ أَنْ يُتَّخَذَ مَسْجِدًا‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:`Aisha said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said during his fatal illness, "Allah cursed the Jews for they took the graves of their prophets as places for worship." `Aisha added, "Had it not been for that (statement of the Prophet ) his grave would have been made conspicuous. But he was afraid that it might be taken as a place for worship
64.hi: Urwa bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne apni aakhri bimari mein farmaya, "Allah ne Yahudiyon par laanat ki, kyunke unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadat-gaah bana liya tha."' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Agar ye baat na hoti to unki qabr khuli-aam (numaayan) banayi jaati, magar unhe dar tha ke kahin ise ibaadat-gaah na bana liya jaaye.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ، فَخَرَجَ وَهْوَ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ، بَيْنَ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَبَيْنَ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بِالَّذِي قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ، فَقَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الآخَرُ الَّذِي لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا دَخَلَ بَيْتِي وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَرِيقُوا عَلَىَّ مِنْ سَبْعِ قِرَبٍ لَمْ تُحْلَلْ أَوْكِيَتُهُنَّ لَعَلِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَى النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَجْلَسْنَاهُ فِي مِخْضَبٍ لِحَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ طَفِقْنَا نَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ تِلْكَ الْقِرَبِ، حَتَّى طَفِقَ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْنَا بِيَدِهِ أَنْ قَدْ فَعَلْتُنَّ قَالَتْ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى النَّاسِ فَصَلَّى لَهُمْ وَخَطَبَهُمْ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) "When the ailment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became aggravated, he requested his wives to permit him to be (treated) nursed in my house, and they gave him permission. He came out (to my house), walking between two men with his feet dragging on the ground, between `Abbas bin `Abdul--Muttalib and another man" 'Ubaidullah said, "I told `Abdullah of what `Aisha had said, `Abdullah bin `Abbas said to me, 'Do you know who is the other man whom `Aisha did not name?' I said, 'No.' Ibn `Abbas said, 'It was `Ali bin Abu Talib." `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to narrate saying, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered my house and his disease became aggravated, he said, " Pour on me the water of seven water skins, the mouths of which have not been untied, so that I may give advice to the people.' So we let him sit in a big basin belonging to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) and then started to pour water on him from these water skins till he started pointing to us with his hands intending to say, 'You have done your job." `Aisha added, "Then he went out to the people and led them in prayer and preached to them
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimari badh gayi, to unhone apni azwaaj se ijaazat maangi ke unka ilaaj mere ghar mein ho, aur unhone ijaazat de di. Wo (mere ghar) do aadmiyon ke sahaare, paanv zameen par ghisaite hue nikle - Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib aur ek aur shaks ke darmiyan.' Ubaidullah kehte hain, 'Maine Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Aisha ki ye baat bataayi. Abdullah bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne mujhse pucha, "Kya tumhe pata hai wo dusra shaks kaun tha jiska naam Aisha ne nahi liya?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, "Wo Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Talib the."' Aisha (Nabi ki zawja) bataya karti thin, 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mere ghar mein daakhil hue aur unki bimari badh gayi, to unhone farmaya, "Mujh par saat mashkon ka paani daalo, jinke muh nahi khole gaye hon, taake main logon ko naseehat kar sakoon."' Hum unhe Hafsa (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) ke ek bade tashat mein bithaya, aur unpar in mashkon se paani daalne lage, yahaan tak ke unhone apne haathon se ishara karke kaha, 'Tumne apna kaam kar diya.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Phir wo bahar aaye aur logon ko namaz padhaayi aur unhe naseehat ki.'

64.ar: وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهم قَالاَ لَمَّا نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَفِقَ يَطْرَحُ خَمِيصَةً لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، فَإِذَا اغْتَمَّ كَشَفَهَا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ وَهْوَ كَذَلِكَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى، اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُحَذِّرُ مَا صَنَعُوا‏.‏
64.en: Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became ill seriously, he started covering his face with his woolen sheet, and when he felt short of breath, he removed it from his face and said, 'That is so! Allah's curse be on the Jews and the Christians, as they took the graves of their prophets as (places of worship),' intending to warn (the Muslims) of what they had done
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: 'Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) sakht bimar hue, to wo apna chehra apni oon ki chaadar se dhakne lage, aur jab unhe saans lene mein dikkat hoti to chaadar hata dete aur farmate, "Aisa hi hai! Yahudiyon aur Nasaara par Allah ki laanat ho, unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadat-gaah bana liya tha," (Musalmanon ko) usi cheez se khabardaar karte hue jo unhone (Yahud-o-Nasaara ne) ki thi.'

64.ar: أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ رَاجَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ، وَمَا حَمَلَنِي عَلَى كَثْرَةِ مُرَاجَعَتِهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقَعْ فِي قَلْبِي أَنْ يُحِبَّ النَّاسُ بَعْدَهُ رَجُلاً قَامَ مَقَامَهُ أَبَدًا، وَلاَ كُنْتُ أُرَى أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَقُومَ أَحَدٌ مَقَامَهُ إِلاَّ تَشَاءَمَ النَّاسُ بِهِ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ يَعْدِلَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَأَبُو مُوسَى وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Aisha added, "I argued with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) repeatedly about that matter (i.e. his order that Abu Bakr should lead the people in prayer in his place when he was ill), and what made me argue so much, was, that it never occurred to my mind that after the Prophet, the people would ever love a man who had taken his place, and I felt that anybody standing in his place, would be a bad omen to the people, so I wanted Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to give up the idea of choosing Abu Bakr (to lead the people in prayer)
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne aage kaha: 'Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se is baat par (yaani unka ye hukm ke bimari mein Abu Bakr unki jagah namaz padhaayein) baar baar bahas ki, aur itni zyada bahas karne ki wajah ye thi ke mere zehen mein kabhi ye baat nahi aayi thi ke Nabi (SAW) ke baad log unki jagah lene waale kisi shaks se mohabbat karenge, aur mujhe laga ke jo bhi unki jagah khada hoga uske liye ye logon ki nazar mein badshugooni (bad-faal) hogi, is liye main chahti thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) Abu Bakr ko (is kaam ke liye) chunne ka iraada chhod dein.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَاتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِنَّهُ لَبَيْنَ حَاقِنَتِي وَذَاقِنَتِي، فَلاَ أَكْرَهُ شِدَّةَ الْمَوْتِ لأَحَدٍ أَبَدًا بَعْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) died while he was between my chest and chin, so I never dislike the death agony for anyone after the Prophet
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ki wafat us waqt hui jab wo mere seene aur thodi ke beech the, isliye mujhe Nabi (SAW) ke baad kisi ki bhi maut ki sakhti buri nahi lagti.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ ـ وَكَانَ كَعْبُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَحَدَ الثَّلاَثَةِ الَّذِينَ تِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ يَا أَبَا حَسَنٍ، كَيْفَ أَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَصْبَحَ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ بَارِئًا، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ عَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَنْتَ وَاللَّهِ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ عَبْدُ الْعَصَا، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لأُرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَوْفَ يُتَوَفَّى مِنْ وَجَعِهِ هَذَا، إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ وُجُوهَ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، اذْهَبْ بِنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلْنَسْأَلْهُ فِيمَنْ هَذَا الأَمْرُ، إِنْ كَانَ فِينَا عَلِمْنَا ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي غَيْرِنَا عَلِمْنَاهُ فَأَوْصَى بِنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ إِنَّا وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ سَأَلْنَاهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَنَعَنَاهَا لاَ يُعْطِينَاهَا النَّاسُ بَعْدَهُ، وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَسْأَلُهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:`Ali bin Abu Talib came out of the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his fatal illness. The people asked, "O Abu Hasan (i.e. `Ali)! How is the health of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) this morning?" `Ali replied, "He has recovered with the Grace of Allah." `Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib held him by the hand and said to him, "In three days you, by Allah, will be ruled (by somebody else). And by Allah, I feel that Allah's Apostle will die from this ailment of his, for I know how the faces of the offspring of `Abdul Muttalib look at the time of their death. So let us go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ask him who will take over the Caliphate. If it is given to us we will know as to it, and if it is given to somebody else, we will inform him so that he may tell the new ruler to take care of us." `Ali said, "By Allah, if we asked Allah's Apostle for it (i.e. the Caliphate) and he denied it to us, the people will never give it to us after that. And by Allah, I will not ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for it
64.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Talib Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki aakhri bimari ke dauraan (ghar se) baahar aaye. Logon ne pucha, 'Aye Abu Hasan (yaani Ali)! Aaj subah Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki tabiyat kaisi hai?' Ali ne jawab diya, 'Allah ke fazl se, wo theek ho gaye hain.' Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib ne unka haath pakda aur kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, teen din mein tum par (kisi aur ki) hukoomat ho jaayegi. Aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe lagta hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) is bimari mein wafat pa jaayenge, kyunke mujhe pata hai Abdul Muttalib ki aulaad ke chehre maut ke waqt kaise hote hain. Chalo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas chalte hain aur unse pucchte hain ke Khilafat kise di jaayegi. Agar wo humein di gayi to hum jaan jaayenge, aur agar kisi aur ko di gayi to hum use bata denge taake wo naye Khalifa se hamara khayal rakhne ko keh sake.' Ali ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, agar humne Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye (Khilafat) maangi aur unhone hume na di, to log hume kabhi ye nahi denge iske baad. Aur Allah ki qasam, main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) se ye nahi maangunga.'

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، بَيْنَا هُمْ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الاِثْنَيْنِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي لَهُمْ لَمْ يَفْجَأْهُمْ إِلاَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ كَشَفَ سِتْرَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ فِي صُفُوفِ الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَبَسَّمَ يَضْحَكُ، فَنَكَصَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ لِيَصِلَ الصَّفَّ، وَظَنَّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ وَهَمَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ أَنْ يَفْتَتِنُوا فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ فَرَحًا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِيَدِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَتِمُّوا صَلاَتَكُمْ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْحُجْرَةَ وَأَرْخَى السِّتْرَ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:While the Muslims were offering the Fajr prayer on Monday and Abu Bakr was leading them in prayer, suddenly Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted the curtain of `Aisha's dwelling and looked at them while they were in the rows of the prayers and smiled. Abu Bakr retreated to join the row, thinking that Allah's Apostle wanted to come out for the prayer. The Muslims were about to be put to trial in their prayer (i.e. were about to give up praying) because of being overjoyed at seeing Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). But Allah's Apostle beckoned them with his hand to complete their prayer and then entered the dwelling and let fall the curtain
64.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Musalmaan Somwaar ke din Fajr ki namaz padh rahe the aur Abu Bakr unhe namaz padha rahe the, achanak Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ke hujre ka parda utha diya aur unhe namaz ki safon mein dekha aur muskuraaye. Abu Bakr (namaz chodkar) saf mein wapas aane laage, ye soch kar ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) namaz ke liye baahar aana chahte hain. Musalmaan Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko dekh kar khushi se apni namaz mein fitne mein padne hi waale the (yaani namaz chodne hi waale the), magar Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unhe haath se ishara karke apni namaz poori karne ko kaha, phir hujre mein wapas chale gaye aur parda gira diya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا عَمْرٍو، ذَكْوَانَ مَوْلَى عَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ كَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِنَّ مِنْ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ عَلَىَّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُوُفِّيَ فِي بَيْتِي وَفِي يَوْمِي، وَبَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ رِيقِي وَرِيقِهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ، دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَبِيَدِهِ السِّوَاكُ وَأَنَا مُسْنِدَةٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ، وَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ يُحِبُّ السِّوَاكَ فَقُلْتُ آخُذُهُ لَكَ فَأَشَارَ بِرَأْسِهِ أَنْ نَعَمْ، فَتَنَاوَلْتُهُ فَاشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَقُلْتُ أُلَيِّنُهُ لَكَ فَأَشَارَ بِرَأْسِهِ أَنْ نَعَمْ، فَلَيَّنْتُهُ، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ رَكْوَةٌ ـ أَوْ عُلْبَةٌ يَشُكُّ عُمَرُ ـ فِيهَا مَاءٌ، فَجَعَلَ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَصَبَ يَدَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى قُبِضَ وَمَالَتْ يَدُهُ‏.‏
64.en: Narrated Aisha:It was one of the favors of Allah towards me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) expired in my house on the day of my turn while he was leaning against my chest and Allah made my saliva mix with his saliva at his death. `Abdur-Rahman entered upon me with a Siwak in his hand and I was supporting (the back of) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (against my chest ). I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) looking at it (i.e. Siwak) and I knew that he loved the Siwak, so I said ( to him ), "Shall I take it for you ? " He nodded in agreement. So I took it and it was too stiff for him to use, so I said, "Shall I soften it for you ?" He nodded his approval. So I softened it and he cleaned his teeth with it. In front of him there was a jug or a tin, (The sub-narrator, `Umar is in doubt as to which was right) containing water. He started dipping his hand in the water and rubbing his face with it, he said, "None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. Death has its agonies." He then lifted his hands (towards the sky) and started saying, "With the highest companion," till he expired and his hand dropped down
64.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Ye Allah ki mujh par ek badi meharbaani thi ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki wafat mere hi ghar mein hui, mere hi baari ke din, jab wo mere seene se tikaaye hue the, aur Allah ne unki maut ke waqt mera lar unke lar ke saath mila diya. Abdur Rahman mere paas ek Siwak liye aaye, aur us waqt main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko (apne seene se) sahaara de rahi thi. Maine dekha ke Nabi (SAW) us (Siwak) ki taraf dekh rahe hain aur mujhe pata tha ke unhe Siwak pasand hai, to maine (unse) kaha, 'Kya main ye aapke liye le loon?' Unhone sar hila kar haan kaha. To maine wo le liya, lekin wo unke istemaal ke liye zyada sakht tha, to maine kaha, 'Kya main ise aapke liye naram kar doon?' Unhone phir sar hila kar haan kaha. To maine use naram kiya aur unhone usse apne daant saaf kiye. Unke saamne ek ghada ya tasla tha (ravi Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko yaqeen nahi ke kaunsa tha) jismein paani tha. Wo apna haath paani mein daal kar apne chehre par phairne lage, aur farmaya, 'Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi. Maut ki apni sakhtiyaan hoti hain.' Phir unhone apne haath (aasman ki taraf) uthaaye aur kehne lage, 'Sabse buland saathi ke saath,' yahaan tak ke unki wafat ho gayi aur unka haath neeche gir gaya.

64.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَسْأَلُ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ يَقُولَ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ أَنَا غَدًا أَيْنَ أَنَا غَدًا ‏"‏ يُرِيدُ يَوْمَ عَائِشَةَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُ أَزْوَاجُهُ يَكُونُ حَيْثُ شَاءَ، فَكَانَ فِي بَيْتِ عَائِشَةَ حَتَّى مَاتَ عِنْدَهَا، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَمَاتَ فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي كَانَ يَدُورُ عَلَىَّ فِيهِ فِي بَيْتِي، فَقَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّ رَأْسَهُ لَبَيْنَ نَحْرِي وَسَحْرِي، وَخَالَطَ رِيقُهُ رِيقِي ـ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ ـ دَخَلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَمَعَهُ سِوَاكٌ يَسْتَنُّ بِهِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَعْطِنِي هَذَا السِّوَاكَ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَانِيهِ فَقَضِمْتُهُ، ثُمَّ مَضَغْتُهُ فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَنَّ بِهِ وَهْوَ مُسْتَنِدٌ إِلَى صَدْرِي‏.‏
64.en: Narrated `Urwa:`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness, used to ask, 'Where will I be tomorrow? Where will I be tomorrow?", seeking `Aisha's turn. His wives allowed him to stay wherever he wished. So he stayed at `Aisha's house till he expired while he was with her." `Aisha added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) expired on the day of my turn in my house and he was taken unto Allah while his head was against my chest and his saliva mixed with my saliva." `Aisha added, "Abdur-Rahman bin Abu Bakr came in, carrying a Siwak he was cleaning his teeth with. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) looked at it and I said to him, 'O `AbdurRahman! Give me this Siwak.' So he gave it to me and I cut it, chewed it (it's end) and gave it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who cleaned his teeth with it while he was resting against my chest
64.hi: Urwa bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne kaha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) apni aakhri bimari mein pucha karte the, "Kal main kahaan hounga? Kal main kahaan hounga?" - wo Aisha ki baari (jaldi aane) ki tamanna kar rahe the. Unki azwaaj ne unhe ijaazat de di ke wo jahaan chahein reh sakte hain. To wo Aisha ke ghar mein rahe, yahaan tak ke unka wisal wahin hua.' Aisha ne aage kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ki wafat mere ghar mein, mere hi baari ke din hui, aur unhe Allah ke paas is haal mein le jaaya gaya ke unka sar mere seene se tika hua tha aur unka lar mere lar mein mil gaya tha.' Aisha ne ye bhi bataya, 'Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr andar aaye, unke haath mein ek Siwak tha jisse wo apne daant saaf kar rahe the. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usko dekha aur maine unse kaha, "Aye Abdur Rahman! Ye Siwak mujhe do." To unhone wo mujhe de diya, maine use kaat kar chabaaya aur Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko de diya, jinhone usse apne daant saaf kiye jabke wo mere seene se tike hue the.'
