76.en: Narrated Sa`d:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Whoever takes seven 'Ajwa dates in the morning will not be effected by magic or poison on that day
76.hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Jo koi subah saat Ajwa khajoorein khaaye, use us din jaadu ya zeher asar nahi karega.'

76.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ‏.‏ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ الشَّأْمَ‏.‏ وَزَادَ اللَّيْثُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ وَسَأَلْتُهُ هَلْ نَتَوَضَّأُ أَوْ نَشْرَبُ أَلْبَانَ الأُتُنِ أَوْ مَرَارَةَ السَّبُعِ أَوْ أَبْوَالَ الإِبِلِ‏.‏ قَالَ قَدْ كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ يَتَدَاوَوْنَ بِهَا، فَلاَ يَرَوْنَ بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا، فَأَمَّا أَلْبَانُ الأُتُنِ فَقَدْ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ لُحُومِهَا، وَلَمْ يَبْلُغْنَا عَنْ أَلْبَانِهَا أَمْرٌ وَلاَ نَهْىٌ، وَأَمَّا مَرَارَةُ السَّبُعِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ أَنَّ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ‏.‏
76.en: Narrated Abu Tha`laba Al-Khushani:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the eating of wild animals having fangs. (Az-Zuhri said: I did not hear this narration except when I went to Sham.) Al-Laith said: Narrated Yunus: I asked Ibn Shihab, "May we perform the ablution with the milk of she-asses or drink it, or drink the bile of wild animals or urine of camels?" He replied, "The Muslims used to treat themselves with that and did not see any harm in it. As for the milk of she-asses, we have learnt that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of their meat, but we have not received any information whether drinking of their milk is allowed or forbidden." As for the bile of wild animals, Ibn Shihab said, "Abu Idris Al-Khaulani told me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of the flesh of every wild beast having fangs
76.hi: Abu Thalaba Al-Khushani bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne naukeele daant waale jangli jaanwaron ka gosht khaane se mana kiya. (Az-Zuhri ne kaha: Maine ye riwayat sirf tab suni jab main Sham gaya.) Ravi Al-Laith bataate hain: Yunus ne bataya: Maine Ibn Shihab se pucha, 'Kya hum gadhi ke doodh se wuzu kar sakte hain ya use pee sakte hain, ya jangli jaanwaron ki pitt (bile) ya oonton ke peshaab pee sakte hain?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Musalmaan inse apna ilaaj kiya karte the aur ismein koi harj nahi samajhte the. Jahaan tak gadhi ke doodh ki baat hai, humein pata chala hai ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne unka gosht khaane se mana kiya tha, magar humein koi khabar nahi mili ke unka doodh peena jaayez hai ya haraam.' Jangli jaanwaron ki pitt ke baare mein, Ibn Shihab ne kaha, 'Abu Idris Al-Khaulani ne mujhe bataya ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne naukeele daant waale har jangli jaanwar ka gosht khaane se mana kiya.'

76.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي تَيْمٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَقَعَ الذُّبَابُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ، فَلْيَغْمِسْهُ كُلَّهُ، ثُمَّ لْيَطْرَحْهُ، فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ شِفَاءً وَفِي الآخَرِ دَاءً ‏"‏‏.‏
76.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a fly falls in the vessel of any of you, let him dip all of it (into the vessel) and then throw it away, for in one of its wings there is a disease and in the other there is healing (antidote for it) i e. the treatment for that disease
76.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Agar makkhi tum mein se kisi ke bartan mein gir jaaye, to use poori tarah (bartan mein) doobo do, phir use nikaal kar phenk do, kyunke uske ek pankh mein bimaari hai aur doosre mein shifa hai (yaani us bimaari ka ilaaj).'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، يُخْبِرُونَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ خُيَلاَءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Allah will not look at the person who drags his garment (behind him) out of conceit
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo ghamand mein apne kapde (zameen par) ghaseetta hai.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ خُيَلاَءَ لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَحَدَ شِقَّىْ إِزَارِي يَسْتَرْخِي، إِلاَّ أَنْ أَتَعَاهَدَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَسْتَ مِمَّنْ يَصْنَعُهُ خُيَلاَءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allah will not look, on the Day of Resurrection at the person who drags his garment (behind him) out of conceit. On that Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! One side of my Izar hangs low if I do not take care of it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'You are not one of those who do that out of conceit
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Qayamat ke din us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo ghamand mein apne kapde ghaseetta hai.' Isper Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere Izaar ka ek taraf neeche jhukta hai agar main iska khayaal na rakhoon.' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Tum unmein se nahi ho jo ye ghamand mein karte hain.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَنَحْنُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ يَجُرُّ ثَوْبَهُ مُسْتَعْجِلاً، حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَسْجِدَ وَثَابَ النَّاسُ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَجُلِّيَ عَنْهَا، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا فَصَلُّوا وَادْعُوا اللَّهَ حَتَّى يَكْشِفَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Bakra:The solar eclipse occurred while we were sitting with the Prophet (ﷺ) He got up dragging his garment (on the ground) hurriedly till he reached the mosque The people turned (to the mosque) and he offered a two-rak`at prayer whereupon the eclipse was over and he traced us and said, "The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah, so if you see a thing like this (eclipse) then offer the prayer and invoke Allah till He remove that state
77.hi: Abu Bakra (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Suraj grahan hua jab hum Nabi (SAW) ke saath baithe the. Wo apna kapda ghaseettte hue jaldi se uthe yahaan tak ke Masjid pahunche. Log (Masjid ki taraf) mude aur unhone do rakat namaz padhaayi, isi dauraan grahan khatam ho gaya, aur unhone humari taraf mudkar kaha, 'Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyaan hain, isliye agar tum aisi cheez (grahan) dekho, to namaz padho aur Allah se dua karo jab tak wo haalat door na ho jaaye.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَوْنُ بْنُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ بِلاَلاً جَاءَ بِعَنَزَةٍ فَرَكَزَهَا، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ الصَّلاَةَ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ فِي حُلَّةٍ مُشَمِّرًا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِلَى الْعَنَزَةِ، وَرَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ وَالدَّوَابَّ يَمُرُّونَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْعَنَزَةِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:I saw Bilal bringing a short spear (or stick) and fixing it in the ground, and then he proclaimed the Iqama of the prayer, and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) coming out, wearing a cloak with its sleeves rolled up. He then offered a two-rak`at prayer while facing the stick, and I saw the people and animals passing in front of him beyond the stick
77.hi: Abu Juhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Bilal (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ek chhoti bhaala (ya lakdi) laate aur zameen mein gaadte dekha, phir unhone namaz ki Iqamat ki, aur maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko baahar aate dekha, ek chogha pehne hue jiski aastin oopar chadhi hui thi. Unhone us lakdi ki taraf muh karke do rakat namaz padhi, aur maine logon aur jaanwaron ko us lakdi ke aage se guzarte dekha.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ مِنَ الإِزَارِ فَفِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The part of an Izar which hangs below the ankles is in the Fire
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Izaar ka wo hissa jo takhnon se neeche latakta hai, (Jahannam ki) Aag mein hoga.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِلَى مَنْ جَرَّ إِزَارَهُ بَطَرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Allah will not look, on the Day of Resurrection, at a person who drags his Izar (behind him) out of pride and arrogance
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Allah Qayamat ke din us shaks ki taraf nahi dekhega jo ghamand aur takabbur mein apna Izaar (zameen par) ghaseetta hai.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ـ أَوْ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي فِي حُلَّةٍ، تُعْجِبُهُ نَفْسُهُ مُرَجِّلٌ جُمَّتَهُ، إِذْ خَسَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ، فَهْوَ يَتَجَلَّلُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (or 'Abul Qasim) said, "While a man was walking, clad in a two-piece garment and proud of himself with his hair well-combed, suddenly Allah made him sink into the earth and he will go on sinking into it till the Day of Resurrection
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) (ya Abul Qasim) ne farmaya, 'Jab ek aadmi do-tukde kapde pehne, apne oopar ghamand karte hue, apne baal sanwaare hue chal raha tha, achaanak Allah ne use zameen mein dhaans diya, aur wo Qayamat tak dhansta hi rahega.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَا رَجُلٌ يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ، خُسِفَ بِهِ، فَهْوَ يَتَجَلَّلُ فِي الأَرْضِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ شُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، جَرِيرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَلَى باب دَارِهِ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was dragging his Izar on the ground (behind him), suddenly Allah made him sink into the earth and he will go on sinking into it till the Day of Resurrection." Narrated Abu Huraira: that he heard the Prophet (narrating as above No)
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jab ek aadmi apna Izaar zameen par ghaseett raha tha, achaanak Allah ne use zameen mein dhaans diya, aur wo Qayamat tak dhansta hi rahega.' Ravi Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain ke unhone bhi Nabi (SAW) se aisi hi riwaayat suni.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَطَرُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ مُحَارِبَ بْنَ دِثَارٍ عَلَى فَرَسٍ وَهْوَ يَأْتِي مَكَانَهُ الَّذِي يَقْضِي فِيهِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فَحَدَّثَنِي فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ مَخِيلَةً، لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِمُحَارِبٍ أَذَكَرَ إِزَارَهُ قَالَ مَا خَصَّ إِزَارًا وَلاَ قَمِيصًا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ جَبَلَةُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَقُدَامَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever drags his clothes (on the ground) out of pride and arrogance, Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo koi ghamand aur takabbur mein apne kapde (zameen par) ghaseette, Allah Qayamat ke din uski taraf nahi dekhega.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ رِفَاعَةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا جَالِسَةٌ وَعِنْدَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ تَحْتَ رِفَاعَةَ فَطَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلاَقِي، فَتَزَوَّجْتُ بَعْدَهُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الزَّبِيرِ، وَإِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا مَعَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ الْهُدْبَةِ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَتْ هُدْبَةً مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا، فَسَمِعَ خَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَوْلَهَا وَهْوَ بِالْبَابِ لَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ، قَالَتْ فَقَالَ خَالِدٌ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلاَ تَنْهَى هَذِهِ عَمَّا تَجْهَرُ بِهِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَزِيدُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى التَّبَسُّمِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَعَلَّكِ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ، لاَ، حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ وَتَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَصَارَ سُنَّةً بَعْدُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) The wife of Rifa`a Al-Qurazi came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while I was sitting, and Abu Bakr was also there. She said, 'O Allah's Apostle! I was the wife of Rifa`a and he divorced me irrevocably. Then I married `AbdurRahman bin Az-Zubair who, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), has only something like a fringe of a garment, Showing the fringe of her veil. Khalid bin Sa`id, who was standing at the door, for he had not been admitted, heard her statement and said, "O Abu Bakr! Why do you not stop this lady from saying such things openly before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" No, by Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did nothing but smiled. Then he said to the lady, "Perhaps you want to return to Rifa`a? That is impossible unless `Abdur-Rahman consummates his marriage with you." That became the tradition after him
77.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Rifa'a Al-Qurazi ki biwi Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aayi jab main baithi thi, aur Abu Bakr bhi wahaan the. Usne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Main Rifa'a ki biwi thi aur unhone mujhe qatai talaaq de di. Phir maine Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) se nikaah kiya jinke paas, Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool, sirf ek kapde ke kinaare jaisa kuch hai,' apne dupatte ka kinaara dikhaate hue. Khalid bin Saeed, jo darwaaze par khade the kyunke unhein andar aane ki ijaazat nahi mili thi, unhone uski baat suni aur kaha, 'Aye Abu Bakr! Aap is khaatoon ko Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saamne aise khule aam ye baatein kehne se kyun nahi rokte?' Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne bas muskuraaya. Phir unhone khaatoon se kaha, 'Shaayad tum Rifa'a ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Ye tab tak mumkin nahi jab tak Abdur Rahman tumhaare saath apna nikaah poora (rukhsati) na kar le.' Ye unke baad ek riwaayat (tareeka) ban gaya.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرِدَائِهِ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَمْشِي، وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ، حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَمْزَةُ، فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَأَذِنُوا لَهُمْ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for his Rida, put it on and set out walking. Zaid bin Haritha and I followed him till he reached the house where Harnza (bin `Abdul Muttalib) was present and asked for permission to enter, and they gave us permission
77.hi: Ali (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne apni Rida (chaadar) maangi, use pehna, aur chalne lage. Zaid bin Haritha aur main unke peechhe gaye yahaan tak ke wo us ghar tak pahunche jahaan Hamza (bin Abdul Muttalib) maujood the aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, aur humein ijaazat de di gayi.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ الْقَمِيصَ، وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَلاَ الْبُرْنُسَ، وَلاَ الْخُفَّيْنِ، إِلاَّ أَنْ لاَ يَجِدَ النَّعْلَيْنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسْ مَا هُوَ أَسْفَلُ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man asked, "O Allah's Apostle What kind of clothes should a Muhrim wear?" The Prophet, said, "A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, trousers a hooded cloak, or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) unless he cannot get sandals, in which case he should cut the part (of the Khuff) that covers the ankles
77.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Muhrim (Ihram waale) ko kaise kapde pehnne chaahiye?' Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Muhrim ko qamees, pajaama, hood waala chogha, ya Khuff (mote kapde ya chamde ke mozon) nahi pehnne chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke use jootiyaan na milein, aisi soorat mein use Khuff ka wo hissa kaat dena chaahiye jo takhne dhaankta hai.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ بَعْدَ مَا أُدْخِلَ قَبْرَهُ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَأُخْرِجَ، وَوُضِعَ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، وَنَفَثَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ رِيقِهِ، وَأَلْبَسَهُ قَمِيصَهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to visit `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) after he had been put in his grave. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that `Abdullah be taken out. He was taken out and was placed on the knees of the Prophet, who blew his (blessed) breath on him and dressed the body with his own shirt. And Allah knows better
77.hi: Jabir (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) ko dekhne aaye unki qabr mein rakhe jaane ke baad. Nabi (SAW) ne hukm diya ke Abdullah ko nikaala jaaye. Unhein nikaala gaya aur Nabi (SAW) ke ghutnon par rakha gaya, unhone apni (mubarak) saans unpar phoonki aur jism ko apni khud ki qamees pehnaayi. Aur Allah behtar jaanta hai.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِنِي قَمِيصَكَ أُكَفِّنْهُ فِيهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُ، فَأَعْطَاهُ قَمِيصَهُ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَآذِنَّا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ آذَنَهُ، فَجَاءَ لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَجَذَبَهُ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ نَهَاكَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ فَقَالَ ‏{‏اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ‏}‏‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا‏}‏ فَتَرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:When `Abdullah bin Ubdi (bin Salul) died, his son came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said ' O Allah's Apostle, give me your shirt so that I may shroud my fathers body in it. And please offer a funeral prayer for him and invoke Allah for his forgiveness." The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him his shirt and said to him 'Inform us when you finish (and the funeral procession is ready) call us. When he had finished he told the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded to order his funeral prayers but `Umar stopped him and said, "Didn't Allah forbid you to offer the funeral prayer for the hypocrites when He said: "Whether you (O Muhammad) ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them: (and even) if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times. Allah will not forgive them." (9.80) Then there was revealed: "And never (O Muhammad) pray for any of them that dies, nor stand at his grave." (9.34) Thenceforth the Prophet (ﷺ) did not offer funeral prayers for the hypocrites
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Salul) ka intekaal hua, unke bete Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mujhe apni qamees dijiye taake main apne waalid ke jism ko usmein kafan de sakoon. Aur barah-e-meharbaani unki namaz-e-janaza padhaiye aur unki maafi ke liye dua kijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne unhein apni qamees di aur unse kaha, 'Jab (janaaza ka jaloos taiyaar ho jaaye) tumhaara kaam khatam ho jaaye, humein bataana.' Jab unka kaam khatam hua, unhone Nabi (SAW) ko bataaya aur Nabi (SAW) unki namaz-e-janaza padhaane ke liye aage badhe, magar Umar ne unhein roka aur kaha, 'Kya Allah ne aapko munaafiqon ki namaz-e-janaza padhaane se mana nahi kiya jab usne farmaaya, "Chaahe aap (Aye Muhammad) unke liye maafi maango ya na maango; (aur agar) aap unke liye sattar baar bhi maafi maangein, Allah unhein kabhi maaf nahi karega"' (9.80). Phir naazil hua: 'Aur (Aye Muhammad) kabhi unmein se kisi ke liye jo mar jaaye namaz mat padho, na uski qabr par khade ho.' (9.34) Iske baad Nabi (SAW) ne munaafiqon ki namaz-e-janaza padhaana chhod diya.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَثَلَ الْبَخِيلِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِ، كَمَثَلِ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا جُبَّتَانِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، قَدِ اضْطُرَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمَا إِلَى ثُدِيِّهِمَا وَتَرَاقِيهِمَا، فَجَعَلَ الْمُتَصَدِّقُ كُلَّمَا تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ انْبَسَطَتْ عَنْهُ حَتَّى تَغْشَى أَنَامِلَهُ وَتَعْفُوَ أَثَرَهُ، وَجَعَلَ الْبَخِيلُ كُلَّمَا هَمَّ بِصَدَقَةٍ قَلَصَتْ، وَأَخَذَتْ كُلُّ حَلْقَةٍ بِمَكَانِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ بِإِصْبَعِهِ هَكَذَا فِي جَيْبِهِ، فَلَوْ رَأَيْتَهُ يُوَسِّعُهَا وَلاَ تَتَوَسَّعُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَأَبُو الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ فِي الْجُبَّتَيْنِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَنْظَلَةُ سَمِعْتُ طَاوُسًا سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ جُبَّتَانِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ جَعْفَرٌ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ جُبَّتَانِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has set forth an example for a miser and a charitable person by comparing them to two men wearing two iron cloaks and their hands are raised to their breasts and necks. Whenever the charitable man tries to give a charitable gift, his iron cloak expands till it becomes so wide that it will cover his fingertips and obliterate his tracks And, whenever the miser wants to give a charitable gift, his cloak becomes very tight over him and every ring gets stuck to its place Abu Huraira added; I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) putting his finger in the (chest) pocket of his shirt like that If you but saw him trying to widen (the opening of his shirt) but it did not widen
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kanjoos aur sakhi shaks ki misaal do aise logon se di hai jo loha ke do chogha pehne hue hon aur unke haath unki chhaati aur gardan tak uthe hue hon. Jab bhi sakhi shaks sadqa dena chahta hai, uska loha ka chogha itna phail jaata hai ke wo uski ungliyon ke sirre tak dhaank leta hai aur uske pairon ke nishaan mita deta hai. Aur jab bhi kanjoos sadqa dena chahta hai, uska chogha uspar bahut kas jaata hai aur har halqa apni jagah chipak jaata hai. Abu Huraira ne aage kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko apni ungli apni qamees ki (chhaati ki) jeb mein daalte dekha, isi tarah. Agar tum dekhte ke wo (jeb) phailaane ki koshish kar rahe the magar wo nahi phaili.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الضُّحَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَسْرُوقٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ انْطَلَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِحَاجَتِهِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ، فَتَلَقَّيْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ وَعَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ شَأْمِيَّةٌ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ، فَذَهَبَ يُخْرِجُ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ كُمَّيْهِ فَكَانَا ضَيِّقَيْنِ، فَأَخْرَجَ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ تَحْتِ الْجُبَّةِ، فَغَسَلَهُمَا وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ وَعَلَى خُفَّيْهِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:The Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, and when he returned, I met him with water and he performed the ablution while he was wearing a Sham, cloak. He rinsed his mouth, put the water in his nose and blew it out, washed his face and tried to take his hands out of his sleeves, but they were too narrow, so he took out his hands from under his chest and washed them and then passed his wet hands over his head and Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
77.hi: Al-Mughira bin Shu'ba (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) qaza-e-haajat ke liye gaye, aur jab wo wapas aaye, main unse paani lekar mila aur unhone wuzu kiya jabke wo Sham ka chogha pehne hue the. Unhone kulla kiya, naak mein paani daala aur nikaala, apna chehra dhoya, aur apne haath aastin se nikaalne ki koshish ki, magar wo bahut tang thin, isliye unhone apne haath apni chhaati ke neeche se nikaale aur unhein dhoya, phir apne geele haath apne sar aur Khuff (mote kapde ya chamde ke mozon) par phere.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فِي سَفَرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَعَكَ مَاءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ، فَمَشَى حَتَّى تَوَارَى عَنِّي فِي سَوَادِ اللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَأَفْرَغْتُ عَلَيْهِ الإِدَاوَةَ، فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، وَعَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ مِنْ صُوفٍ، فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ مِنْهَا حَتَّى أَخْرَجَهُمَا مِنْ أَسْفَلِ الْجُبَّةِ، فَغَسَلَ ذِرَاعَيْهِ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ أَهْوَيْتُ لأَنْزِعَ خُفَّيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُمَا، فَإِنِّي أَدْخَلْتُهُمَا طَاهِرَتَيْنِ، فَمَسَحَ عَلَيْهِمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Al-Mughira:One night I was with the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey. He asked (me), "Have you got water with you?" I replied, "Yes" So he got down from his she-camel and went away till he disappeared in the darkness of the night. Then he came back and I poured water for him from the pot (for the ablution). He washed his face and hands while he was wearing a woollen cloak (the sleeves of which were narrow), so he could not take his arms out of it. So he took them out from underneath the cloak. Then he washed his forearms and passed his wet hands over his head. Then I tried to take off his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather), but he said, "Leave them, for I have performed ablution before putting them on." And so he passed his wet hands over them
77.hi: Al-Mughira bataate hain: Ek raat main Nabi (SAW) ke saath safar mein tha. Unhone (mujhse) pucha, 'Kya tumhaare paas paani hai?' Maine kaha, 'Haan.' To wo apni oontni se utre aur chal diye yahaan tak ke wo raat ke andhere mein ghayab ho gaye. Phir wo wapas aaye aur maine unke liye bartan se paani daala (wuzu ke liye). Unhone apna chehra aur haath dhoye jabke wo ek oon ka chogha pehne hue the (jiski aastin tang thi), isliye wo apni baahein usmein se nahi nikaal sake. To unhone unhein chogha ke neeche se nikaala. Phir unhone apni kalaaiyan dhoyi aur apne geele haath apne sar par phere. Phir maine unke Khuff utaarne ki koshish ki, magar unhone kaha, 'Inhein rehne do, kyunke maine inhein pehanne se pehle hi wuzu kiya tha.' Aur unhone apne geele haath unpar phere.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْبِيَةً، وَلَمْ يُعْطِ مَخْرَمَةَ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ مَخْرَمَةُ يَا بُنَىَّ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ ادْخُلْ فَادْعُهُ لِي‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَعَوْتُهُ لَهُ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِ قَبَاءٌ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خَبَأْتُ هَذَا لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَضِيَ مَخْرَمَةُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed some Qaba's but he did not give anything to Makhrama. Makhrama said (to me), "O my son! Let us go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So I proceeded with him and he said, "Go in and call him 'or me." So I called the Prophet (ﷺ) for him The Prophet (ﷺ) came out to him, wearing one of those Qaba's and said, (to Makhrama), "I have kept this for you " Makhrama looked at it and said, "Makhrama is satisfied now
77.hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhrama (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kuch Qaba (chogha) baante, magar Makhrama ko kuch nahi diya. Makhrama ne kaha, 'Aye mere bete! Chalo Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas chalte hain.' To main unke saath gaya aur unhone kaha, 'Andar jaao aur unhein bulaao (mere liye).' To maine Nabi (SAW) ko unke liye bulaaya. Nabi (SAW) unke paas baahar aaye, un Qabaon mein se ek pehne hue, aur kaha (Makhrama se), 'Maine ye tumhaare liye rakh liya hai.' Makhrama ne use dekha aur kaha, 'Makhrama ab santusht hai.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُّوجُ حَرِيرٍ، فَلَبِسَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى فِيهِ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَنَزَعَهُ نَزْعًا شَدِيدًا كَالْكَارِهِ لَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْبَغِي هَذَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ فَرُّوجٌ حَرِيرٌ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:A silken Farruj was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he put it on and offered the prayer in it. When he finished the prayer, he took it off violently as if he disliked it and said, "This (garment) does not befit those who fear Allah
77.hi: Uqba bin Aamir bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko resham ka ek Farruj (khula-samne wala chogha) pesh kiya gaya aur unhone use pehna aur usmein namaz padhi. Jab unhone namaz khatam ki, unhone use zor se utaara jaise unhein wo napasand ho, aur kaha, 'Ye (kapda) un logon ke liye theek nahi jo Allah se darte hain.'

77.ar: وَقَالَ لِي مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، رَأَيْتُ عَلَى أَنَسٍ بُرْنُسًا أَصْفَرَ مِنْ خَزٍّ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Mu'tamir:I heard my father saying, "I saw Anas wearing a yellow hooded cloak of Khazz
77.hi: Mu'tamir bataate hain: Maine apne waalid ko ye kehte suna, 'Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko Khazz ka ek peela hood-waala chogha pehne dekha.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْقُمُصَ، وَلاَ الْعَمَائِمَ، وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلاَتِ، وَلاَ الْبَرَانِسَ، وَلاَ الْخِفَافَ، إِلاَّ أَحَدٌ لاَ يَجِدُ النَّعْلَيْنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ، وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تَلْبَسُوا مِنَ الثِّيَابِ شَيْئًا مَسَّهُ زَعْفَرَانٌ وَلاَ الْوَرْسُ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). What type of clothes should a Muhrim wear Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'Do not wear shirts, turbans trousers hooded cloaks or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather); but if someone cannot get sandals, then he can wear Khuffs after cutting them short below the ankles. Do not wear clothes touched by saffon or wars (two kinds of perfumes)
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks ne pucha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Muhrim ko kaise kapde pehnne chaahiye?' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Qamees, pagdi, pajaama, hood-waale chogha, ya Khuff mat pehno; magar agar kisi ko jootiyaan na mile, to wo takhnon se neeche kaat kar Khuff pehan sakta hai. Zafraan ya Wars (do khushbuon) se chhue kapde bhi mat pehno.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ إِزَارًا فَلْيَلْبَسْ سَرَاوِيلَ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever cannot get an Izar, can wear trousers, and whoever cannot wear sandals can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
77.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jise Izaar na mile, wo pajaama pehan sakta hai, aur jise jootiyaan na milein, wo Khuff pehan sakta hai.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا تَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَلْبَسَ إِذَا أَحْرَمْنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْقَمِيصَ، وَالسَّرَاوِيلَ، وَالْعَمَائِمَ وَالْبَرَانِسَ، وَالْخِفَافَ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ لَهُ نَعْلاَنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تَلْبَسُوا شَيْئًا مِنَ الثِّيَابِ مَسَّهُ زَعْفَرَانٌ وَلاَ وَرْسٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah:A man got up and said, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order us to wear when we assume the state of Ihram?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do not wear shirts, trousers, turbans, hooded cloaks or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather), but if a man has no sandals, he can wear Khuffs after cutting them short below the ankles; and do not wear clothes touched with (perfumes) of saffron or wars
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap humein Ihram baandhte waqt kya pehnne ka hukm dete hain?' Nabi (SAW) ne jawab diya, 'Qamees, pajaama, pagdi, hood-waale chogha, ya Khuff mat pehno, magar agar kisi ke paas jootiyaan na hon, to wo takhnon se neeche kaat kar Khuff pehan sakta hai; aur Zafraan ya Wars se chhue kapde mat pehno.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ الْقَمِيصَ، وَلاَ الْعِمَامَةَ، وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَلاَ الْبُرْنُسَ، وَلاَ ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ زَعْفَرَانٌ، وَلاَ وَرْسٌ، وَلاَ الْخُفَّيْنِ، إِلاَّ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ النَّعْلَيْنِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْهُمَا فَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muhrim should not wear a shirt, a turban, trousers, hooded cloaks, a garment touched with (perfumes) of saffron or wars, or Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) except if one has no sandals in which case he should cut short the Khuffs below the ankles
77.hi: Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Muhrim ko qamees, pagdi, pajaama, hood-waale chogha, Zafraan ya Wars se chhue kapde, ya Khuff nahi pehnne chaahiye, siwaaye is ke ke kisi ke paas jootiyaan na hon, aisi soorat mein use takhnon se neeche Khuff kaat lena chaahiye.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ هَاجَرَ إِلَى الْحَبَشَةِ نَاسٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَتَجَهَّزَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُهَاجِرًا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ، فَإِنِّي أَرْجُو أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَوَ تَرْجُوهُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَحَبَسَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ نَفْسَهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِصُحْبَتِهِ، وَعَلَفَ رَاحِلَتَيْنِ كَانَتَا عِنْدَهُ وَرَقَ السَّمُرِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ يَوْمًا جُلُوسٌ فِي بَيْتِنَا فِي نَحْرِ الظَّهِيرَةِ فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُقْبِلاً مُتَقَنِّعًا، فِي سَاعَةٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَأْتِينَا فِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِدًا لَهُ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي، وَاللَّهِ إِنْ جَاءَ بِهِ فِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ إِلاَّ لأَمْرٍ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُ فَدَخَلَ، فَقَالَ حِينَ دَخَلَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ أَخْرِجْ مَنْ عِنْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّمَا هُمْ أَهْلُكَ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي قَدْ أُذِنَ لِي فِي الْخُرُوجِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَالصُّحْبَةُ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَخُذْ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِحْدَى رَاحِلَتَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بِالثَّمَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَجَهَّزْنَاهُمَا أَحَثَّ الْجِهَازِ، وَضَعْنَا لَهُمَا سُفْرَةً فِي جِرَابٍ، فَقَطَعَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قِطْعَةً مِنْ نِطَاقِهَا، فَأَوْكَتْ بِهِ الْجِرَابَ، وَلِذَلِكَ كَانَتْ تُسَمَّى ذَاتَ النِّطَاقِ، ثُمَّ لَحِقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ بِغَارٍ فِي جَبَلٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثَوْرٌ، فَمَكُثَ فِيهِ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ يَبِيتُ عِنْدَهُمَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَهْوَ غُلاَمٌ شَابٌّ لَقِنٌ ثَقِفٌ، فَيَرْحَلُ مِنْ عِنْدِهِمَا سَحَرًا، فَيُصْبِحُ مَعَ قُرَيْشٍ بِمَكَّةَ كَبَائِتٍ، فَلاَ يَسْمَعُ أَمْرًا يُكَادَانِ بِهِ إِلاَّ وَعَاهُ، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُمَا بِخَبَرِ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يَخْتَلِطُ الظَّلاَمُ، وَيَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمَا عَامِرُ بْنُ فُهَيْرَةَ مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ مِنْحَةً مِنْ غَنَمٍ، فَيُرِيحُهَا عَلَيْهِمَا حِينَ تَذْهَبُ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ الْعِشَاءِ، فَيَبِيتَانِ فِي رِسْلِهَا حَتَّى يَنْعِقَ بِهَا عَامِرُ بْنُ فُهَيْرَةَ بِغَلَسٍ، يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ تِلْكَ اللَّيَالِي الثَّلاَثِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Aisha:Some Muslim men emigrated to Ethiopia whereupon Abu Bakr also prepared himself for the emigration, but the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Wait, for I hope that Allah will allow me also to emigrate." Abu Bakr said, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you. Do you hope that (emigration)?" The Prophet said, 'Yes." So Abu Bakr waited to accompany the Prophet (ﷺ) and fed two she-camels he had on the leaves of As-Samur tree regularly for four months One day while we were sitting in our house at midday, someone said to Abu Bakr, "Here is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), coming with his head and a part of his face covered with a cloth-covering at an hour he never used to come to us." Abu Bakr said, "Let my father and mother be sacrificed for you, (O Prophet)! An urgent matter must have brought you here at this hour." The Prophet (ﷺ) came and asked the permission to enter, and he was allowed. The Prophet (ﷺ) entered and said to Abu Bakr, "Let those who are with you, go out." Abu Bakr replied, "(There is no stranger); they are your family. Let my father be sacrificed for you, O Allah's Apostle!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been allowed to leave (Mecca)." Abu Bakr said, " I shall accompany you, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Let my father be sacrificed for you!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes," Abu Bakr said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Let my father be sacrificed for you. Take one of these two shecamels of mine" The Prophet (ﷺ) said. I will take it only after paying its price." So we prepared their baggage and put their journey food In a leather bag. And Asma' bint Abu Bakr cut a piece of her girdle and tied the mouth of the leather bag with it. That is why she was called Dhatan- Nitaqaln. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr went to a cave in a mountain called Thour and remained there for three nights. `Abdullah bin Abu Bakr. who was a young intelligent man. used to stay with them at night and leave before dawn so that in the morning, he would he with the Quraish at Mecca as if he had spent the night among them. If he heard of any plot contrived by the Quraish against the Prophet and Abu Bakr, he would understand it and (return to) inform them of it when it became dark. 'Amir bin Fuhaira, the freed slave of Abu Bakr used to graze a flock of milch sheep for them and he used to take those sheep to them when an hour had passed after the `Isha prayer. They would sleep soundly till 'Amir bin Fuhaira awakened them when it was still dark. He used to do that in each of those three nights
77.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch Musalmaan Habsha (Ethiopia) hijrat kar gaye, isper Abu Bakr ne bhi hijrat ki taiyaari ki, magar Nabi (SAW) ne (unse) kaha, 'Ruko, kyunke mujhe ummeed hai ke Allah mujhe bhi hijrat karne dega.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon. Kya aapko iski (hijrat ki) ummeed hai?' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' To Abu Bakr Nabi (SAW) ke saath jaane ke intezaar mein ruk gaye aur apni do oontniyon ko chaar mahine tak As-Samur darakht ke patton par palte rahe. Ek din jab hum apne ghar mein dophar ko baithe the, kisi ne Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Ye Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hain, apna sar aur chehre ka kuch hissa kapde se dhaanke hue aa rahe hain, us waqt jab wo kabhi humaare paas nahi aate the.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, (Aye Nabi)! Zaroor koi zaroori maamla aapko is waqt yahaan laaya hai.' Nabi (SAW) aaye aur andar aane ki ijaazat maangi, aur unhein ijaazat di gayi. Nabi (SAW) andar aaye aur Abu Bakr se kaha, 'Jo tumhaare saath hain unhein baahar bhejo.' Abu Bakr ne jawab diya, '(Koi ajnabi nahi hai); ye aapka hi khaandaan hai. Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon, Aye Allah ke Rasool!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Mujhe (Makkah se) nikalne ki ijaazat mil gayi hai.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Main aapke saath chalunga, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon!' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Haan.' Abu Bakr ne kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere waalid aap par qurbaan hon. In do oontniyon mein se ek le lijiye.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main ise sirf qeemat adaa karke lunga.' To humne unka saamaan taiyaar kiya aur unke safar ka khaana ek chamde ke thaile mein rakha. Aur Asma (رضی اللہ عنہا) bint Abu Bakr (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne apni kamarbandh ka ek tukda kaata aur usse thaile ka munh baandha. Isi wajah se unhein 'Dhatan-Nitaqain' (do kamarbandon wali) kaha jaane laga. Phir Nabi (SAW) aur Abu Bakr Thour naami pahaad ki ek gufaa mein gaye aur teen raatein wahaan rahe. Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abu Bakr, jo ek jawaan aur aqlmand shaks the, raat ko unke saath rehte aur subah hone se pehle chale jaate taake subah wo Makkah mein Quraish ke saath aise ho jaise unhone unke beech hi raat guzaari ho. Agar unhein Quraish ki Nabi aur Abu Bakr ke khilaaf kisi saazish ka pata chalta, to wo use samajhkar andhera hote hi unhein bataane (wapas) jaate. Aamir bin Fuhaira, Abu Bakr ke azaad kiye ghulaam, unke liye doodh dene wali bakriyon ka jhund charaate the aur wo unhein Isha ki namaz ke ek ghante baad unke paas le jaate. Wo gehri neend sote yahaan tak ke Aamir bin Fuhaira unhein andhera rehte hi jagaate. Wo aisa un teenon raaton mein har baar karte.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ الْمِغْفَرُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet (ﷺ) entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head
77.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Fatah-e-Makkah ke saal, Nabi (SAW) Makkah mein daakhil hue, apne sar par khod (helmet) pehne hue.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَيْهِ بُرْدٌ نَجْرَانِيٌّ غَلِيظُ الْحَاشِيَةِ، فَأَدْرَكَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَجَبَذَهُ بِرِدَائِهِ جَبْذَةً شَدِيدَةً، حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى صَفْحَةِ عَاتِقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَثَّرَتْ بِهَا حَاشِيَةُ الْبُرْدِ مِنْ شِدَّةِ جَبْذَتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ مُرْ لِي مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي عِنْدَكَ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ ضَحِكَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ لَهُ بِعَطَاءٍ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once I was walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he was wearing a Najram Burd with thick margin. A bedouin followed him and pulled his Burd so violently that I noticed the side of the shoulder of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) affected by the margin of the Burd because of that violent pull. The Bedouin said, "O Muhammad! Give me some of Allah's wealth which is with you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned and looked at him, and smiling, 'he ordered that he be given something
77.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Ek baar main Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke saath chal raha tha aur wo ek mote kinaare wale Najrani Burd (chaadar) pehne hue the. Ek badawi unke peechhe aaya aur unka Burd itni zor se khaincha ke maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke kandhe ka wo hissa dekha jahaan Burd ke kinaare ka nishaan pad gaya tha is zordaar khainchne ki wajah se. Badawi ne kaha, 'Aye Muhammad! Mujhe Allah ke maal mein se kuch do jo tumhaare paas hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) mude aur usse dekha, aur muskuraate hue unhone hukm diya ke use kuch diya jaaye.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ بِبُرْدَةٍ ـ قَالَ سَهْلٌ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا الْبُرْدَةُ قَالَ نَعَمْ هِيَ الشَّمْلَةُ، مَنْسُوجٌ فِي حَاشِيَتِهَا ـ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَسَجْتُ هَذِهِ بِيَدِي أَكْسُوكَهَا‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْتَاجًا إِلَيْهَا، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا وَإِنَّهَا لإِزَارُهُ، فَجَسَّهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اكْسُنِيهَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ، فَطَوَاهَا ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ بِهَا إِلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْقَوْمُ مَا أَحْسَنْتَ، سَأَلْتَهَا إِيَّاهُ وَقَدْ عَرَفْتَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَرُدُّ سَائِلاً‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ وَاللَّهِ مَا سَأَلْتُهَا إِلاَّ لِتَكُونَ كَفَنِي يَوْمَ أَمُوتُ‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَكَانَتْ كَفَنَهُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Hazim:Shahl bin Sa`d said, "A lady came with a Burda. Sahl then asked (the people), "Do you know what Burda is?" Somebody said, "Yes. it is a Shamla with a woven border." Sahl added, "The lady said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have knitted this (Burda) with my own hands for you to wear it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took it and he was in need of it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out to us and he was wearing it as an Izar. A man from the people felt it and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Give it to me to wear.' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Yes.' Then he sat there for some time (and when he went to his house), he folded it and sent it to him. The people said to that man, 'You have not done a right thing. You asked him for it, though you know that he does not put down anybody's request.' The man said, 'By Allah! I have only asked him so that it may be my shroud when I die." Sahl added, "Late it was his shroud
77.hi: Abu Hazim bataate hain: Sahl bin Sa'd (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne kaha, 'Ek khaatoon ek Burda (bunayi hui chaadar) leke aayi.' Sahl ne (logon se) pucha, 'Kya tumhein pata hai Burda kya hoti hai?' Kisi ne kaha, 'Haan, ye bunayi hui kinaare wali Shamla hai.' Sahl ne aage kaha, 'Khaatoon ne kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Maine ye (Burda) apne haathon se buni hai taake aap ise pehnein." Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne use liya aur unhein iski zaroorat thi. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) hamare paas baahar aaye aur wo ise Izaar ke taur par pehne hue the. Logon mein se ek shaks ne ise chhua aur kaha, "Aye Allah ke Rasool! Ise mujhe pehnne ke liye de dijiye." Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, "Theek hai." Phir wo kuch der wahaan baithe (aur jab wo apne ghar gaye), unhone ise mod kar us shaks ko bhej diya. Logon ne us shaks se kaha, "Tumne theek nahi kiya. Tumne unse ye maangi, jabke tumhein pata hai wo kisi ki darkhwaast wapas nahi karte." Us shaks ne kaha, "Allah ki qasam! Maine sirf isliye maangi taake ye meri maut ke waqt mera kafan bane." Sahl ne aage kaha, "Baad mein wahi uska kafan bana."'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي زُمْرَةٌ هِيَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا، تُضِيءُ وُجُوهُهُمْ إِضَاءَةَ الْقَمَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ عُكَاشَةُ بْنُ مِحْصَنٍ الأَسَدِيُّ يَرْفَعُ نَمِرَةً عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ سَبَقَكَ عُكَاشَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying "From among my followers, a group (o 70,000) will enter Paradise without being asked for their accounts, Their faces will be shining like the moon." 'Ukasha bin Muhsin Al-Asadi got up, lifting his covering sheet and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Invoke Allah for me that He may include me with them." The Prophet (ﷺ) said! "O Allah! Make him from them." Then another man from Al-Ansar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Invoke Allah for me that He may include me with them." On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "'Ukasha has anticipated you
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ko ye farmaate suna, 'Mere maanne walon mein se ek giroh (sattar hazaar) bina hisaab-kitaab ke Jannat mein daakhil hoga. Unke chehre chaand jaise chamakenge.' Ukasha bin Muhsin Al-Asadi apni chaadar utha kar khade hue aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe unmein shaamil kare.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Aye Allah! Ise unmein se bana de.' Phir Ansaar ka ek aur shaks khada hua aur kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Mere liye dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe unmein shaamil kare.' Isper Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ukasha tumse pehle keh chuke.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَىُّ الثِّيَابِ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ الْحِبَرَةُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Qatada:I asked Anas, "What kind of clothes was most beloved to the Prophet?" He replied, "The Hibra (a kind of Yemenese cloth)
77.hi: Qatada bataate hain: Maine Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) se pucha, 'Nabi (SAW) ko kis qism ke kapde sabse zyaada pasand the?' Unhone jawab diya, 'Hibra (Yemen ka ek qism ka kapda).'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ أَحَبُّ الثِّيَابِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَلْبَسَهَا الْحِبَرَةَ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The most beloved garment to the Prophet (ﷺ) to wear was the Hibra (a kind of Yemenese cloth)
77.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ko pehnne ke liye sabse zyaada aziz kapda Hibra (Yemen ka ek qism ka kapda) tha.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ سُجِّيَ بِبُرْدٍ حِبَرَةٍ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, he was covered with a Hibra Burd (green square decorated garment)
77.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) (Nabi ki zawja) bataati hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ka intekaal hua, unhein Hibra Burd (hari, chaukor, sajaayi hui chaadar) se dhaanka gaya.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهم قَالاَ لَمَّا نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَفِقَ يَطْرَحُ خَمِيصَةً لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، فَإِذَا اغْتَمَّ كَشَفَهَا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ وَهْوَ كَذَلِكَ ‏ "‏ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُحَذِّرُ مَا صَنَعُوا‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas:When the disease of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got aggravated, he covered his face with a Khamisa, but when he became short of breath, he would remove it from his face and say, "It is like that! May Allah curse the Jews Christians because they took the graves of their prophets as places of worship." By that he warned his follower of imitating them, by doing that which they did
77.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) aur Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ki bimaari aur badh gayi, unhone apna chehra Khamisa (chaadar) se dhaank liya, magar jab unki saans phoolne lagi, wo use apne chehre se hata dete aur kehte, 'Aisa hi hai! Allah Yahudiyon aur Isaaiyon par laanat kare kyunke unhone apne Nabiyon ki qabron ko ibaadat ki jagah bana liya.' Isse unhone apne maanne walon ko unki tarah aisa karne ki nakal karne se khabardaar kiya.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَمِيصَةٍ لَهُ لَهَا أَعْلاَمٌ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَى أَعْلاَمِهَا نَظْرَةً، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اذْهَبُوا بِخَمِيصَتِي هَذِهِ إِلَى أَبِي جَهْمٍ، فَإِنَّهَا أَلْهَتْنِي آنِفًا عَنْ صَلاَتِي، وَائْتُونِي بِأَنْبِجَانِيَّةِ أَبِي جَهْمِ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ غَانِمٍ مِنْ بَنِي عَدِيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered prayer while he was wearing a Khamisa of his that had printed marks. He looked at its marks and when he finished prayer, he said, "Take this Khamisa of mine to Abu Jahm, for it has just now diverted my attention from my prayer, and bring to me the Anbijania (a plain thick sheet) of Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifa bin Ghanim who belonged to Bani Adi bin Ka`b
77.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne namaz padhi jabke wo apna chhape hue nishaan waala Khamisa pehne hue the. Unhone uske nishaanon ki taraf dekha, aur jab namaz khatam ki, unhone kaha, 'Mera ye Khamisa Abu Jahm ke paas le jaao, kyunke isne abhi mera dhyaan meri namaz se hataaya. Aur mere liye Abu Jahm bin Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Ghanim, jo Banu Adi bin Ka'b se the, ki Anbijania (ek saadi moti chaadar) le aao.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ أَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا عَائِشَةُ كِسَاءً وَإِزَارًا غَلِيظًا فَقَالَتْ قُبِضَ رُوحُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَيْنِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Burda:Aisha brought out to us a Kisa and an Izar and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) died while wearing these two." (Kisa, a square black piece of woolen cloth. Izar, a sheet cloth garment covering the lower half of the body)
77.hi: Abu Burda bataate hain: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne hamare saamne ek Kisa (ooni chaukor kaali chaadar) aur ek Izaar nikaala aur kaha, 'Nabi (SAW) ka intekaal in dono ko pehne hue hua.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبٍ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ، وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ، وَعَنْ صَلاَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ، وَأَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ بِالثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَأَنْ يَشْتَمِلَ الصَّمَّاءَ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden: (A) the Mulamasa and Munabadha (bargains), (B) the offering of two prayers, one after the morning compulsory prayer till the sun rises, and the others, after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets (C) He also forbade that one should sit wearing one garment, nothing of which covers his private parts (D) and prevent them from exposure to the sky; (E) he also forbade Ishtimalas- Samma
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne mana kiya tha: (A) Mulamasa aur Munabadha (khareed-farokht ke tareeke), (B) fajr ki farz namaz ke baad suraj nikalne tak, aur Asr ki namaz ke baad suraj doobne tak namaz padhne se, (C) unhone ye bhi mana kiya ke koi aisa ek kapda pehnkar baithe jo uski sharmgaah ko na dhaanke, (D) aur unhein aasman ki taraf khulne se roka; (E) unhone Ishtimal-as-Samma se bhi mana kiya.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ وَعَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ، نَهَى عَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ فِي الْبَيْعِ، وَالْمُلاَمَسَةُ لَمْسُ الرَّجُلِ ثَوْبَ الآخَرِ بِيَدِهِ بِاللَّيْلِ أَوْ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَلاَ يُقَلِّبُهُ إِلاَّ بِذَلِكَ، وَالْمُنَابَذَةُ أَنْ يَنْبِذَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ بِثَوْبِهِ، وَيَنْبِذَ الآخَرُ ثَوْبَهُ، وَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ بَيْعَهُمَا، عَنْ غَيْرِ نَظَرٍ وَلاَ تَرَاضٍ، وَاللِّبْسَتَيْنِ اشْتِمَالُ الصَّمَّاءِ، وَالصَّمَّاءُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى أَحَدِ عَاتِقَيْهِ، فَيَبْدُو أَحَدُ شِقَّيْهِ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ، وَاللِّبْسَةُ الأُخْرَى احْتِبَاؤُهُ بِثَوْبِهِ وَهْوَ جَالِسٌ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two ways of wearing clothes and two kinds of dealings. (A) He forbade the dealings of the Mulamasa and the Munabadha. In the Mulamasa transaction the buyer just touches the garment he wants to buy at night or by daytime, and that touch would oblige him to buy it. In the Munabadha, one man throws his garment at another and the latter throws his at the former and the barter is complete and valid without examining the two objects or being satisfied with them (B) The two ways of wearing clothes were Ishtimal-as-Samma, i e., to cover one's shoulder with one's garment and leave the other bare: and the other way was to wrap oneself with a garment while one was sitting in such a way that nothing of that garment would cover one's private part
77.hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne kapde pehnne ke do tareeke aur do qism ki khareed-farokht se mana kiya. (A) Unhone Mulamasa aur Munabadha ki khareed-farokht se mana kiya. Mulamasa mein khareedaar raat ya din mein jis kapde ko khareedna chahta hai use sirf chhuta hai, aur wo chhuna hi use khareedne par majboor kar deta hai. Munabadha mein, ek shaks apna kapda doosre ki taraf phenkta hai aur doosra apna use ki taraf, aur ye badla dono cheezon ko dekhe ya santusht hue bagair mukammal aur maan liya jaata hai. (B) Kapde pehnne ke do tareeke the: Ishtimal-as-Samma, yaani apne ek kandhe ko apne kapde se dhaankna aur doosra khula chhodna; aur doosra tareeka apne aap ko ek kapde se aise lapetna ke baithte waqt kapde ka koi hissa sharmgaah ko na dhaanke.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ أَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ الرَّجُلُ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ، وَأَنْ يَشْتَمِلَ بِالثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ، لَيْسَ عَلَى أَحَدِ شِقَّيْهِ، وَعَنِ الْمُلاَمَسَةِ وَالْمُنَابَذَةِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade two types of dresses: (A) To sit in an Ihtiba' posture in one garment nothing of which covers his private parts. (B) to cover one side of his body with one garment and leave the other side bare The Prophet (ﷺ) also forbade the Mulamasa and Munabadha
77.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne do tarah ke kapde pehnne se mana kiya: (A) Ihtiba (ghutne modkar baithne) ki mudra mein ek aise kapde mein baithna jo sharmgaah ko na dhaanke. (B) apne jism ke ek taraf ko ek kapde se dhaankna aur doosri taraf khula chhodna. Nabi (SAW) ne Mulamasa aur Munabadha se bhi mana kiya.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْلَدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ اشْتِمَالِ الصَّمَّاءِ، وَأَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ الرَّجُلُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، لَيْسَ عَلَى فَرْجِهِ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade Ishtimal-as-Samma' and that a man should sit in an Ihtiba' posture in one garment, nothing of which covers his private parts
77.hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne Ishtimal-as-Samma se aur is baat se mana kiya ke koi shaks Ihtiba ki mudra mein ek aise kapde mein baithe jo sharmgaah ko na dhaanke.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعِيدِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ ـ هُوَ عَمْرُو بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ ـ عَنْ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدٍ، أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثِيَابٍ فِيهَا خَمِيصَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ صَغِيرَةٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ تَرَوْنَ نَكْسُو هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ الْقَوْمُ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْتُونِي بِأُمِّ خَالِدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهَا تُحْمَلُ فَأَخَذَ الْخَمِيصَةَ بِيَدِهِ فَأَلْبَسَهَا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِيهَا عَلَمٌ أَخْضَرُ أَوْ أَصْفَرُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ خَالِدٍ هَذَا سَنَاهْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَسَنَاهْ بِالْحَبَشِيَّةِ حَسَنٌ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Um Khalid bint Khalid:The Prophet (ﷺ) was given some clothes including a black Khamisa. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "To whom shall we give this to wear?" The people kept silent whereupon the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Fetch Um Khalid for me." I (Um Khalid) was brought carried (as I was small girl at that time). The Prophet (ﷺ) took the Khamisa in his hands and made me wear it and said, "May you live so long that your dress will wear out and you will mend it many times." On the Khamisa there were some green or pale designs (The Prophet (ﷺ) saw these designs) and said, "O Um Khalid! This is Sanah." (Sanah in a Ethiopian word meaning beautiful)
77.hi: Umm Khalid bint Khalid bataati hain: Nabi (SAW) ko kuch kapde diye gaye jinmein ek kaala Khamisa bhi tha. Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Ise kise pehnne ke liye dein?' Log khaamosh rahe, isper Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Umm Khalid ko mere paas laao.' Mujhe (Umm Khalid ko) uthaakar laaya gaya (kyunke main us waqt chhoti bachi thi). Nabi (SAW) ne Khamisa apne haathon mein liya aur mujhe pehnaaya aur kaha, 'Itni umar jiyo ke tumhaara ye kapda purana ho jaaye aur tum ise kayi baar theek karwaao.' Khamisa par kuch hare ya halke rang ke design the (Nabi SAW ne wo design dekhe) aur kaha, 'Aye Umm Khalid! Ye Sanah hai.' ('Sanah' ek Habshi lafz hai jiska matlab hai khoobsoorat.)

77.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ قَالَتْ لِي يَا أَنَسُ انْظُرْ هَذَا الْغُلاَمَ فَلاَ يُصِيبَنَّ شَيْئًا حَتَّى تَغْدُوَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ‏.‏ فَغَدَوْتُ بِهِ، فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي حَائِطٍ وَعَلَيْهِ خَمِيصَةٌ حُرَيْثِيَّةٌ، وَهْوَ يَسِمُ الظَّهْرَ الَّذِي قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْفَتْحِ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Anas:When Um Sulaim gave birth to a child. she said to me, "O Anas! Watch this boy carefully and do not give him anything to eat or drink until you have taken him to the Prophet (ﷺ) tomorrow morning for the Tahnik." So the next morning I took the child to the Prophet (ﷺ) who was sitting in a garden and was wearing a Huraithiya Khamisa and was branding the she-camel on which he had come during the Conquest of Mecca
77.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab Umm Sulaim (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne ek bacche ko paidaish diya, unhone mujhse kaha, 'Aye Anas! Is bacche ka khayaal rakho aur use kuch khaane ya peene ko mat do jab tak tum use kal subah Tahnik ke liye Nabi (SAW) ke paas na le jao.' To agli subah main bacche ko Nabi (SAW) ke paas le gaya jo baagh mein baithe hue the, Huraithiya Khamisa pehne hue, aur us oontni par daagh laga rahe the jispar wo Fatah-e-Makkah ke dauraan aaye the.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ، طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ، فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الزَّبِيرِ الْقُرَظِيُّ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَعَلَيْهَا خِمَارٌ أَخْضَرُ‏.‏ فَشَكَتْ إِلَيْهَا، وَأَرَتْهَا خُضْرَةً بِجِلْدِهَا، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنِّسَاءُ يَنْصُرُ بَعْضُهُنَّ بَعْضًا قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا رَأَيْتُ مِثْلَ مَا يَلْقَى الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ، لَجِلْدُهَا أَشَدُّ خُضْرَةً مِنْ ثَوْبِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعَ أَنَّهَا قَدْ أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ وَمَعَهُ ابْنَانِ لَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي إِلَيْهِ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ، إِلاَّ أَنَّ مَا مَعَهُ لَيْسَ بِأَغْنَى عَنِّي مِنْ هَذِهِ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَتْ هُدْبَةً مِنْ ثَوْبِهَا، فَقَالَ كَذَبَتْ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي لأَنْفُضُهَا نَفْضَ الأَدِيمِ، وَلَكِنَّهَا نَاشِزٌ تُرِيدُ رِفَاعَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ لَمْ تَحِلِّي لَهُ ـ أَوْ لَمْ تَصْلُحِي لَهُ ـ حَتَّى يَذُوقَ مِنْ عُسَيْلَتِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَبْصَرَ مَعَهُ ابْنَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَنُوكَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا الَّذِي تَزْعُمِينَ مَا تَزْعُمِينَ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَهُمْ أَشْبَهُ بِهِ مِنَ الْغُرَابِ بِالْغُرَابِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated `Ikrima:Rifa`a divorced his wife whereupon `AbdurRahman bin Az-Zubair Al-Qurazi married her. `Aisha said that the lady (came), wearing a green veil (and complained to her (Aisha) of her husband and showed her a green spot on her skin caused by beating). It was the habit of ladies to support each other, so when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, `Aisha said, "I have not seen any woman suffering as much as the believing women. Look! Her skin is greener than her clothes!" When `AbdurRahman heard that his wife had gone to the Prophet, he came with his two sons from another wife. She said, "By Allah! I have done no wrong to him but he is impotent and is as useless to me as this," holding and showing the fringe of her garment, `Abdur-Rahman said, "By Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She has told a lie! I am very strong and can satisfy her but she is disobedient and wants to go back to Rifa`a." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, to her, "If that is your intention, then know that it is unlawful for you to remarry Rifa`a unless `Abdur-Rahman has had sexual intercourse with you." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) saw two boys with `Abdur- Rahman and asked (him), "Are these your sons?" On that `AbdurRahman said, "Yes." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You claim what you claim (i.e.. that he is impotent)? But by Allah, these boys resemble him as a crow resembles a crow
77.hi: Ikrima bataate hain: Rifa'a ne apni biwi ko talaaq de di, isper Abdur Rahman bin Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Qurazi ne unse nikaah kiya. Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) ne bataaya ke wo khaatoon (aayi), hara dupatta pehne hue (aur Aisha se apne shohar ki shikaayat ki aur unhein maar ki wajah se apni khaal par ek hara nishaan dikhaya). Auraton ki aadat thi ki wo ek doosre ki madad karti thin, to jab Allah ke Rasool (SAW) aaye, Aisha ne kaha, 'Maine kabhi kisi aurat ko Momin auraton jitna dukhi nahi dekha. Dekhiye! Uski khaal uske kapdon se bhi zyaada hari hai!' Jab Abdur Rahman ne suna ke uski biwi Nabi (SAW) ke paas gayi hai, wo apni doosri biwi se hue apne do beton ke saath aaye. Usne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam! Maine unke saath koi galat nahi kiya, magar wo napunsak hain aur mere kaam ke nahi, is (dupatte ke kinaare) jaise,' apne kapde ka kinaara pakadkar dikhaate hue. Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Allah ki qasam, Aye Allah ke Rasool! Usne jhoot bola hai! Main bahut taaqatwar hoon aur use santusht kar sakta hoon, magar wo naafarmaan hai aur Rifa'a ke paas wapas jaana chahti hai.' Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne usse kaha, 'Agar yahi tumhaara irada hai, to jaan lo ke tumhaare liye Rifa'a se dobara nikaah karna jaayez nahi jab tak Abdur Rahman tumhaare saath humbistari na kare.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne Abdur Rahman ke saath do ladke dekhe aur pucha (unse), 'Kya ye tumhaare bete hain?' Isper Abdur Rahman ne kaha, 'Haan.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Tum jo dawa karte ho wo karte ho (yaani ke tum napunsak ho)? Magar Allah ki qasam, ye ladke unse aise milte-julte hain jaise ek kauwa doosre kauwe se milta hai.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ بِشِمَالِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِيَمِينِهِ رَجُلَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ثِيَابٌ بِيضٌ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، مَا رَأَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Sa`d:On the day of the battle of Uhud, on the right and on the left of the Prophet (ﷺ) were two men wearing white clothes, and I had neither seen them before, nor did I see them afterwards
77.hi: Sa'd bataate hain: Jang-e-Uhud ke din, Nabi (SAW) ke daaen aur baaen taraf do aadmi the jo safed kapde pehne hue the, aur maine unhein na pehle kabhi dekha tha, na baad mein dekha.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمَرَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا الأَسْوَدِ الدِّيلِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَلَيْهِ ثَوْبٌ أَبْيَضُ وَهْوَ نَائِمٌ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ وَقَدِ اسْتَيْقَظَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، إِلاَّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ عَلَى رَغْمِ أَنْفِ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ إِذَا حَدَّثَ بِهَذَا قَالَ وَإِنْ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ أَبِي ذَرٍّ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هَذَا عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ أَوْ قَبْلَهُ، إِذَا تَابَ وَنَدِمَ وَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ غُفِرَ لَهُ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu Dharr:I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was wearing white clothes and sleeping. Then I went back to him again after he had got up from his sleep. He said, "Nobody says: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' and then later on he dies while believing in that, except that he will enter Paradise." I said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said. 'Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft." I said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?" He said. 'Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft." I said, 'Even it he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft?' He said, "Even if he had committed illegal sexual intercourse and theft, inspite of the Abu Dharr's dislike. Abu `Abdullah said, "This is at the time of death or before it if one repents and regrets and says "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. He will be forgiven his sins
77.hi: Abu Dharr (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Main Nabi (SAW) ke paas aaya jabke wo safed kapde pehne hue so rahe the. Phir main unke jaagne ke baad dobara unke paas gaya. Unhone kaha, 'Koi bhi shaks "La ilaha illallah" (Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi) kehta hai aur phir isi Iman par mar jaata hai, wo Jannat mein daakhil hoga.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho.' Maine pucha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho?' Unhone kaha, 'Chaahe usne zina aur chori ki ho,' Abu Dharr ki napasandidagi ke bawajood. Abu Abdullah (رضی اللہ عنہ) kehte hain, 'Ye maut ke waqt ya usse pehle ki baat hai agar koi tauba kare, pachhtaawa kare aur kahe "La ilaha illallah." Uske gunaah maaf kar diye jaayenge.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ، أَتَانَا كِتَابُ عُمَرَ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ بِأَذْرَبِيجَانَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ، إِلاَّ هَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ اللَّتَيْنِ تَلِيَانِ الإِبْهَامَ قَالَ فِيمَا عَلِمْنَا أَنَّهُ يَعْنِي الأَعْلاَمَ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Aba `Uthman An-Nahdi:While we were with `Utba bin Farqad at Adharbijan, there came `Umar's letter indicating that Allah's Apostle had forbidden the use of silk except this much, then he pointed with his index and middle fingers. To our knowledge, by that he meant embroidery
77.hi: Aba Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) An-Nahdi bataate hain: Jab hum Utba bin Farqad ke saath Azerbaijan mein the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ka ek khat aaya jismein bataya gaya tha ke Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham istemaal karne se mana kiya siwaaye itne ke, phir unhone apni shahaadat aur beech ki ungli se ishara kiya. Hamaari samajh mein, unka matlab kadhaai (embroidery) se tha.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْنَا عُمَرُ وَنَحْنُ بِأَذْرَبِيجَانَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ إِلاَّ هَكَذَا، وَصَفَّ لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِصْبَعَيْهِ‏.‏ وَرَفَعَ زُهَيْرٌ الْوُسْطَى وَالسَّبَّابَةَ‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu `Uthman:While we were at Adharbijan, `Umar wrote to us: 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade wearing silk except this much. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) approximated his two fingers (index and middle fingers) (to illustrate that) to us.' Zuhair (the sub-narrator) raised up his middle and index fingers
77.hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Azerbaijan mein the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein likha, 'Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne resham pehanne se mana kiya, siwaaye itne ke.' Phir Nabi (SAW) ne apni do ungliyaan (shahaadat aur beech ki) paas-paas laa kar humein dikhaayi. (Ravi Zuhair ne apni beech ki aur shahaadat ki ungli uthaayi.)

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ عُتْبَةَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُلْبَسُ الْحَرِيرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، إِلاَّ لَمْ يُلْبَسْ فِي الآخِرَةِ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ،، وَأَشَارَ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ الْمُسَبِّحَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Abu `Uthman:While we were with `Utba. `Umar wrote to us: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is none who wears silk in this world except that he will wear nothing of it in the Hereafter." ' Abu `Uthman pointed out with his middle and index fingers. This hadith has also been narrated by Abu `Uthman
77.hi: Abu Uthman (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Jab hum Utba ke saath the, Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ne humein likha, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo koi is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein isme se kuch nahi pehanega."' Abu Uthman ne apni beech ki aur shahaadat ki ungli se ishara kiya. Ye hadees Abu Uthman se bhi riwaayat ki gayi hai.

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ كَانَ حُذَيْفَةُ بِالْمَدَايِنِ فَاسْتَسْقَى، فَأَتَاهُ دِهْقَانٌ بِمَاءٍ فِي إِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَرَمَاهُ بِهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أَرْمِهِ إِلاَّ أَنِّي نَهَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَنْتَهِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الذَّهَبُ وَالْفِضَّةُ وَالْحَرِيرُ وَالدِّيبَاجُ هِيَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَلَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Ibn Abi Laila:While Hudhaifa was at Al-Madain, he asked for water whereupon the chief of the village brought him water in a silver cup. Hudhaifa threw it at him and said, "I have thrown it only because I have forbidden him to use it, but he does not stop using it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Gold, silver, silk and Dibaj (a kind of silk) are for them (unbelievers) in this world and for you (Muslims) in the hereafter
77.hi: Ibn Abi Laila bataate hain: Jab Hudhaifa (رضی اللہ عنہ) Al-Mada'in mein the, unhone paani maanga, isper gaon ke sardaar ne unhein chaandi ke pyaale mein paani diya. Hudhaifa ne use unpar phenk diya aur kaha, 'Maine ise isliye phenka kyunke maine usse ise istemaal karne se mana kiya tha, magar wo istemaal karna nahi chhodta. Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, "Sona, chaandi, resham aur Dibaj (ek qism ka resham) unke (kaafiron ke) liye is duniya mein hai, aur tumhaare (Musalmaanon ke) liye Aakhirat mein."'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَقُلْتُ أَعَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ شَدِيدًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَلَنْ يَلْبَسَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Whoever wears silk in this world shall not wear it in the Hereafter
77.hi: Anas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bin Malik (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi pehanega.'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
77.en: Narrated Thabit:I heard Ibn Az-Zubair delivering a sermon, saying, "Muhammad said, 'Whoever wears silk in this world, shall not wear it in the Hereafter
77.hi: Thabit bataate hain: Maine Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko khutba dete hue ye kehte suna, 'Muhammad (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi pehanega."'

77.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي ذُبْيَانَ، خَلِيفَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، قَالَتْ مُعَاذَةُ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمُّ عَمْرٍو بِنْتُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، سَمِعَ عُمَرَ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏ نَحْوَهُ
77.en: Narrated Ibn Az-Zubair:I heard `Umar saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever wears silk in this world, shall not wear it in the Hereafter." This hadith is also narrated through 'Umar ibn al-Khattab
77.hi: Ibn Az-Zubair (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) ko ye kehte suna, 'Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, "Jo is duniya mein resham pehanta hai, wo Aakhirat mein use nahi pehanega."' Ye hadees Umar bin Al-Khattab ke zariye bhi riwaayat ki gayi hai.
