97.en: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The delegates of `Abdul Qais came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "The pagans of the tribe of Mudar intervene between you and us therefore we cannot come to you except in the Holy months. So please order us to do something good (Religious deeds) by which we may enter Paradise (by acting on them) and we may inform our people whom we have left behind to observe it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you from four things: I order you to believe in Allah. Do you know what is meant by belief in Allah? It is to testify that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to offer prayers perfectly, to give Zakat, and to give Al-Khumus (one-fifth of the war booty) (in Allah's Cause). And I forbid you four things, (i.e., Do not drink alcoholic drinks) Ad-Dubba, An- Naqir, (pitched water skins), Az-Zuruf, Al-Muzaffat and Al--Hantam (names of utensils used for the preparation of alcoholic drinks)." (See Hadith No. 50, Vol)
97.hi: Ibn Abbas (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Abd Al-Qais qabeele ke namaindé (delegates) Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ke paas aaye aur kaha, 'Mudar qabeele ke mushrik hamare aur aapke beech aate hain, isliye hum sirf muqaddas maheenon mein hi aap tak pahunch paate hain. Isliye barah-e-meharbaani humein kuch achhi (deeni) cheezein karne ka hukm dijiye (taake amal karke hum Jannat mein daakhil ho sakein) aur taake hum apne piche chhode logon ko bhi iske baare mein bataa sakein.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Main tumhein chaar cheezon ka hukm deta hoon aur chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: Main tumhein Allah par Iman laane ka hukm deta hoon. Kya tumhein pata hai Allah par Iman laane ka matlab kya hai? Ye hai ke gawaahi do ke Allah ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laayak nahi, sahi tareeke se namaz padho, Zakat do, aur Al-Khumus (jang ke maal-e-ganimat ka paanchwaan hissa) do (Allah ki raah mein). Aur main tumhein chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon, (yaani nasha-aawar sharbat na piyo) Ad-Dubba, An-Naqir, (chamde ke thaile), Az-Zuruf, Al-Muzaffat, aur Al-Hantam (nasha-aawar sharbat taiyaar karne ke liye istemaal hone waale bartanon ke naam).' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees No. 50, Jild dekhein.)

97.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
97.en: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The painter of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, Make alive what you have created
97.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Allah ke Rasool (SAW) ne farmaya, 'In tasveeron ka chitrakaar Qayamat ke din saza paayega, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Zinda karo jo tumne banaaya."'

97.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
97.en: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The painters of these pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and it will be said to them, 'Make alive what you have created
97.hi: Ibn Umar (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Un tasveeron ke chitrakaar Qayamat ke din saza paayenge, aur unse kaha jaayega, "Zinda karo jo tumne banaaya."'

97.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذَهَبَ يَخْلُقُ كَخَلْقِي، فَلْيَخْلُقُوا ذَرَّةً، أَوْ لِيَخْلُقُوا حَبَّةً أَوْ شَعِيرَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
97.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Allah said, 'Who are most unjust than those who try to create something like My creation? I challenge them to create even a smallest ant, a wheat grain or a barley grain
97.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Maine Nabi (SAW) ko ye kehte suna, 'Allah ne farmaaya, "Kaun us shaks se zyaada zaalim ho sakta hai jo Meri takhleeq jaisi koi cheez banaane ki koshish kare? Main unhein challenge (chunauti) deta hoon ke wo ek sabse chhoti chionti, gehun ka daana, ya jau ka daana bhi banaayein."'

97.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالأُتْرُجَّةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَالَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ كَالتَّمْرَةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا، وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الرَّيْحَانَةِ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ، وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي لاَ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الْحَنْظَلَةِ، طَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ وَلاَ رِيحَ لَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
97.en: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The example of a believer who recites the Qur'an is that of a citron (a citrus fruit) which is good in taste and good in smell. And the believer who does not recite the Qur'an is like a date which has a good taste but no smell. And the example of an impious person who recites the Qur'an is that of Ar-Rihana (an aromatic plant) which smells good but is bitter in taste. And the example of an impious person who does not recite the Qur'an is that of a colocynth which is bitter in taste and has no smell
97.hi: Abu Musa (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Ek aise Momin ki misaal jo Quran padhta hai, ek Utrujj (khatte phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayka bhi achha hai aur khushbu bhi achhi hai. Aur wo Momin jo Quran nahi padhta, wo khajoor jaisa hai jiska zaayka achha hai magar khushbu nahi hai. Aur ek badkaar shaks ki misaal jo Quran padhta hai, Ar-Rihana (ek khushbudaar paudha) jaisi hai jiski khushbu achhi hai magar zaayka kadwa hai. Aur ek badkaar shaks jo Quran nahi padhta, uski misaal Handh (ek kadwe swaad waala phal) jaisi hai jiska zaayka kadwa hai aur khushbu bhi nahi hai.'

97.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ سَأَلَ أُنَاسٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْكُهَّانِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيْسُوا بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ يُحَدِّثُونَ بِالشَّىْءِ يَكُونُ حَقًّا‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تِلْكَ الْكَلِمَةُ مِنَ الْحَقِّ يَخْطَفُهَا الْجِنِّيُّ فَيُقَرْقِرُهَا فِي أُذُنِ وَلِيِّهِ كَقَرْقَرَةِ الدَّجَاجَةِ، فَيَخْلِطُونَ فِيهِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مِائَةِ كَذْبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
97.en: Narrated `Aisha:Some people asked the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the soothsayers. He said, "They are nothing." They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Some of their talks come true." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "That word which happens to be true is what a Jinn snatches away by stealth (from the Heaven) and pours it in the ears of his friend (the foreteller) with a sound like the cackling of a hen. The soothsayers then mix with that word, one hundred lies
97.hi: Aisha (رضی اللہ عنہا) bataati hain: Kuch logon ne Nabi (SAW) se ganitagaar (jyotishiyon/soothsayers) ke baare mein pucha. Unhone kaha, 'Wo kuch nahi hain.' Unhone kaha, 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Unki kuch baaten sach nikalti hain.' Nabi (SAW) ne kaha, 'Wo baat jo sach nikalti hai wo Jinn dwara chupke se (Aasman se) chhini gayi hoti hai aur wo apne dost (jyotishi) ke kaan mein aisi aawaaz ke saath daalta hai jaisi murgi ki kudkudaahat. Phir jyotishi us baat mein sau jhoot mila dete hain.'

97.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سِيرِينَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَخْرُجُ نَاسٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَشْرِقِ وَيَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لاَ يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ، يَمْرُقُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ كَمَا يَمْرُقُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ لاَ يَعُودُونَ فِيهِ حَتَّى يَعُودَ السَّهْمُ إِلَى فُوقِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ مَا سِيمَاهُمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ سِيمَاهُمُ التَّحْلِيقُ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ التَّسْبِيدُ ‏"‏‏.‏
97.en: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will emerge from the East some people who will recite the Qur'an but it will not exceed their throats and who will go out of (renounce) the religion (Islam) as an arrow passes through the game, and they will never come back to it unless the arrow, comes back to the middle of the bow (by itself) (i.e., impossible). The people asked, "What will their signs be?" He said, "Their sign will be the habit of shaving (of their beards and their heads). (Fath-ul-Bari, Page 322, Vol. 17th)
97.hi: Abu Saeed Al-Khudri (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, 'Poorab se kuch log zaahir honge jo Quran padhenge magar wo unke galay se aage nahi jaayega, aur wo deen (Islam) chhod denge (tyaag denge) jaise ek teer shikaar se guzar jaata hai, aur wo kabhi ismein wapas nahi aayenge jab tak teer khud (apne aap) kamaan ke beech tak wapas na aa jaaye (yaani asambhav).' Logon ne pucha, 'Unki nishaani kya hogi?' Unhone kaha, 'Unki nishaani (unki daadi aur sar) mundhwaane ki aadat hogi.' (Fath-ul-Bari, Page 322, Jild 17.)

97.ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِشْكَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَلِمَتَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
97.en: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(There are) two words which are dear to the Beneficent (Allah) and very light (easy) for the tongue (to say), but very heavy in weight in the balance. They are: ''Subhan Allah wa-bi hamdihi'' and ''Subhan Allah Al-`Azim." (see Hadith)
97.hi: Abu Huraira (رضی اللہ عنہ) bataate hain: Nabi (SAW) ne farmaya, '(Do jumle hain) jo Rehmaan (Allah) ko aziz hain aur zubaan ke liye bahut halke (aasaan) hain, magar (Amaal ke) taraazu mein bahut bhaari hain. Wo hain: "Subhan Allah wa-bi Hamdihi" aur "Subhan Allah Al-Azim."' (Poori tafseel ke liye Hadees dekhein.)
